jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. AI Automation & Data Platform Lead(Build & Scale Our AI-Driven Global Sourcing Platform) About ASC GlobalASC Global is a global independent distributor and sourcing company serving the electronic-components, computer and data-center, industrial MRO and aviation MRO markets.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

AI Automation & Data Platform Lead

(Build & Scale Our AI-Driven Global Sourcing Platform)

About ASC Global

ASC Global is a global independent distributor and sourcing company serving the electronic-components, computer and data-center, industrial MRO and aviation MRO markets. We source semiconductors, passive components, interconnect products, memory, computer hardware, data-center infrastructure and industrial/aviation parts from suppliers worldwide.

The Opportunity

We're building an AI-driven global sourcing and product-intelligence platform, and we need someone who can both build it and help the rest of the company put AI to work. This is a rare hybrid: part hands-on technical builder, part AI/automation lead for the business. You'll personally architect and ship a system that continuously monitors hundreds of distributor sites, broker inventories, marketplaces and manufacturer sources - identifying products, capturing pricing and availability, and matching listings to canonical parts - while also working directly with our buyers, sales, operations and leadership to find and implement practical AI use cases across the company.

This is not a role where you hand requirements to someone else and wait. You'll write the code, deploy the system, and also run the workshops that get people using it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate the crawling, data-ingestion, normalization and matching platform - handling static and JavaScript-rendered sites, PDFs, pagination and multilingual content, with full source provenance on every record

  • Design the canonical product/supplier/offer data model and the entity-resolution logic that matches listings to real parts

  • Use LLMs where they genuinely help (extraction, translation, classification) with proper evaluation, confidence thresholds and human review - never letting a model guess a price or quantity it can't find

  • Connect the platform to Zoho CRM's RFQ workflow and, downstream, QuickBooks

  • Work with Sales, Purchasing, Operations and Finance to spot other processes AI or automation can improve, turn those into real pilots, train employees to use them, and track the impact

What Success Looks Like

  • A working architecture and data model within the first 90 days

  • At least 10 sources connected with full provenance

  • Searchable, normalized product and supplier data

  • Measured matching accuracy

  • Source-health monitoring in place

  • An initial Zoho RFQ integration

  • Beyond that: measurable hours saved, faster sourcing turnaround, broader AI adoption across departments, and a documented plan for scaling to hundreds of sources

What We're Looking For

  • Five or more years of hands-on software/data-engineering experience with real production ownership of web-crawling or large-scale data-acquisition systems - not personal projects or coursework

  • Advanced Python and strong SQL

  • Experience with a production crawling framework (e.g. Scrapy) and browser automation (Playwright or Selenium) for JavaScript-rendered sites

  • Solid grounding in HTTP, rate limiting, retries, queues and failure recovery

  • Experience building normalized pipelines from messy, conflicting data, plus entity resolution / fuzzy matching / deduplication work backed by real accuracy numbers

  • Strong PostgreSQL (or similar), plus Docker and at least one major cloud platform

  • Comfortable using LLM APIs in production - structured outputs, evaluation, cost control - without treating them as a replacement for deterministic checks

  • Personally implemented an AI or automation solution inside a real company (not just used the tools), ideally across more than one department, and comfortable running training and translating business needs into requirements for other engineers

Nice to Have

  • Temporal, Dagster, Prefect or Airflow

  • OpenSearch or Elasticsearch

  • RapidFuzz, Splink or embeddings-based matching

  • Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks or other ERP integrations

  • Electronic components or other complex technical catalogs

  • Prior experience as the first or lead engineer on a new platform

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Nurse Practitioner to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:
  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

This is a backend-first role: about 70% backend (Python, some ) and 30% frontend (React/TypeScript). You'll own the server side of the funnel: APIs behind registration, booking and the visitor account, attribution, and server-side integrations with ad platforms. When a feature needs frontend work, you'll take it end-to-end yourself. You'll work within the squad's processes: planning, grooming, code review, sprints and releases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain Python services and APIs behind the funnel: registration, booking and the visitor account

  • Build and own server-side integrations with ad platforms (Meta CAPI, TikTok Events API and similar): event delivery, deduplication, retries and monitoring

  • Own attribution on the backend: end-to-end visit tracking, UTM persistence, and diagnosing gaps in V2L/V2B data

  • Keep services fast and reliable: caching, query optimization, debugging server-side rendering in our layer

  • Investigate production incidents through Sentry and see them through to resolution

  • Support A/B testing on the server side: feature flags, rollouts, and cleanup after experiments

  • Ship frontend changes in React/TypeScript when a feature needs it

Requirements

  • Requirements

    • 5+ years of production backend development in Python, including services you designed, shipped and supported in production yourself

    • Strong backend fundamentals: API design, relational databases and SQL, caching, background jobs, and integrating third-party APIs (auth, rate limits, retries, idempotency)

    • Production debugging experience: logs, error tracking, finding the root cause of an issue

    • : comfortable reading and changing an Express service

    • Working frontend skills: enough TypeScript and React to deliver a feature end-to-end. Expert level not required.

    • An understanding of how tracking data travels from click to report, and the ability to find where it gets lost

    • Product mindset: you work with metrics and hypotheses, not just tickets

    • Fluent English

    Nice to Have

    • Server-side conversion tracking (CAPI, Events API, server-side GTM)

    • BigQuery: checking your own hypotheses with data

    • CDN and edge caching (CloudFront or similar)

    • GDPR and consent mechanisms

    • E2E testing with Playwright or Cypress

    Our Tech Stack

    Python, , Express (SSR), TypeScript, React, , Sentry, GrowthBook, BigQuery.

    What we offer

    • Fully remote work

    • A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education

    • A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products

    • Unlimited holidays, because we trust you to deliver

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

jobs.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease company focused on significantly improving outcomes for individuals with hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinism (HI). Our antibody therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is designed to treat all forms of HI and has shown substantial benefit in clinical trials and real-world use for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI) and tumor hyperinsulinism (tumor HI).

The Associate Director, Medical Affairs Operations will play a key role in supporting the implementation, coordination, and ongoing management of Medical Affairs operational capabilities, processes, systems, and infrastructure to enable effective execution of Medical Affairs strategies and initiatives.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Medical Affairs Strategy & Operations, this individual will translate established Medical Affairs priorities into operational plans, processes, and deliverables supporting pre-launch, launch, post-launch, and future pipeline activities. The position will support the Executive Director in advancing Medical Affairs operational capabilities, infrastructure, governance, and launch readiness, while maintaining alignment with functional leadership on priorities, resource allocation, and key operational decisions.

The successful candidate will combine strong project management skills, operational expertise, initiative, and attention to detail with the ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and collaborate effectively across functions. This individual will contribute to building scalable Medical Affairs infrastructure and operational processes appropriate for Rezolute's evolution into a commercial-stage organization.

Key Responsibilities

    1. Medical Affairs Operational Planning & Execution

    • Translate established Medical Affairs strategies and priorities into operational project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and tracking mechanisms.
    • Manage assigned Medical Affairs operational initiatives and projects from planning through execution, ensuring alignment with approved objectives and timelines.
    • Coordinate activities across Medical Affairs functions to support effective implementation of approved initiatives and launch readiness priorities.
    • Develop and maintain integrated project trackers, operational dashboards, milestone reports, and risk and dependency logs.
    • Facilitate operational planning meetings, document decisions and action items, and drive follow-through on assigned responsibilities.
    • Identify operational challenges, resource constraints, and execution risks; recommend solutions and escalate significant issues to Medical Affairs leadership as appropriate.

      • 2. Medical Affairs Systems, Technology & Infrastructure

      • Coordinate implementation, administration, and ongoing optimization of Medical Affairs systems and technologies based on functional requirements, priorities, and governance established by Medical Affairs leadership.
      • Support implementation and management of platforms such as Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault/PromoMats, and other relevant Medical Affairs technology solutions.
      • Partner with Information Technology, Compliance, functional stakeholders, and external vendors to coordinate system configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
      • Develop and maintain standardized workflows, system documentation, user guidance, and training resources.
      • Coordinate system onboarding, user access, troubleshooting, and process enhancements to support effective adoption and utilization.
      • Identify and recommend opportunities to improve operational efficiency, data management, reporting, and knowledge sharing through technology.

        • 3. Medical Affairs Governance, Compliance & Process Management

        • Coordinate drafting, implementation, maintenance, and periodic review of Medical Affairs standard operating procedures (SOPs), policies, and operational processes under the direction and oversight of Medical Affairs leadership and appropriate functional stakeholders.
        • Support implementation and administration of governance processes for Medical-Legal-Regulatory (MLR) review, HCP interactions, advisory boards, medical education, grants, congress activities, and other Medical Affairs programs.
        • Develop and maintain operational documentation, templates, tracking tools, and records to support compliance, consistency, and inspection readiness.
        • Collaborate with Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and other functions to ensure operational processes are aligned with applicable requirements and approved company policies.
        • Support periodic process assessments, internal audits, and corrective or preventive actions as appropriate.
        • Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize workflows and implement approved process improvements.

          • 4. Medical Affairs Programs & Launch Readiness

          • Provide operational and project management support for Medical Affairs programs, including Field Medical, Medical Communications, Medical Information, Medical Education, congress activities, advisory boards, and external scientific engagements.
          • Coordinate timelines, logistics, vendors, documentation, and deliverables associated with assigned Medical Affairs initiatives.
          • Support implementation of Medical Affairs launch readiness plans, including operational infrastructure, systems, processes, training coordination, and functional preparedness.
          • Track progress against established launch milestones, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate updates to Medical Affairs leadership.
          • Partner with Medical Affairs functional leads to facilitate timely, consistent, and compliant execution of approved programs.
          • Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders as appropriate to support operational alignment and execution.

            • 5. Budget, Resource & Vendor Management

            • Support Medical Affairs leadership in budget development, forecasting, and resource planning through preparation of financial data, tracking reports, and operational analyses.
            • Manage assigned activities related to expense tracking, purchase orders, invoices, contracting workflows, and budget reconciliation.
            • Coordinate vendor identification, onboarding, contracting, and ongoing management in accordance with approved procurement processes and Medical Affairs leadership direction.
            • Monitor vendor deliverables, project timelines, performance, and expenditures against approved budgets and contractual expectations.
            • Maintain accurate records of vendor agreements, financial commitments, and operational expenditures.
            • Identify opportunities to improve vendor coordination, resource utilization, and operational cost efficiency.

              • 6. Operational Metrics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

              • Develop and maintain operational dashboards, reporting tools, and performance tracking mechanisms aligned with Medical Affairs leadership-defined objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs).
              • Coordinate collection, consolidation, and reporting of operational data across Medical Affairs systems, programs, and functional teams.
              • Prepare periodic operational performance reports, project updates, and launch readiness summaries for Medical Affairs leadership.
              • Monitor execution against approved operational plans and identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
              • Recommend and implement approved process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, consistency, scalability, and accountability.
              • Support ongoing evaluation and refinement of Medical Affairs operational processes and infrastructure as organizational needs evolve.

                • 7. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Coordination

                • Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Information Technology, Patient Affairs, and other relevant functions to facilitate coordinated operational execution.
                • Support implementation of cross-functional workflows and processes that enable effective collaboration while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs functional independence and compliance requirements.
                • Facilitate communication, information sharing, and resolution of operational dependencies across internal and external stakeholders.
                • Represent Medical Affairs Operations in assigned project teams, working groups, and operational meetings, communicating progress, challenges, and recommendations to Medical Affairs leadership.
                • Support implementation of leadership decisions and ensure appropriate operational follow-through across affected stakeholders.

                  • 8. Other Responsibilities

                  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Expected Capabilities

    • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare, business administration, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
    • Minimum of 5–7 years of relevant experience within the biopharmaceutical industry, including experience in Medical Affairs operations, project management, or related functions.
    • Demonstrated experience supporting Medical Affairs operational activities, systems, infrastructure, and processes within a pharmaceutical or biotechnology organization.
    • Familiarity with core Medical Affairs capabilities, including Field Medical, Medical Communications, Medical Information, Medical Education, congress activities, and external scientific engagements.
    • Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing Medical Affairs technology platforms, including Veeva CRM, Veeva Vault/PromoMats, or comparable systems preferred.
    • Working knowledge of Medical Affairs governance, SOPs, MLR processes, and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
    • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects independently, establish executional priorities within approved direction, identify dependencies and risks, and drive deliverables through completion.
    • Experience coordinating vendors, contracts, budgets, purchase orders, and financial tracking processes.
    • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, project management tools, and operational reporting systems.
    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners in a matrixed environment.
    • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
    • Ability to balance independent execution with appropriate communication, escalation, and alignment with functional leadership.
    • Experience in rare diseases, specialty therapeutics, launch preparation, or growing biotechnology organizations preferred.
    • High degree of accountability, adaptability, initiative, integrity, and commitment to operational excellence and compliance.

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for the Associate Director, Medical Affairs Operations role could range from $195,000 to $225,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate's geographical location and qualifications for the role, including education and experience.This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan. Rezolute offers competitive compensation, stock options, and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud FinOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton is seeking a skilled and motivated FinOps Cloud Engineer to support DOI USGS Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a skilled and motivated FinOps Cloud Engineer to support DOI USGS Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program. You will serve as the primary financial operations authority for a multi-environment AWS cloud platform supporting 50+ software developers, 20 business analysts, and Government staff engaged in permitting modernization. You will own end-to-end cloud cost management from consumption forecasting to rightsizing recommendations and budget enforcement, following the FinOps Foundation's Inform → Optimize → Operate framework. This is a high-visibility, mission-critical role operating within a FedRAMP-compliant federal environment, directly supporting one of DOI's flagship technology modernization efforts.

Peraton supports the U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI) and U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) in modernizing the federal permitting process through the Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program. At the heart of this initiative is the WARP platform (Workflows, Authorizations, Registrations, and Permits), a cloud-native AWS environment purpose-built to streamline and accelerate how the federal government processes permits, authorizations, and registrations. The program leverages cutting-edge cloud infrastructure, AI-assisted decision support, and advanced data engineering to serve a large, distributed team of developers, business analysts, and Government stakeholders. Peraton's role spans the full lifecycle of cloud operations from provisioning and managing secure multi-environment AWS infrastructure and AI/ML services to delivering workforce training and certification, all within a rigorous federal compliance framework including FedRAMP, FISMA, and NIST security standards.

Work Location: Remote

What You Will Do:

  • Produce monthly FinOps reports including cloud and AI consumption forecasts vs. actuals, unit economics, and Government-facing chargeback views aligned to contract deliverables.
  • Configure and manage AWS Budgets, Cost Explorer, Cost Anomaly Detection, and Trusted Advisor to monitor spending, identify anomalies, and enforce financial guardrails.
  • Develop and maintain quarterly rightsizing recommendation packages, identifying underutilized or over-provisioned resources and presenting actionable optimization strategies to Government stakeholders.
  • Implement and enforce auto-suspend policies for non-production environments to reduce idle consumption costs, as directed by the customer.
  • Manage AI/ML cost tracking for Amazon Bedrock LLM inference and token consumption, applying FinOps for AI disciplines.
  • Issue Limitation of Funds notifications to the Contracting Officer at the 75% consumption threshold and provide 60-day advance warning before funding exhaustion.
  • Maintain compliance with FedRAMP Moderate, FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and all applicable DOI security and financial policies.
  • Complete mandatory annual DOI IT Security Awareness Training and execute required DOI Rules of Behavior and non-disclosure agreements.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
  • Must perform all work within the United States; no international work permitted under this contract.
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 6 years of professional experience, or a PhD and 3 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree and 10 years of professional experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent and 12 years of professional experience.
  • 5 plus years of hands-on cloud engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on cloud financial management (FinOps).
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with FinOps Foundation Best Practices for cloud and AI including Tokenomics, FOCUS and tagging strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience managing AWS cost attribution, budgets, and financial reporting in a multi-account, multi-environment AWS Organization.
  • Proven ability to build and deliver recurring cloud consumption reports and cost optimization deliverables for Government or enterprise clients.
  • Advanced proficiency with AWS Cost Management tools: Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, Cost Anomaly Detection, Trusted Advisor.
  • Understanding of Amazon Bedrock or other LLM/AI token-based cost models.
  • Experience with Databricks or similar data platform cost management.
  • Proficiency in reporting tools and ability to present financial data clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting U.S. federal government programs with FedRAMP, FISMA, or NIST SP 800-53 compliance requirements.
  • One or more of the following certifications (or able to obtain with 90 days):
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional.
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional.
  • FinOps Certified Engineer
  • FinOps Certified AI Value

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with FinOps for AI/ML cost management (token metering, inference optimization).
  • Familiarity with Databricks cluster cost governance and workspace administration.
  • Familiarity with AWS Organizations, tag policies, and Service Control Policies (SCPs).
  • Familiarity with AWS compute services: EC2, Lambda, Fargate, ECS/EKS, and associated cost drivers.
  • Familiarity with ETL pipelines and medallion-architecture cost considerations.
  • Experience with 3rd party cloud financial management tools such as IBM Cloudability, Flexera.
  • Prior experience on a DOI, USGS, or other Department of Interior program.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum delivery environment using GitLab or Atlassian (Jira/Confluence).
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-37 (RMF), or NIST SP 800-64 (SDLC security).
  • Experience with cloud governance frameworks in multi-AZ/multi-region AWS deployments.
  • Background in data engineering or analytics platforms (Databricks, AWS Glue, or similar).
  • Familiarity with federal acquisition regulations, particularly reporting and notification requirements under T&M contract vehicles.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: What We NeedCorpay is looking for a UX Designer to join our Corporate Payments division.
jobs.description:
What We Need

Corpay is looking for a UX Designer to join our Corporate Payments division. In this role, the UX Designer will shape the next generation of digital experiences for our Payables business. You’ll work across a diverse product ecosystem that includes complex web applications, operational and administrative tools, and intuitive end-user experiences. One day, you may be simplifying a high-volume workflow for finance teams; the next, you may be designing tools for administrators or creating a seamless experience for an individual user completing a payment-related task.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who enjoys turning complexity into clarity—and who thrives when ideas move quickly from sketch to prototype to shipped experience. You’ll work in tight feedback loops with Product, Research, Engineering, and fellow designers to frame problems, explore possibilities, test assumptions, and continuously improve what we put in front of customers.

We care deeply about craft, but we don’t confuse perfection with progress. The strongest candidate will know how to choose the right level of fidelity, move decisively with incomplete information, and maintain a high bar for quality while keeping momentum. We’re also looking for a designer who sees AI as an advantage. Not as a replacement for judgment, empathy, or creativity—and not as a shortcut—but as a powerful way to expand exploration, automate repetitive work, accelerate prototyping, challenge assumptions, and produce better work faster. You will collaborate closely with Product, Research, Design, and Engineering partners and report directly into the VP of Product.

How We Work As a UX Designer you will be expected to work in a virtual environment.

Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

  • Company-issued equipment
  • Formal, hands-on training

Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of this role will include:

  • Designing end-to-end interfaces, interactions, and workflows across Corpay’s Payables product ecosystem.
  • Creating experiences for sophisticated web applications, internal and customer-facing administrative tools, and end-user consumer applications.
  • Simplifying complex financial and operational workflows without losing the depth, control, or flexibility users need.
  • Translating user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into experiences that are clear, useful, and ready to move forward.
  • Producing low-fidelity concepts early and often to help Product teams explore opportunities, clarify scope, and make faster decisions.
  • Creating prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity for stakeholder alignment, usability research, and development handoff.
  • Partnering with UX Researchers to understand user behaviors, identify unmet needs, test concepts, and turn findings into meaningful product improvements.
  • Working directly with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the development process—not simply at the beginning and end.
  • Using AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly to accelerate activities such as ideation, workflow exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, content development, and documentation.
  • Protecting customer and company information by using AI tools in accordance with Corpay’s privacy, security, and data-handling standards.
  • Maintaining a prioritized backlog of incremental design improvements and helping the team continuously raise the quality of the Payables experience.
  • Contributing to and evolving Corpay’s UX Design System, including patterns, components, documentation, and standards.
  • Collaborating with developers to keep coded component libraries aligned with the Design System.
  • Designing responsive experiences that work effectively across devices and adapting to the needs of different user types.
  • Balancing speed with usability, accessibility, consistency, and attention to detail.
  • Communicating design rationale clearly, inviting critique, and adapting quickly when new evidence points toward a better solution.
  • Taking on additional high-impact design challenges as the product and business evolve.

Qualifications & Skills

  • At least 4+ years of professional experience in UX, product, or interaction design.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong interaction design, clear problem-solving, thoughtful iteration, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience designing complex web applications, administrative platforms, workflow tools, or consumer-facing digital products.
  • Experience working with agile product and development teams.
  • The ability to move comfortably between rough concepts, detailed interface design, interactive prototypes, and implementation support.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma or comparable modern design and prototyping tools.
  • Curiosity about AI and hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools to improve the quality or speed of your design process.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to determine when a design needs deeper exploration—and when it is ready to move forward.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity, creating clarity, and making progress without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in a remote environment.
  • Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail.
  • The ability to work independently while actively seeking input, sharing work early, and contributing to a highly collaborative team.
  • A genuine commitment to understanding users and advocating for their needs.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • A degree or certification in Human-Computer Interaction, interaction design, UX design, or a related field.
  • Experience designing financial products, payment platforms, accounts payable software, enterprise tools, or other transaction-based products.
  • Experience designing for multiple audiences, such as finance professionals, administrators, operations teams, and individual end users.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design practices.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining a design system.
  • Experience working successfully on a distributed or remote team.

You’ll Thrive Here If You You like to make ideas tangible. You share work before it feels perfect, learn from feedback, and improve it quickly. You can untangle a complicated workflow, understand the needs of multiple user types, and create an experience that feels focused and intuitive. You can defend a design decision without becoming attached to it. You know that speed and quality are not opposites when a team has strong judgment, clear priorities, and short feedback loops. Most importantly, you are excited about how the designer’s role is evolving. You bring the empathy, taste, curiosity, and critical thinking that technology cannot replace—and you actively use new technology to increase what you are capable of producing.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
  • Automatic enrollment into our 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
  • Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, and volunteer time
  • Employee discounts with major providers (wireless, gym, car rental, and more)
  • Philanthropic support with local and national organizations
  • Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes

Pay Transparency The expected salary range for this position is $100,000 – $120,000, based on the candidate’s work location. This range reflects a good faith estimate of the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The final offer will be determined based on job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable market conditions. Compensation may vary based on geographic location and will be confirmed during the hiring process. Additional compensation and benefits, including incentive programs, health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits (where applicable), may also be provided.

#CORPAY

About Corpay

Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions. Learn more about Corpay:

Transparency & Compliance

Equal Opportunity Employer Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.

Candidate Privacy Notice For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice:

Pay Philosophy Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.

Overview

Change Business Partner - MRP

Location: MexicoorUS based remote with travels

Role Overview:

The Change Business Partner will lead the people-side implementation of strategic transformation across manufacturing operations. This includes driving the adoption of new systems, processes, and behaviours that enhance efficiency, safety, and growth. A key focus will be supporting the deployment and behavioural integration of standard costing across manufacturing sites, ensuring consistency in cost control, performance tracking, and margin visibility. The role requires a strong understanding of manufacturing, ERP (notably Microsoft D365), and change facilitation to support both people and site-level transitions.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support change initiatives linked to process improvements and ERP projects, with a particular focus on standard costing.
  • Partner with finance, operations, and systems teams to make sure costing methods are understood, applied consistently, and support effective cost control.
  • Help operational leaders move from legacy costing approaches to standardised cost models, explaining the impact on reporting, performance measurement, and profitability.
  • Work with local teams to build understanding of how standard costs are created and maintained, including bill of materials (BOM) accuracy, labour and machine rates, and overhead allocation.
  • Deliver training and capability-building activities that strengthen cost awareness and accountability across production and planning teams.
  • Act as the link between Global Process Owners, finance teams, and manufacturing sites, turning costing policy into practical day-to-day processes within D365.
  • Support the accuracy and integrity of costing data by identifying gaps in processes, systems, and reporting, and helping teams put the right controls in place.
  • Drive adoption of new ways of working, making sure standard costing becomes embedded in decision-making rather than simply a finance exercise.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • Experience delivering change management within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Understands and leads for the to-be processes and ways of working.
  • Understanding and advocating good practices in principle and in detail for a range of topics especially standard costing (cost build-up, cost drivers, variance analysis, cost updates) and margin management, but also MRP, planning, and warehousing.
  • Experience supporting or deploying standard costing frameworks within ERP systems (especially Microsoft D365), including training, data validation, and cost centre alignment.
  • Ability to engage both finance and non-finance teams in understanding the operational impact of cost changes, cost performance, and product profitability.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence frontline teams, middle management, and senior leaders.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, particularly in operational and technical contexts.
  • Experience with ERP systems (JD Edwards, Microsoft D365) is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable working at different levels of the organisation.
  • Flexible to adapt to the changing business needs of the projects.
  • Serves as best practice/quality resource within Standard costing and ERP Transformations.

Qualifications and Behaviours:

  • Aptitude to learn and adapt, seeing change opportunities and encouraging others to seek positive change.
  • Change Management or Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher) is an advantage.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in finance management or transformation, or multi-site general management roles within manufacturing or industrial sectors.

We are a purpose driven organisation. Our purpose is to use advanced materials to make the world more sustainable and to improve the quality of life. We deliver on that purpose through the products that we make, and the way that we make them.

Product Designer, Industrial Solutions

Location: USRemote Job Term: Full-Time

The Opportunity

Picarro is looking for a Product Designer to own the design portfolio across our Industrial Solutions products. This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks in systems, sweats the details, and can move fluidly between design and code. Shaping how our products look, feel, and behave from prototype through production.

Good design at Picarro means something specific: our users are compliance managers, EHS leads, and field operators making high-stakes decisions under real-world constraints. We care about clarity, trust, and workflow efficiency — not engagement or delight for its own sake.

You will define and maintain design standards across Industrial Solutions, contribute directly to prototypes, and make production code contributions that bring designs to life. You will work closely with PM and engineering to ensure design intent survives the handoff, ensuring that what ships matches what was envisioned.

Responsibilities

Design Ownership

Own the design portfolio for Industrial Solutions, establishing and maintaining visual, interaction, and workflow standards across all products. You are the voice of design quality on the team.

User Research & Workflow Design

Deeply understand how industrial customers, compliance managers, EHS leads, and field operators work. Map user journeys, identify friction, and translate complex operational workflows into product experiences that are intuitive under real-world conditions.

Prototype Development

Collaborate with PM to build and refine product prototypes. You contribute, shape, and raise the quality bar before engineering picks work up.

Production Contributions

Make targeted code contributions in production to implement or refine UI and interaction patterns. You bridge the gap between what design specifies and what engineering delivers.

Design Review

Review production PRs for design and UX fidelity. Catch drift between intent and implementation before it reaches customers.

Design System Stewardship

Own and evolve the design system for Industrial Solutions, including components, patterns, and documentation to ensure consistency across the product surface.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in a design engineering, UX engineering, or product design role.
  • A portfolio of shipped product work — we want to see what you’ve built, how you think, and how your design decisions held up in production.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and document complex user workflows, not just screens.
  • Strong visual and UX design sensibility with the vocabulary to clearly articulate design decisions.
  • Proficiency with Figma for user flows, wireframing, prototyping, and handoff.
  • Proficiency in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; you can read, write, and contribute to production code.
  • Experience owning or contributing to a design system.
  • Comfortable working closely with both PMs and engineers — you can speak both languages.
  • AI-forward mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools in your design and development workflow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for data-dense, industrial, or enterprise environments where users are managing complex operational workflows.
  • Comfort working with user research outputs, synthesizing interview findings, usability results, and journey maps to inform design decisions.
  • Experience building prototypes that informed real engineering work, not just mockups.
  • Exposure to backend systems sufficient to understand technical constraints on design decisions.
  • Experience with or understanding of AI agents applied to design or frontend development workflows.
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth technology company.

Salary & Benefits:

The base salary range for this full-time position is $130k-$170k, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Total compensation includes base salary, bonus eligibility, and equity.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) plans
  • Life, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Vacation Policy and Paid Holidays
  • Employee Referral Program
  • 401K
  • Social events (summer picnic, holiday party, team lunches, etc.)
  • On-site Health & Wellness programs (fitness challenges, outdoor bootcamp, flu-shots, etc.)

We are the global leader in delivering timely, trusted, and actionable data through enhanced optical spectroscopy. Our solutions serve diverse applications, including natural gas leak detection, ethylene oxide emissions monitoring, semiconductor fabrication, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, atmospheric science, air quality, greenhouse gas measurements, food safety, hydrology, and ecology. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, our products are trusted in over 90 countries and supported by over 65 patents related to cavity ring-down spectroscopy (CRDS) technology.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

Skills & Experience Required - Desirable

  • Emergency-calling experience, such as E911/NG911 or international equivalents.
  • Number porting and provisioning at scale.
  • Experience running self-hosted real-time media infrastructure.
  • Multi-region or multi-carrier telecom exposure.
  • American Sign Language (ASL) knowledge is a strong plus.

  • Cloud infrastructure, containers, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD.

  • Real responsibility and direct work with the founders, without bureaucracy layers.
  • Flexible, results-focused remote work.

Overview

The Director of Security Operations leads the team responsible for detection and response across the enterprise. This role owns incident response, endpoint detection and response, email security, and SIEM and detection engineering, along with the monitoring and automation that support them. The director sets the strategy, staffing model, budget, and operating metrics for the function, and remains a working leader who takes incident commander duty, builds detections, and reviews analyst work alongside the team.

Responsibilities

  • Own the detection and response strategy and multi year roadmap, and align it to enterprise risk, the threat landscape, and business priorities
  • Lead, coach, and develop the security operations team, including hiring, scheduling, on call rotation, performance management, succession planning, and career development
  • Operate as a player coach, taking incident commander duty, writing detections, and performing hands on analysis alongside the team
  • Own the incident response program end to end, including the IR plan, severity model, escalation paths, tabletop exercises, evidence handling, and post incident review
  • Own endpoint detection and response strategy and operations, including policy tuning, coverage assurance, containment workflows, and threat hunting
  • Own email security, including phishing defense, mail authentication controls (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), user reporting workflows, and response to business email compromise attempts
  • Own SIEM and detection engineering, including log source onboarding, detection development and testing, alert quality, and false positive reduction
  • Build and maintain automation and runbooks that shorten response time and remove repetitive analyst work
  • Develop threat informed detection coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and validate it through purple team and control testing
  • Define and report operational metrics including mean time to detect, mean time to respond, alert volume and quality, coverage, and containment effectiveness
  • Coordinate with IT, engineering, legal, privacy, and communications during incidents, including support for regulatory and customer notification decisions
  • Own budget, staffing plan, and vendor strategy for the detection and response stack, including managed service providers, tooling selection, and licensing
  • Present program status, incident outcomes, and risk decisions to executive leadership, and support board, audit committee, and regulator reporting as requested
  • Support audit and compliance requirements with evidence for monitoring, response, and control operation

Qualifications

You design and implement modern lakehouse architectures on Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, build performant ELT/ETL pipelines, develop rich semantic models, and deliver complex Power BI reports, all while acting as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise clients. You thrive on translating ambiguous business requirements into scalable, well-documented technical solutions and are equally comfortable deep in Spark transformations or fine-tuning DAX formulas.

This role sits at the intersection of Collectiv’s Data Engineering and Senior Power BI Consultant practices and is designed for experienced professionals who refuse to choose a lane.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform & Lakehouse Engineering

  • Design and implement modern data platforms leveraging Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Factory) and Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, SQL Warehouses)
  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines using ELT/ETL best practices

jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role

Prepare bookkeeping, VAT returns and draft year end accounts for UK small business clients. You work in a pod of five led by a UK-based Senior Accounts Manager: two senior accountants, two accountants and a bookkeeper, serving around 300 UK small business clients from January and growing to around 500 through 2027. Until the manager starts in January, you work in one of our existing UK teams. A Senior Accountant reviews your work. Your work is on time and right the first time, and as you grow you take on year end accounts and corporation tax returns.

What you’ll do

  • Keep clients’ books up to date in Xero: bank reconciliations, sales and purchase ledgers, and month and year end adjustments.
  • Prepare VAT returns under Making Tax Digital for review.
  • Prepare draft year end accounts and, as you grow, corporation tax returns.
  • Check your own work before sending it for review, and act on corrections.
  • Chase clients early for missing records, and tell your Senior Accountant in good time when a deadline is at risk.
  • Keep client records and workflow data accurate.
  • Use the AI tools we are building into our products and workflow

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months

  1. Your bookkeeping and VAT returns are ready for review before their deadlines, with client delays chased early and recorded.
  2. Your work needs fewer review rounds, measured from when you start.
  3. By month 12, you prepare draft year end accounts and CT600s for review, not just bookkeeping and VAT.
  4. Workflow data for your clients is accurate and up to date.

Must-have experience

  1. A degree in commerce, accounting or finance (for example B.Com or BS Accountancy).
  2. At least 2 years in accounting, including at least 1 on UK clients: bookkeeping, bank reconciliations and VAT returns.
  3. Confident with Xero, QuickBooks or a similar cloud accounting package.
  4. Written English good enough to email UK clients directly.
  5. Based in India or the Philippines, with the right to work there.
  6. Able to work a shift that overlaps UK business hours.

Nice to have

  1. Has prepared draft UK year end accounts or CT600s

Must-have attributes

  1. Ownership: you finish what you start and fix problems rather than pass them on.
  2. Accuracy: you check your own numbers before anyone else has to.
  3. Takes feedback well: you act on corrections and don’t make the same mistake twice.
  4. Great communicator: clear in writing, with UK clients and with your reviewer.
  5. Process, data and compliance: you follow the process and keep records clean.
  6. One team: you help the rest of the pod, not just your own clients.
  7. Open to AI: comfortable with our tools taking on more of the routine work.

The interview process

  • TA Screening Call: A 30 minute call with our Talent Acquisition team
  • Live Technical Assessment: A ~60–90 minute live skills test to assess your hands-on bookkeeping capability.
  • Technical Interview : A 45 - 60 minute interview with the Accounting manager who will assess your technical skills.
  • Soft Skills Interview: A ~15-30 minute interview with the hiring team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.
  • Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.
