Purpose The Foreclosure Paralegal I, positioned within the Shared Services Department, holds the responsibility of the pre-foreclosure process across the various states in which the firm operates. This role entails a comprehensive review of pre-foreclosure documents, onboarding documents, as well as the utilization of MSP, AIQ, and other internal systems. It is imperative to ensure the legal validity and compliance of foreclosure actions, while also identifying and addressing any potential impediments that may arise during the pre-foreclosure process. The primary function of this position is to guarantee that all impediments are resolved in a timely manner pre-foreclosure. Effectively resolving these impediments may necessitate direct communication with attorneys, clients, or internal staff, ensuring that any legal or procedural barriers are addressed promptly and proficiently. This role is critical in maintaining the integrity of the foreclosure process and ensuring that all necessary steps are taken to facilitate a smooth transition through the pre-foreclosure phase. Specific Duties, Activities and Responsibilities

Document Review: Thoroughly review and confirm the loan origination documents to ensure accuracy and compliance. MSP (Mortgage Servicing System): Thoroughly review and confirm the data within the MSP system to ensure its accuracy and reliability. AIQ (Document Repository): Review, download, and confirm the loan documents. Quality Control Review: Review and complete a QC sheet per loan. Case Management: Maintaining and organizing case files, tracking deadlines, and ensuring all necessary documentation is submitted in a timely manner. The Paralegal I will ensure all deadlines are met, maintain workloads and process flow within the team, and distribute workloads as necessary. Communication and Collaboration: Responding to various emails, providing accurate and timely information, and maintaining client systems with current information regarding the onboarding process. Compliance Monitoring: Ensuring all activities adhere to internal policies, state laws, and federal regulations. Review of Financial Documents: Reviewing payoff statements, payoff histories, and previous monthly statements to ensure accuracy and completeness, addressing any discrepancies as needed. Issue Escalation and Support: Escalating any issues as needed and assisting with the training of new paralegal staff.

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree Preferred or Paralegal Certificate 5+ years of default law experience Strong knowledge of AP foreclosure process Understanding of judicial and non-judicial foreclosure processes Previous default industry experience Analytical document review capabilities Able to respond appropriately to constructive feedback from management. Self-starter with exceptional ability to identify and solve problems. Ability to recognize changing environments and think analytically.

General Competency Factors

Remote | United Kingdom | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $35–$150 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if your clinical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand complex medical information, evaluate healthcare scenarios, and deliver more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we’re connecting experienced healthcare professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We’re seeking physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants who can apply their clinical knowledge, independent judgment, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This isn’t a traditional healthcare position. You won’t be providing direct patient care or managing a caseload. Instead, you’ll assess complex medical scenarios, challenge inaccurate conclusions, identify gaps in reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your clinical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Healthcare SME, you’ll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized healthcare functions.

You’ll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established medical standards, clinical guidelines, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex healthcare challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

1. General Practice

Physicians experienced in primary care, diagnostic assessment, preventive medicine, management of common medical conditions, and evidence-based clinical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Physicians with expertise in comprehensive primary care, acute and chronic disease management, differential diagnosis, and patient care across different age groups.

3. Internal Medicine

Physicians experienced in adult medicine, complex medical conditions, diagnostic interpretation, multisystem disease management, and evidence-based treatment decisions.

4. Nurse Practitioners (NPs)

Advanced-practice nursing professionals with experience in clinical assessment, diagnostic reasoning, treatment planning, patient management, and healthcare quality standards within their professional scope.

5. Physician Assistants / Physician Associates (PAs)

Qualified clinical professionals with experience in patient assessment, diagnostic evaluation, treatment planning, and interpretation of medical findings within their professional scope.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated medical content: Assess responses for clinical accuracy, completeness, relevance, and consistency with accepted medical standards.
  • Analyze clinical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment recommendations are supported by appropriate clinical evidence.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate medical information, unsupported conclusions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns.
  • Validate medical information: Reference authoritative medical literature, established clinical guidelines, and evidence-based healthcare practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend clinically appropriate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply established evaluation guidelines, scoring criteria, and project-specific quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Clinical Expertise in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and professional judgment you've developed throughout your career to contribute to advanced AI technology without providing direct patient care.

Help Improve AI Accuracy and Reliability

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more accurate, clinically informed AI systems.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project-based assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads determined by project needs.

Explore the Future of Healthcare Technology

Gain experience contributing to advanced AI model evaluation while applying the professional expertise you already possess.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for strong clinical professionals who can recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify mistakes, and explain their assessments using sound professional judgment.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on clinical specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements. See rates per expertise:

General Practice Physician: $70–$125

Family Medicine Physician: $75–$135

Internal Medicine Physician: $85–$150

Nurse Practitioner: $40–$75

Physician Assistant: $35–$70

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Locations: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete a skills-based clinical evaluation assessment before selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Medical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced healthcare professional who enjoys analyzing complex medical information, applying evidence-based clinical judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We’re seeking experienced healthcare professionals who bring more than familiarity with clinical practice. You should be comfortable analyzing complex medical information, exercising independent clinical judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of three years of relevant professional clinical experience in an applicable specialty.
  • Recognized medical degree, advanced-practice qualification, or equivalent professional credential appropriate to the specialty and country.
  • Demonstrated experience applying clinical judgment, diagnostic reasoning, or evidence-based medical practices.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, clinical guidelines, and healthcare standards relevant to the candidate's specialization.
  • Ability to critically evaluate complex medical information and distinguish accurate clinical reasoning from unsupported conclusions.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written English communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain clinical findings and professional assessments.
  • Comfort using digital platforms, web-based applications, and online research tools.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet established quality standards.
  • Must be comfortable and understand this is a task-based role.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Current or previous professional licensure or registration relevant to the candidate's specialty.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical research, medical guidelines, or healthcare quality assessments.
  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare standards or clinical practices in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand.
  • Experience evaluating clinical documentation, medical literature, or complex healthcare cases.
  • Previous exposure to AI model evaluation, medical content review, clinical research, or healthcare technology.

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

You shape architecture and design, raise the bar on engineering quality, mentor other developers, and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate technical decisions into business value. You are equally comfortable guiding agentic-AI tools to deliver code, reviewing designs, and influencing how the platform evolves.

Location: This is a fully remote position located in Colombia.

Core Responsibilities

  • Create architecture, prototypes, and design proposals that deliver near-term business value while aligning with the future-state product and platform vision.
  • Influence technical direction through architecture reviews, RFCs, design discussions, and hands-on collaboration.
  • Partner with senior developers, architects, and tech leads to define and execute the product/platform architecture roadmap.
  • Balance delivery speed, quality, maintainability, and long-term platform health when making technical decisions.

  • Facilitate design discussions within and across teams.
  • Represent the team in technical discussions with Tech Leads, Operations, Product/UX, Security, Domain SMEs, and external stakeholders.

  • Experience with agentic-AI software development practices.
  • Experience designing and consuming well-designed HTTP APIs (REST, GraphQL, or similar).
  • Experience mentoring developers and influencing architectural decisions across teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. English high B2.

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

Loan Processing Manager

We receive a high volume of applications for our roles and we review every one carefully. To ensure we can give qualified candidates the attention they deserve, please only apply if you meet the following:

ELP is a rapidly growing outsourcing company with a strong presence across India and Australia. Established recently, we are now one of the fastest-growing firms in the sector.

This isn't a standard loan processing role. It's an operational leadership position for someone who is an exceptional loan processor.

You'll be stepping into a fast-paced, high-volume mortgage broking operation. Your job is to make sure everything runs smoothly, from the moment a deal comes in through to post-settlement maintenance.

You'll own the processing pipeline end-to-end, coordinate with support teams, and manage priorities across a busy and growing book. You won't be waiting for someone to tell you what to do next. You'll be the one deciding what needs to happen and ensuring it gets done. When something falls through the cracks, the expectation is that you've already caught it.

This role has a clear trajectory into formal team leadership, and we're looking for someone who sees that as a natural progression.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Running the full loan lifecycle, from initial document collection and pre-credit validation through to approval, settlement, and post-settlement maintenance
  • Preparing files for credit assessment, ensuring applications are complete, compliant, and lender-ready before submission
  • Managing deal approvals and leading client communication in the lead-up to settlement
  • Coordinating and assigning tasks across support teams, ensuring deadlines are met and nothing stalls
  • Proactively managing the broker's pipeline by prioritising deals, flagging risks early, and keeping the operation moving without needing to be directed
  • Handling lender liaison including pricing, credit queries, and settlement follow-ups
  • Stepping into an operational leadership capacity, with a clear path to formally owning that function

Requirements

What You Need to Bring

  • 5 to 10 years of hands-on loan processing experience within the Australian mortgage sector (this is a firm requirement)
  • Strong working proficiency in MyCRM, not surface-level familiarity, but genuine depth from regular use across a meaningful volume of deals
  • Experience with Apply Online and standard document management workflows
  • Sound knowledge of lender processes, credit policies, pricing structures, and settlement procedures
  • Familiarity with complex lending structures including trust, company, and SMSF scenarios
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, managing your own priorities, making decisions with confidence, and escalating only when it genuinely warrants it
  • The professional maturity to operate as a second-in-command, someone who is assured in their knowledge, can navigate difficult conversations, and takes ownership of outcomes
  • Experience coordinating with or managing support teams is highly regarded
  • A bachelor's degree

Please Note

This is a senior position that requires substantial, demonstrable experience in Australian mortgage processing. Candidates should be comfortable managing a high-volume pipeline independently and operating in a leadership-adjacent capacity from the outset. If you are earlier in your career and still building your foundational processing skills, we'd encourage you to look at our other opportunities as they come up.


Benefits

  • A genuine operational leadership pathway, built into the role from day one
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Access to industry-leading technology and tools
  • Ongoing training, learning, and professional development opportunities
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on work-life balance

jobs.title: Mapping and Analysis of Family Language in African Union Agreed Language and Hum
jobs.excerpt: 1.  BackgroundFòs Feminista.  Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people.
locationRestrictions: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
jobs.description:
1. Background

Fòs Feminista. Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. In 2026, Fòs Feminista completed a three-decade mapping of how "family" has been used in United Nations agreed language — reviewing 1,441 excerpts across 180 UN documents from 1994 to 2025. That mapping found that a substantial, underused body of UN agreed language already centers individual rights, gender equality, and diverse family forms, offering feminist advocates a propositional foundation to build on rather than only a defensive posture against anti-rights mobilization around "family."

This mapping has not yet been extended to the regional level. The African Union (AU) has its own distinct body of human rights instruments, agreed language, and political dynamics relevant to family, gender equality, and SRHR — including the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (the Maputo Protocol), one of the most progressive regional instruments globally on women’s rights, alongside AU mechanisms with an active record on ending child marriage and other harmful practices. At the same time, the AU is not insulated from anti-rights and anti-gender actors seeking to co-opt family language in multilateral outcomes.

As such, Fòs Feminista is seeking a consultant to conduct a systematic mapping and analysis of family-related language across African Union agreed language and human rights mechanisms to produce a rigorous, regionally grounded evidence base for use in African Union-level advocacy.

2. Purpose and Objectives

The purpose of this consultancy is to produce a systematic, evidence-based mapping of how "family" is defined, referenced, and used across African Union agreed language, in order to:

  • Identify where existing AU agreed language already reflects rights-based, gender-equal, and diverse understandings of family, distinguishing this from areas where family language is used restrictively or left unaddressed.
  • Produce a citable evidence base to inform feminist advocacy in African Union-level negotiations.
  • Identify patterns specific to the African regional context — including but not limited to child marriage, female genital mutilation and other harmful practices, inheritance and marital property rights, and care — grounded in the region’s own instruments and mechanisms.
  • Analyze whether language has changed over time, assessing whether it reflects advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and identifying the instruments, sessions or political context associated with such shifts.
  • Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for use in AU Summit declarations, Specialized Technical Committee outcomes, and other AU negotiating processes.

3. Scope of Work

The consultant will review family-related language across the following African Union instruments and mechanisms, at minimum:

  • The African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights (1981) and its jurisprudence.
  • The Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (Maputo Protocol, 2003), with particular attention to its marriage, family, and inheritance provisions.
  • The African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (1990).
  • Decisions, declarations, and resolutions of the AU Assembly of Heads of State and Government and the Executive Council.
  • Resolutions, General Comments, and Concluding Observations of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR).
  • General Comments and Concluding Observations of the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (ACERWC).
  • The Solemn Declaration on Gender Equality in Africa (2004) and subsequent AU gender policy instruments.
  • The Plan of Action on the Family in Africa (2004), adopted by the AU Assembly to mark the tenth anniversary of the International Year of the Family, and its 2010 mid-term review.
  • The Continental Policy Framework on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (2005, endorsed by the AU Assembly in January 2006) and the Maputo Plan of Action for its operationalization, including subsequent iterations (2007–2010 and the revised 2016–2030 Plan).
  • Outcome documents of relevant AU Specialized Technical Committees, including those on Health, Population and Drug Control; Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment; and Social Development, Labour and Employment.
  • Materials and declarations associated with the AU Campaign to End Child Marriage.
  • Agenda 2063 and associated flagship programmes, where family-related language appears.

The consultant, in consultation with Fòs Feminista, will propose a final document list and inclusion timeframe during the inception phase (see Section 5).

4. Specific Tasks

  • Review Fòs Feminista’s existing mapping and adapt methodology to the African Union context, in consultation with Fòs Feminista.
  • Define inclusion criteria, search terms, and a document timeframe appropriate to AU instruments, accounting for the African Union’s founding in 2002 and, where relevant, continuity with instruments of its predecessor, the Organisation of African Unity (OAU).
  • Systematically identify and retrieve relevant documents across the proposed mechanisms.
  • Extract all excerpts referencing family (and relevant equivalent terminology across the AU’s working languages, as feasible) into a structured, coded database.
  • Code excerpts thematically, drawing on categories established in the UN-level mapping, while remaining open to additional categories specific to the African regional context.
  • Assess the political and normative implications of each excerpt (positive, neutral, or negative) from a feminist, rights-based perspective, consistent with the coding logic used in the UN-level mapping.
  • Analyze how family-related language has evolved over the mapping period, identifying patterns of advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and the specific instruments, sessions, or political context associated with such shifts.
  • Draft a mapping report presenting findings, methodology, illustrative excerpts with full citations, and the trend analysis described above.
  • Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language formulations suited to AU negotiating contexts, grounded in specific cited instances of existing agreed language.
  • Provide updates and present final findings to Fòs Feminista and relevant partners.

5. Deliverables

  • Inception report, including proposed methodology, document list, inclusion criteria, and timeframe (due at the end of the inception phase).
  • A structured spreadsheet database of coded excerpts, consistent in format with Fòs Feminista’s existing UN-level mapping database (mechanism, document title, citation/symbol, date, page reference, excerpt text, and thematic codes).
  • A draft mapping and analysis report, for Fòs Feminista review and feedback. This should already include a set of concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for AU negotiating contexts, cross-referenced to specific cited excerpts.
  • A final mapping and analysis report incorporating feedback, including an executive summary suitable for external advocacy use.
  • A presentation of findings (virtual or in-person, to be agreed) to Fòs Feminista and partner organizations.

6. Indicative Timeline

The following is an indicative timeline of approximately 10 weeks; the final schedule will be confirmed with the selected consultant during contracting.

  • Weeks 1–2: Inception phase — methodology, document list, and workplan finalized.
  • Weeks 3–4: Document identification, retrieval, and excerpt extraction.
  • Weeks 4–6: Thematic coding and analysis.
  • Weeks 6–8: Draft mapping report submitted to and reviewed by Fòs Feminista.
  • Weeks 8–10: Revisions, finalization, and presentation of findings.

7. Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or higher) in law, human rights, gender studies, African studies, political science, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of African Union human rights mechanisms and regional legal and policy frameworks, including the Maputo Protocol.
  • Prior experience conducting legal, policy, or content analysis of agreed language, treaty text, or comparable normative documents.
  • Experience applying feminist or rights-based analytical frameworks to legal and policy texts.
  • Strong written communication skills in English; working proficiency in French, Arabic, and/or Portuguese is highly desirable given the African Union’s official languages.
  • Prior experience on gender equality, SRHR, or family law in the African regional context is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with qualitative data analysis tools (e.g., Dedoose, NVivo, or comparable software) is an asset.

8. Reporting and Supervision

The consultant will report to an assigned Senior Advocacy Officer and will maintain regular check-ins (proposed bi-weekly, to be confirmed) throughout the assignment to review progress against the agreed workplan.

9. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit the following by October 16, 2026:

  • A current CV or resume.
  • A cover letter outlining relevant experience and interest in the assignment.
  • A brief proposed methodology and workplan (no more than 3 pages), including any suggested adaptations to the approach described above.
  • A financial proposal, inclusive of a proposed daily or total consultancy rate.
  • A relevant writing sample (e.g., a legal or policy analysis, research report, or comparable output).

10. Budget

The total consultancy fee for this assignment is USD 6,000–7,000, inclusive of all costs. Candidates should submit a proposed budget within this range as part of their application; Fòs Feminista will confirm the final consultancy fee during contracting.

Bilingual Virtual Assistant (English/Spanish)
Receptionist

Remote | Part-Time | 40 Hours/Week | $6.5/hour with 6 mos perf review

Role Summary

We are hiring a Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant to support an Internal Medicine practice. This role requires someone with strong English and Spanish communication skills, especially over the phone, since a large part of the work involves speaking directly with patients, coordinating appointments, handling follow-ups, and keeping communication clear and professional.

This is a patient-facing support role that directly affects clinic flow, patient experience, and day-to-day operational efficiency. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, confident on calls, and able to manage scheduling, insurance-related tasks, and administrative follow-through with accuracy.

Top Requirements

  • Strong bilingual communication skills in both English and Spanish

  • Confident and professional on phone calls

  • Strong patient coordination and scheduling ability

  • High attention to detail and reliable follow-through

Key Responsibilities

1) Phone Calls and Patient Communication

  • Handle a high volume of inbound and outbound phone calls with patients, pharmacies, payer offices, and other healthcare contacts

  • Communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish

  • Provide appointment reminders, follow-up calls, rescheduling support, and general patient assistance

  • Answer routine patient questions and escalate concerns appropriately

  • Maintain a calm, patient-friendly tone, especially when dealing with elderly patients or complex situations

2) Appointment Scheduling and Patient Coordination

  • Manage new and existing patient scheduling through phone, email, and text

  • Maintain provider calendars accurately and help prevent gaps, overlaps, or scheduling errors

  • Confirm appointments and manage cancellations, reschedules, and waitlist coordination

  • Conduct pre-visit outreach and communicate next steps clearly to patients

  • Ensure accurate patient demographics, appointment notes, and call outcomes are documented in the system

3) Insurance Verification and Benefits

  • Verify patient eligibility and benefits before appointments

  • Confirm copays, deductibles, covered services, and authorization requirements

  • Identify insurance issues early and communicate them clearly to patients and internal staff

  • Document verification results accurately in the EMR and any internal trackers

  • Escalate unresolved payer issues and follow through until completed

4) Referral and Prior Authorization Support

  • Process referral-related tasks and ensure required documents are complete

  • Initiate and follow up on prior authorization requests as needed

  • Track pending items, approvals, denials, and required follow-up actions

  • Coordinate with payer offices, provider offices, and internal team members to avoid delays

5) Administrative Support and Documentation

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and consistent documentation

  • Support daily administrative workflows such as inbox management, task queues, forms, uploads, and follow-up tracking

  • Handle patient information in a HIPAA-compliant manner

  • Provide status updates proactively and complete assigned tasks with minimal follow-up

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Spanish

  • Previous experience handling phone calls in a patient-facing, customer-facing, or healthcare support role

  • Strong confidence speaking with patients over the phone, including appointment coordination and follow-up calls

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks accurately

  • Able to work independently and communicate updates clearly

  • Reliable computer setup, headset, and stable internet connection for remote work

  • HIPAA knowledge or experience with HIPAA-compliant workflows

Nice to Have

  • Clinical or healthcare background

  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems

  • Experience supporting internal medicine, primary care, or similar outpatient practices

jobs.excerpt: About RemotePass RemotePass is a global employment, payroll, and spend platform that helps companies hire, pay, and support talent in 150+ countries.
jobs.description:
About RemotePass
RemotePass is a global employment, payroll, and spend platform that helps companies hire, pay, and support talent in 150+ countries. Recognised as one of G2’s Top 100 Fastest Growing Software Products, we’re on a mission to break down geographical barriers and create a world where exceptional talent can thrive anywhere.

From hiring and onboarding to payroll, compliance, and financial services, we give organisations everything they need to build high-performing global teams, and give workers worldwide access to opportunities that were once out of reach.

We’re backed by world-class investors including EBRD Venture Capital, 500 Global, Endeavor Catalyst, BECO Capital, Wamda Capital, 212 VC, Oraseya Capital, Khwarizmi Ventures, and Access Bridge Ventures.

About the Role
Employer of Record is the core of our business. We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our EOR product end to end and make it the best in the market. You’ll sit in the Product & Operations team with a direct line to the CEO.

This role is about depth and craft, not a big title. You’ll own the full employee lifecycle, from quotes and onboarding to compliance, benefits, and offboarding, along with the internal tooling and AI agents that run behind it.

We’re also moving our product organisation from delivery-led to discovery-led, and EOR leads that shift. The scope is real from day one.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full EOR lifecycle. Quotes, onboarding, contracts, country compliance, benefits, changes during employment, and offboarding. Know where it breaks today, and fix it.
  • Set the roadmap. Decide what gets built and what doesn’t, and defend those calls.
  • Lead discovery. Spend real time with customers, prospects, employees, and our operations teams, and set the standard for discovery-led product at RemotePass.
  • Turn noise into direction. Distil CS escalations, ops pain, sales objections, prospect calls, and support tickets into a clear, prioritised view of what matters. Make your reasoning visible so the business knows where it stands.
  • Go deep on countries. EOR runs on a mix of our own entities and in-country partners, each with its own rules. Turn employment law, compliance requirements, and country-specific flows into product that works at scale.
  • Build the machinery behind EOR. Own the internal platforms and AI agents behind EOR operations, including onboarding and contract automation, compliance checks, ops workflows, and support tooling, so operations can scale without adding headcount.
  • Drive execution across time zones. Connect product, engineering, operations, and go-to-market, and work closely with Payroll where EOR and payroll meet. Drive outcomes without waiting for a room to walk into.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in product, with hands-on ownership of EOR, HR tech, or complex B2B workflow products such as onboarding, compliance, or operations platforms.
  • A track record of shipping and scaling a product built on real operational complexity, ideally through a growth phase.
  • Strong discovery skills: you form your own view from customers and data.
  • Hands-on with AI, both as a product surface and as a working tool.
  • Comfortable going deep into employment law, compliance requirements, and country-specific processes.
  • Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams across time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience at an EOR, PEO, or global payroll provider.
  • Experience building internal tooling or automation for operations teams.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If

  • You’d rather form your own view than work from a backlog handed to you.
  • You like making calls in a fast, direct, low-process environment.
  • You care as much about the machinery behind the product as the customer-facing surface.

Benefits

Why Join RemotePass?

  • Own our core product line, end to end.
  • Work directly with the CEO and have a real voice in shaping the product organisation.
  • Equity grant on top of competitive compensation.
  • Profitable, and still scaling fast. We reached profitability in 2025 and just raised a $17.4M Series B led by EBRD, with 500 Global joining. You get the pace of a scale-up with the stability of a business that works.
  • Real global scale. We support 35,000+ workers in 150+ countries and have processed over $800M in cross-border payroll for companies like Logitech, Tata Group, and Careem.
  • Big bets ahead. We’re expanding across Europe and the US, building financial products for distributed teams, and investing heavily in AI. There’s a lot to build, and room to grow with it.
  • Remote-first, for real. We don’t just sell remote work, we live it. Work from anywhere.
  • Inclusion matters. We value different perspectives and empower everyone to bring their authentic self to work.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

jobs.description:
Compensation Grade:‏‏‎ ‎35

Job Description

At SAIF, actuaries are more than our numbers people.

Their work is the thread that binds together our enterprise-wide projects, strategies, and mission. Heavily relied-upon for their creativity and expertise, this team has the autonomy to work directly with business partners to help establish rates, maintain adequate reserves, produce forecasts, and ensure long term stability.

We are recruiting for an associate actuary. In this role, you'll play a vital role in SAIF's mission to serve Oregon's workers and employers by making workers' compensation coverage widely available and affordable, and by providing extraordinary service. We're looking for a highly motivated self-starter with actuarial experience and an ACAS credential, but just as importantly, we're seeking a collaborative teammate, strategic communicator, seeker of challenges, and champion of analytics.

Your work won't be done in isolation. You will work closely with a seasoned team of actuaries and analysts and collaborate regularly with partners across the company. You will work directly with senior executives and influence critical work for our customers, board members, regulators, and other stakeholders. The impact and visibility of your work could reach the four corners of the state and beyond.

Note: This position is open to remote candidates; however, due to some state restrictions there are some locations that SAIF is not able to hire remote candidates. Remote workers may be required to travel to SAIF's offices in Salem, Oregon, around two times annually.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively assist in the identification of and solutions for the most complex problems that impact the management and direction of the business by participating and leading actuarial work in the following areas:
  • Development of reasonable loss and loss adjustment expense reserves.
  • Preparation of various inputs to the annual and quarter financial statements and related filings and participation in regulatory audits.
  • Development and filing of sound rate recommendations, maintenance of SAIF’s pricing and rate adequacy monitoring tools, conducting trend and market analysis research, and providing support and consult to Underwriting on individual account pricing and the development of technical underwriting guidelines.
  • Updates to and maintenance of SAIF’s financial forecasts, dividend models, capital models, and surplus analyses. Completion of supporting documentation and communication including the Own Risk Solvency Assessment (ORSA).
  • Support for SAIF’s reinsurance program and monitoring of reinsurance coverage including claim reporting, commutations, and financial reporting.
  • NCCI financial data call process, including calculating any data anomalies and communicating with NCCI to explain SAIF’s data and answer questions.
  • Conduct and guide research and analysis to inform strategic priorities. Assist management as a strategic business partner by advising on methods and applications for actuarial analysis.
  • Design and execute data analysis, and provide support to various external and internal customers, including auditors, reinsurers, and reinsurance brokers, SAIF’s appointed actuary and staff, and SAIF’s executive leadership team and board of directors.
  • Monitor external information sources for developments that may affect SAIF’s operations and strategies, including such areas as regional business conditions, competitors, demographics, legal or regulatory changes, and medical costs, utilization, treatment patterns and practices, medical outcomes, and healthcare policy. Assess potential impacts and assist with the preparation of recommendations to inform management response.
  • Stay abreast of trends and innovations in the casualty actuarial profession related to pricing, reserving, workers’ compensation, and related areas.
  • Work closely with the Data & Analytics function to monitor and inform data integrity and incorporate the use of analytics to inform decisions.
  • Coach other staff in the use and interpretation of standard actuarial procedures. Provide peer review of actuarial work performed by others.
  • Assist in the training and/or professional development of other staff by mentoring or coaching in specific areas and identifying and developing training needs. Provide feedback to division leadership to support the performance management processes.
  • Explore diverse perspectives and consistently behave sensitively toward differences in cultural norms, expectations, and ways of communicating. Work effectively with others who have different perspectives, backgrounds, and/or work styles.

The following qualifications are recommended:

  • Five or more years of actuarial experience, including at least one year of workers’ compensation experience.
  • A bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, economics, finance, or a related field and membership in the Casualty Actuarial Society.
  • Continued progress towards or maintenance of membership in the Casualty Actuarial Society in accordance with the guidelines established by SAIF’s Actuarial Study and Professionalism Program.
  • Other combinations of skills and experience may be considered.

Next step

To receive consideration, please submit your resume with a cover letter by the close of this recruitment. We want your submission to count, so be sure it’s complete.

This recruitment will close on Thursday, November 5, 2026.

If a sufficient number of qualified applications are received this recruitment may close early.

Compensation & Benefits

Typical hiring range:‏‏‎ ‎$133,182‏‏‎ ‎-‏‏‎ ‎$156,685.‏‏‎ ‎The pay range for this position is annually based on a full-time schedule. Actual compensation will be determined using factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications & education.

SAIF provides a wide range of benefits to employees who work at least 20 hours per week, including health care, retirement savings plans, paid time off, and more. For additional information about SAIF's total rewards, visit our website at: Total rewards (saif.com)

*Note that eligibility and cost of benefits can vary depending on the number of regularly scheduled hours, and job status such as regular full-time, regular part-time, seasonal, or temporary employment.

Full salary range:‏‏‎‏‏‎ ‎$117,515‏‏‎ ‎-‏‏‎ ‎$195,855

Veterans

We provide preference to qualifying and disabled veterans. For more information please visit saif.com/veterans.

About us

Since 1914, SAIF has been taking care of injured workers, helping people get back to work, and keeping rates low by focusing on workplace safety. Together with our partners, we strive to make Oregon the safest and healthiest place to work.

For questions related to this job, please reach out to us at .

Are you an energetic product leader who thrives at the intersection of client strategy, cloud-native engineering, and cutting-edge AI? RevStar is an AI-first innovation shop and AWS Advanced Tier Partner building transformative digital products for enterprise clients. We are seeking a client-facing Product Manager / Sr. Product Manager to own product delivery from discovery to launch. In this role, you will lead cross-functional engineering teams, run discovery workshops, leverage AI tools for rapid prototyping, and partner directly with client executives to translate complex business needs into high-impact software.   • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.

Your day-to-day contributions are organized into four strategic areas:

  • Facilitate client discovery sessions (onsite and virtual) to define product roadmaps, MVP boundaries, and success metrics.
  • Translate client vision into actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), prioritized feature backlogs, and detailed user stories.
  • Conduct client product demos and manage stakeholder expectations across project analysis, design, and execution phases.

2. Delivery & Team Enablement

  • Lead cross-functional pods of engineers, architects, and designers using Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Establish a "shared brain" across teams to unblock engineering, eliminate delivery friction, and empower autonomous decision-making.
  • Drive project governance inside Azure DevOps, maintaining clean backlogs, accurate tracking, and high delivery velocity.

3. AI Prototyping & Modern Workflows

  • Utilize generative AI tools and modern rapid-prototyping platforms (like v0) to generate wireframes and validate user experiences fast.
  • Continuously explore and implement emerging AI workflows to accelerate client communication, requirements gathering, and design iterations.

4. Account Leadership & Growth

  • Serve as the primary client point-of-contact, building trust through proactive communication, delivery updates, and value creation.
  • Guide clients through complex technical tradeoffs, scope management, and risk mitigation.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3+ years of full-lifecycle Product Management experience within a client-facing, consultancy, or agency environment.
  • Product Mastery: Strong understanding of MVP prioritization frameworks, user story mapping, PRD development, and Agile/Scrum delivery.

  • Peer Mentorship & Coaching – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities – Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
  • Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities – Build relationships and give back to the community.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). In this role, you will:
