jobs.excerpt: Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO) About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.
jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, analytical, and detail-oriented professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Amazon Brand Manager opening.

As the Amazon Brand Manager, you will take full ownership of Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US, while expanding the company's presence across additional Amazon marketplaces, including Mexico, Brazil, and other markets, as well as key dropship retail partners. You will have full P&L accountability across all managed marketplaces and be responsible for driving revenue growth in alignment with company targets.

Your responsibilities will include ensuring accurate pricing and image mapping across listings, implementing evergreen listing strategies to improve conversion, maintaining account health, and monitoring competitors across all managed marketplaces. You will work closely with the in-house PPC manager, supply chain, and creative teams to support marketplace performance and expansion.

This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, organization, and a clear sense of ownership. You will be expected to take accountability for outcomes, prioritize effectively, and identify innovative approaches to marketplace challenges.

About the Company

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities

Own International Marketplace Operations

  • Take full operational ownership of Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US within the first 90 days, ensuring zero disruption to ongoing sales.
  • Manage marketplace operations and ensure accurate pricing and image mapping across all managed channels.
  • Maintain strong account health and address issues that could disrupt marketplace operations or ongoing sales.
  • Ensure listings and marketplace operations are maintained consistently across all managed channels.

Drive Marketplace Revenue and P&L Performance

  • Own full P&L performance across all managed primary and secondary marketplaces, aligning results with company targets.
  • Monitor marketplace performance and use data to identify opportunities for revenue growth and improved financial results.
  • Evaluate performance across managed channels and identify opportunities to improve results.
  • Support data-driven decision-making to ensure marketplace growth remains aligned with company objectives.

Optimize Listings and Improve Conversion

  • Implement evergreen listing strategies to improve conversion across Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart US within the first six months.
  • Ensure accurate product listings, pricing, and image mapping across managed marketplaces.
  • Identify opportunities to improve listing performance and conversion.
  • Work closely with the creative team to support listing optimization and ensure accurate product imagery.
  • Collaborate with the in-house PPC manager to support marketplace performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Expand Secondary Marketplaces and Dropship Partnerships

  • Grow the company's presence across additional Amazon marketplaces, including Mexico, Brazil, and other relevant markets.
  • Contribute to the growth of secondary marketplaces and key dropship retail partners throughout the first year.
  • Support the development and expansion of retail partnerships, including HD Supply, Vitality Medical, Medical Shop, Sleepplay, and other relevant partners.
  • Ensure accurate pricing and image mapping across retail partner channels.
  • Identify opportunities to expand marketplace and retail partner presence in alignment with company growth targets.

Maintain Competitive Intelligence and Account Health

  • Maintain an ongoing competitive intelligence process across all managed marketplaces.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market developments to identify opportunities and potential risks.
  • Maintain vigilant account health across managed channels and address issues that could affect ongoing sales.
  • Use marketplace insights to inform decisions and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Build Cross-Functional Relationships

  • Establish effective working relationships with the in-house PPC manager, supply chain, and creative teams within the first six months.
  • Coordinate marketplace activities with relevant teams to support listing performance and channel growth.
  • Communicate marketplace performance, opportunities, and issues clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Work collaboratively across functions to support the company's international expansion and marketplace objectives.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.
  • Experience with Walmart Marketplace is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to process data and draw meaningful conclusions.
  • Ability to take ownership of marketplace operations and financial performance.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly regarding listing accuracy, pricing, and image mapping.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to prioritize work efficiently.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems proactively, and develop innovative approaches to challenges.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with PPC, supply chain, and creative teams.

Core Competencies & Values

  • Attention to Detail: Does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Consistency: Demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.

jobs.title: Head of Product Launch Program Management (Rare Disease)
jobs.excerpt: Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders.
jobs.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare and difficult-to-treat diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity.

Rezolute’s lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage clinical development for the treatment of hypoglycemia due to congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI). As Rezolute expands its medical and scientific focus into tumor-related hyperinsulinism (tumor HI), most commonly related to pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (insulinomas) or paraneoplastic hypoglycemia (NICTH), the company is committed to advancing novel therapeutic strategies that address this rare and complex form of hypoglycemia associated with insulin-secreting tumors and related neuro-oncology disorders.

More information can be found at rezolutebio.com

The Director, Product Launch Program Management is a member of the Program Management Office (PMO), reporting to the Senior Vice President, Operations, and directly supporting the Commercial Product Launch Lead (Head of Marketing). The PLPM owns the integrated launch plan by indication and by market across the U.S. and priority ex-U.S. countries, and facilitates, consolidates, organizes, documents, and measures that plan so the Product Launch Lead and functional leaders can make decisions and deliver against it. The role supports establishment of the launch strategy with specific responsibility to make it complete, current, and executable. Working within the company’s governance model, the role works daily within the PMO enabling coordination, dependency determination, awareness and cross functional planning with program managers supporting the Development and Technical Operations teams.

Success requires a working understanding of each contributing function’s scope of work, with emphasis on critical coordination of Commercial, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Supply and Quality, and the ability to engage the working team credibly on scope, tasks, dependencies, risks, and outcomes. As Rezolute advances concurrent launches across multiple indications in the U.S. and ex-U.S., this role may expand to build and manage a team of Launch Program Managers.

This can be a remote role based in the United States, with travel as necessary to Rezolute headquarters in Redwood City, CA, and to launch team, partner, and ex-U.S. working sessions.

Key Responsibilities

    Launch Plan Ownership

    • Own a single, authoritative integrated launch plan(ILP) by indication and by market, covering scope, tasks, owners, timelines, critical path, and cross-functional dependencies, including shared versus indication-specific workstreams.

    • Consolidate inputs from Commercial, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Clinical, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Legal, and reconcile conflicts in timing, assumptions, and ownership.

    • Manage plan changes through PMO governance, re-baselining when scope, indication sequencing, or timing changes and communicating impacts to the team.

    Facilitation & Day-to-Day Coordination

    • Facilitate launch team and working team meetings on behalf of the Head of Operations and/or Product Launch Lead, driving agendas and pre-reads to document decisions, actions, and ownership.

    • Worksdaily with amongst the launch working team to communicate, coordinate, influence, problem solve and drive issue resolution; escalate critical-path issues, dependencies and risks in a timely way, with options.

    • Coordinate Launch Readiness Reviews (LRR) and day-of-approval and launch-window execution plans, and capture lessons learned for subsequentindication and country launches.

    • Assemble, facilitate, coordinate, manage and document cross functional sub teams driving alignment.

    • Support Head of Operations, Executive Leadershipand enterprise functions including IS&T.

    Documentation, Measurement & Reporting

    • Maintain the launch plan record set, including RACI, decision log, risk and issue register, and change log, so the current state of each launch is always clear.

    • Develop and maintain readiness criteria, dashboards, and KPIs by indication and market; track variance to baseline; and report status to the Product Launch Lead, the Head of Operations, the enterprise PMO, and executive and Board forums.

    U.S. & Ex-U.S. Market Entry

    • Maintain country-level plans for priority ex-U.S. markets with regional leads, distributors, and partners, tracking regulatory, pricing and reimbursement (HTA), supply, and market-entry milestones.

    • Work with the Development team Program Manager to integrate Expanded Access Program (EAP) and ex-U.S. Named Patient Program (NPP) activities, enabling to internal and external coordination toward NPP sales, and the transition of clinical trial, open-label extension, EAP, and NPP patients to commercial supply in each market.

    Team Leadership (as the launch portfolio expands)

    • Build, lead, and develop a team of Launch Program Managers supporting concurrent U.S. and ex-U.S. launches, and establish common PMO standards, tools, and templates.

Qualifications

    Education

    • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS, PharmD, or PhD) preferred.

    Experience

    • 7+ years in a similar role with broad program management responsibility for a biotech therapeutic; rare disease strongly preferred.

    • Hands-on ownership of an integrated launch plan (ILP)through at least one product launch, from approximately 24 months before approval through post-launch; concurrent, multi-indication, first-in-company, or biologic launch experience preferred.

    • Familiarity with ex-U.S. Named Patient Program sales, Expanded Access Programs, and ex-U.S. distribution or partnered market entry (e.g., distributor or licensing-partner models).

    • Experience managing or mentoring program managers preferred.

    • Proficiency with Smartsheet, MS Project, or equivalent tools; PMP or related certification a plus.

    Functional Knowledge

    Working knowledge of the launch scope of work for:

    • Commercial:marketing, market access, pricing, trade and distribution, patient services, data warehousing and commercial operations, and field readiness

    • Medical Affairs: medical strategy, scientific communications, medical information, field medical, and evidence generation

    • Supply and Quality: commercial supply readiness, demand and supply planning, packaging and labeling, and distribution; compliance, inspection readiness, QMS and Quality integration across all GxP functions, plans and activity

    • Regulatory: rare-disease pathways (e.g., Orphan Drug Designation, Breakthrough Therapy, Priority Review, PRIME, conditional approval) and how regulatory milestones drive launch timing

    Competencies

    The successful candidate will demonstrate:

    • Plan ownership: Organized and disciplined; keeps the plan, records, and status accurate and current.

    • Functional credibility: Engages function leads and task owners on scope, tasks, dependencies, risks, and outcomes based on experience and specific understanding of their work.

    • Communication and influence: Clear in writing and in the room, from the working team to executive and Board audiences; influences without authority as a service-oriented partner to the Product Launch Lead and functional leaders.

    • Resolution and escalation: Resolves issues and solves problems at the working level; escalates early, with facts and options.

    • Remote effectiveness: Self-directed across time zones; willing and able to travel as necessary, including internationally.

    • Direct multi-tasked execution and ownership: comfort working within a fast paced, agile, hands on environment

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for the Director level, Product Launch Program Management role could range from $240,000 to $290,000 and will depend in part on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience, and geographical location of the selected candidate.

Qualifying employees are eligible to participate in benefit programs such as:

  • Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision)

  • Disability, Life & Long-Term Care Insurance

  • Holiday Pay

  • Tracking Free Vacation Program

  • 401(k) Plan Match

  • Educational Assistance Benefit

  • Fitness Center Reimbursement

jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role

Prepare and review UK year end accounts, corporation tax returns and VAT returns for UK small business clients. You work in a pod of five led by a UK-based Senior Accounts Manager: two senior accountants, two accountants and a bookkeeper, serving around 300 UK small business clients from January and growing to around 500 through 2027. Until the manager starts in January, you work in one of our existing UK teams. You review the accountants’ and bookkeeper’s work so it reaches the manager right the first time, and you are the person they come to with questions.

What you’ll do

  • Prepare year end accounts (FRS 102 and 105), corporation tax computations and CT600s, and VAT returns under Making Tax Digital.
  • Review the work of the accountants and bookkeeper in your pod, explain your corrections, and help them get it right the first time.
  • Chase clients early for missing records, and tell your manager in good time when a deadline is at risk.
  • Email UK clients directly to ask for information or explain what you need.
  • Keep client records and workflow data accurate, so anyone can see where each client stands.
  • Use the AI tools we are building into our products and workflows, and help shape them.

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months:

  1. No statutory deadline missed because of us on the clients you work on.
  2. Work you send to the Senior Accounts Manager needs fewer review rounds, measured from when you start.
  3. Work from the accountants and bookkeeper you review needs fewer review rounds over time.
  4. Workflow data for your clients is accurate and up to date.

Must-have experience

  1. At least part-qualified: CA or CA Intermediate (India), CPA (Philippines), or ACCA (member, or all Applied Skills papers passed).
  2. At least 4 years in accounting, including at least 2 preparing UK year end accounts, CT600s and VAT returns for small businesses, in a UK practice or an outsourcing firm.
  3. At least 1 year reviewing other accountants’ or bookkeepers’ work.
  4. Confident with Xero, QuickBooks or a similar cloud accounting package.
  5. Written English good enough to email UK clients directly.
  6. Based in India or the Philippines, with the right to work there.
  7. Able to work a shift that overlaps UK business hours.

Must-have attributes

  1. Ownership: the clients you work on are yours, and you fix problems rather than pass them on.
  2. Knowledgeable: you give the accountants and bookkeeper a definite answer.
  3. Coaching: when you correct someone’s work, you explain why, so the mistake doesn’t come back.
  4. Great communicator: clear in writing, with UK clients and with a manager in another country.
  5. Process, data and compliance: you follow the process, keep records clean and never cut corners.
  6. One team: you help the rest of the pod succeed, not just your own clients.
  7. Open to AI: the pod can grow to 500 clients only because our tools take on more of the routine work.

The interview process

  • TA Screening Call: A 30 minute call with our Talent Acquisition team
  • Live Technical Assessment: A ~60–90 minute live skills test to assess your hands-on bookkeeping capability.
  • Technical Interview : A 45 - 60 minute interview with the Accounting manager who will assess your technical skills.
  • Soft Skills Interview: A ~15-30 minute interview with the hiring team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.
  • Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About us

Since 2000, EUPD Group has established itself as a trusted, independent voice in the renewable energy industry. Our work centers on primary data-driven market research, quality certification, and strategic consulting in the areas of photovoltaics, energy storage, and the energy transition. Internationally positioned, we support organizations - from ambitious start-ups to global corporations - in navigating change with clarity, backed by more than 25 years of market experience.

As China's dual-carbon agenda reshapes the domestic industry and Chinese renewable energy companies go global at speed, we are establishing our own presence here - not a nameplate office, but a local team with a real mandate, built together with the colleague who joins us now.

About the Role

We are looking for a China Market Intelligence & Commercial Lead to drive business development in China, build senior industry relationships, and provide the European headquarters with a clear understanding of the Chinese market.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone who combines industry knowledge, commercial capability, strong relationships and market intelligence.

Key Responsibilities
  • Drive the commercial development and sales of our market intelligence, research and consulting solutions in China.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with leading companies and senior decision-makers across the PV and energy storage value chain, including modules, batteries, inverters, PCS and ESS.
  • Monitor Chinese market developments, customer needs, competitive dynamics and emerging trends to identify new business opportunities.
  • Translate customer and market insights into recommendations for new research products, consulting solutions and commercial opportunities.
  • Represent the company at major solar PV, energy storage and renewable energy conferences and industry events in China and internationally.
  • Work closely with the European headquarters and global team, connecting Chinese market insights with international market developments.

Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in solar PV, energy storage, renewable energy, market intelligence, consulting, strategy or a related industry.
  • Strong understanding of the Chinese PV and energy storage value chain and key market players.
  • Established relationships and network within the Chinese renewable energy industry; access to senior decision-makers is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in B2B business development, consulting, research or data-driven solution sales.
  • Strong commercial mindset, analytical ability and communication skills.
  • Active, hands-on use of AI and automation tools in daily work, paired with a genuine interest in continuously improving and streamlining processes.
  • Fluent Mandarin and excellent professional English.
  • Comfortable working in an international, English-speaking environment.
  • Willingness to travel frequently within China and internationally.
  • Experience in industry conferences, panels, speaking engagements or media is a strong plus.

What we offer
  • Exciting, data-driven projects in the renewable energy, storage, and solar sector - with direct relevance to fast-moving markets and to the overseas strategies of leading Chinese manufacturers.
  • Access to our primary research on European and global installers, channels, and end customers - insight most of the market never sees.
  • A direct line to our German headquarters: flat structures, no reporting layers, and real influence on how we build up China.
  • High degree of autonomy and freedom in organizing your own work and schedule - we assess outcomes, not attendance.
  • Fair, project- and outcome-based fee structure, with clear terms agreed in advance.
  • Potential for further projects/engagements based on successful collaboration, and a hand in growing the China business itself.
  • Professional exchange on current developments in solar, storage, and renewables with analysts who track these markets year-round.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can: Understand the industry / Understand the customer / Leverage the network / Identify opportunities / Develop business / Shape products.

The successful candidate will serve as an important bridge between China, our European headquarters and the global renewable energy industry.

This is a remote position.

Job title : Manager — SAP Materials Management (MM) , SAP S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement SAP Ariba
Role Description : Work as part of the SAP MM and Ariba team on large S/4HANA transformation programmes — contributing to solution design, delivering assigned areas independently and to a high standard, and guiding less experienced colleagues along the way.
PURPOSE Translate client procurement and inventory processes into robust, upgrade-safe SAP configuration, and deliver assigned areas on time and to quality as part of the wider project team.
SCOPE Contributes across the full delivery lifecycle of the MM / Sourcing & Procurement workstream — design, build, test, data
migration, cutover and hypercare — including Ariba integration.
REPORTS TO Workstream Lead / Senior Manager, Enterprise Applications (SAP).
WORKING STYLE A hands-on member of the delivery team. Completes assigned areas independently with minimal supervision, and guides
less experienced colleagues on MM and Ariba topics. No direct line-management responsibility.
KEY INTERFACES Client procurement and supply chain process owners, IT leads and programme management; internal SD, FI/CO, PP,
technical and change management workstreams.
MEASURES OF SUCCESS Assigned deliverables completed to plan and to quality; design decisions accepted first time; low post-go-live defect
volume; positive client and team feedback; effective knowledge sharing with colleagues.
Key Responsibilities :
SOLUTION DESIGN & DELIVERY
Participate in requirement-gathering and fit-gap workshops with client business and IT stakeholders; translate business processes into SAP MM solution design.
Deliver functional design and configuration across procure-to-pay, inventory management, valuation and material master governance.
Author and review functional specifications for RICEFW objects; guide technical teams through build and unit testing.
Drive standard-versus-custom design decisions, ensuring solutions are scalable, upgrade-safe and aligned to SAP leading practices.
Prepare test scenarios and support SIT, UAT and regression testing, including defect triage and resolution.
Plan and execute MM data migration — material master, business partner, info records, source lists, open POs and stock balances — including mock loads and
reconciliation.
Configure and support the integration between SAP Ariba and S/4HANA, including master data replication, transaction flow and error-handling processes.
Contribute to cutover planning and provide go-live and hypercare support for the MM and Ariba workstreams.
CLIENT & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
Work directly with client process owners and IT leads on MM and Ariba matters within your area.
Report progress, flag risks, issues and dependencies early, and help resolve them with the wider team.
Collaborate closely with the SD, FI/CO, PP, QM, PM and Ariba teams to align cross-functional designs.
Support change management and end-user enablement, including review of training material and process documentation.
WAYS OF WORKING & TEAM GUIDANCE
Work independently on assigned areas, taking decisions within your remit without day-to-day supervision.
Guide and support less experienced colleagues — clarifying requirements, reviewing their deliverables and helping unblock issues.
Provide effort estimates for your area and report status accurately against the project plan.
Identify scope changes early, raise change requests and keep timesheets and delivery tracking up to date.
Mentor junior colleagues informally, sharing MM and Ariba knowledge and supporting their technical development.
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & PRACTICE GROWTH
Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, effort estimation and client orals.
Identify opportunities to extend scope within existing accounts.
Develop accelerators, reusable assets and points of view that strengthen the practice's go-to-market position.
Stay current with the SAP roadmap, including S/4HANA innovations and cloud procurement solutions.
CORE SAP MM
Procurement: purchase requisitions, RFQ, purchase orders, contracts, scheduling agreements, source determination and release strategies.
Inventory management: goods movements, physical inventory, special stocks and stock transport orders (intra- and inter-company).
Logistics invoice verification: three-way match, GR/IR, ERS, tolerance keys and blocking logic.
Master data: material master, vendor/business partner, purchasing info records, source lists and quota arrangements, including governance and data quality
design.
Special processes: subcontracting, consignment, pipeline, third-party and returns procurement.
Configuration depth: pricing procedures and condition technique, tax and account determination (OBYC), split valuation, batch management and MRP
parameters.
Integration: strong command of MM–FI and MM–SD integration, including inventory valuation and its accounting impact.
S/4HANA
Hands-on experience with S/4HANA Sourcing & Procurement, including simplification items, Business Partner conversion, MATNR field-length extension and the
material ledger.
Experience with Fiori applications for procurement, embedded analytics and role design.
Practical experience with Migration Cockpit (LTMC/LTMOM) or legacy LSMW for data migration.
SAP ARIBA
Demonstrable implementation experience across one or more Ariba solutions — Sourcing (RFx events, auctions, award scenarios), Contracts (contract workspaces,
clause libraries, templates), Buying & Invoicing / Guided Buying, and Supplier Lifecycle & Performance (SLP).
Working knowledge of supplier onboarding, registration, qualification and segmentation processes, including Ariba Network enablement of suppliers.
Catalogue management experience covering CIF catalogues, punch-out catalogues and catalogue validation.
Hands-on integration expertise between Ariba and SAP ERP / S/4HANA using Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG) or SAP Integration Suite / CPI, including master data
replication, cXML message flows and monitoring of failed transactions.
Clear understanding of the end-to-end Ariba–S/4HANA transaction cycle (requisition, purchase order, goods receipt, invoice) and of ERP-integrated versus
standalone deployment models.
Familiarity with realm setup, site configuration, transformation and mapping of custom fields, and Ariba release-cycle management.
PROJECT EXPERIENCE
Minimum four full-lifecycle SAP implementations, of which at least one or two on S/4HANA — greenfield, brownfield conversion or selective data transition.
At least one full implementation or integration project involving SAP Ariba, delivered alongside or on top of an SAP ERP landscape.
Working knowledge of SAP Activate; familiarity with Agile and hybrid delivery models.
Global rollout, template design and localisation experience strongly preferred.
PREFERRED / VALUE-ADD
Exposure to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain, or comparable platforms such as Coupa or Jaggaer.
SAP Ariba solution certification and experience of Ariba Spend Analysis or Supply Chain Collaboration.
Understanding of Indian statutory requirements (GST, e-invoicing, e-way bill) and other regional localisations.
Exposure to SAP BTP, Integration Suite / CPI and clean-core extensibility principles.
Basic ABAP debugging ability sufficient to work effectively with technical teams.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA Dynamo is a high-throughput, low-latency inference framework for serving generative AI and reasoning models across multi-node distributed environments.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA Dynamo is a high-throughput, low-latency inference framework for serving generative AI and reasoning models across multi-node distributed environments. Built in Rust for performance and Python for extensibility, Dynamo orchestrates GPU shards, routes requests, and manages shared KV cache across heterogeneous clusters so that many accelerators feel like a single system at datacenter scale. As large language models rapidly outgrow the memory and compute budget of any single GPU, this platform enables efficient, resilient deployment of cutting-edge LLM workloads.

We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to define the vision and roadmap for memory management of large-scale LLM and storage systems.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design and evolve a unified memory layer that spans GPU memory, pinned host memory, RDMA-accessible memory, SSD tiers, and remote file/object/cloud storage to support large-scale LLM inference.

  • Architect and implement deep integrations with leading LLM serving engines (such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM), with a focus on KV-cache offload, reuse, and remote sharing across heterogeneous and disaggregated clusters.

  • Co-design interfaces and protocols that enable disaggregated prefill, peer-to-peer KV-cache sharing, and multi-tier KV-cache storage (GPU, CPU, local disk, and remote memory) for high-throughput, low-latency inference.

  • Partner closely with GPU architecture, networking, and platform teams to exploit GPUDirect, RDMA, NVLink, and similar technologies for low-latency KV-cache access and sharing across heterogeneous accelerators and memory pools.

  • Mentor senior and junior engineers, set technical direction for memory and storage subsystems, and represent the team in internal reviews and external forums (open source, conferences, and customer-facing technical deep dives).

What we need to see:

  • Masters or PhD or equivalent experience

  • 15+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, high-performance storage, or ML systems infrastructure in C/C++ and Python, with a track record of delivering production services.

  • Deep understanding of memory hierarchies (GPU HBM, host DRAM, SSD, and remote/object storage) and experience designing systems that span multiple tiers for performance and cost efficiency.

  • Distributed caching or key-value systems, especially designs optimized for low latency and high concurrency.

  • Hands-on experience with networked I/O and RDMA/NVMe-oF/NVLink-style technologies, and familiarity with concepts like disaggregated and aggregated deployments for AI clusters.

  • Strong skills in profiling and optimizing systems across CPU, GPU, memory, and network, using metrics to drive architectural decisions and validate improvements in TTFT and throughput.

  • Excellent communication skills and prior experience leading cross-functional efforts with research, product, and customer teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Prior contributions to open-source LLM serving or systems projects focused on KV-cache optimization, compression, streaming, or reuse.

  • Experience designing unified memory or storage layers that expose a single logical KV or object model across GPU, host, SSD, and cloud tiers, especially in enterprise or hyperscale environments.

  • Publications or patents in areas such as LLM systems, memory-disaggregated architectures, RDMA/NVLink-based data planes, or KV-cache/CDN-like systems for ML.

jobs.title: Chief Digital Assets Officer (CDAO)
jobs.excerpt: Role SummaryThe Chief Digital Assets Officer (CDAO) is responsible for leading the organization's digital assets strategy, including tokenized assets, digital securities, cryptocurrencies, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), custody solutions, and blockchain-enabled financial products.
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Chief Digital Assets Officer (CDAO) is responsible for leading the organization's digital assets strategy, including tokenized assets, digital securities, cryptocurrencies, central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), custody solutions, and blockchain-enabled financial products. This executive role oversees the development, governance, commercialization, and regulatory compliance of digital asset initiatives while driving innovation and sustainable growth in the evolving digital economy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Assets Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital assets and tokenization strategy.
  • Identify opportunities for digital asset adoption, monetization, and business growth.
  • Advise the CEO, Board, and executive leadership on digital asset trends, risks, and market developments.
  • Establish long-term digital asset roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy.

2. Digital Asset Product Development

  • Lead the creation and commercialization of digital asset products and services.
  • Oversee tokenized investment products, digital securities, stablecoin initiatives, and custody offerings.
  • Drive innovation in digital asset trading, settlement, and asset management solutions.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of digital asset platforms.

3. Tokenization & Digital Securities

  • Develop tokenization strategies for financial instruments, real-world assets, and alternative investments.
  • Lead digital securities issuance and lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Evaluate opportunities in asset tokenization and fractional ownership models.
  • Drive adoption of blockchain-enabled financial infrastructure.

4. Digital Asset Operations & Custody

  • Oversee custody frameworks and asset protection mechanisms.
  • Ensure operational resilience and secure management of digital assets.
  • Implement governance controls for wallets, private keys, and settlement processes.
  • Establish operational best practices and service standards.

5. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with digital asset regulations and financial market requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Information Security functions.
  • Manage regulatory licensing, reporting, and audit obligations.
  • Monitor developments from regulators and industry bodies affecting digital assets.

6. Market Development & Strategic Partnerships

  • Build partnerships with exchanges, custodians, financial institutions, fintechs, and blockchain providers.
  • Develop strategic alliances to expand digital asset capabilities and market access.
  • Represent the organization within digital asset industry forums and working groups.
  • Support ecosystem growth and institutional adoption initiatives.

7. Technology & Innovation

  • Partner with technology teams to develop blockchain-based digital asset infrastructure.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies supporting digital assets and tokenization.
  • Drive innovation in settlement, custody, interoperability, and smart contract capabilities.
  • Support integration of digital assets into existing financial systems.

8. Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build and lead high-performing digital asset, product, operations, and compliance teams.
  • Develop internal expertise in digital assets, tokenization, and blockchain technologies.
  • Manage budgets, investments, and vendor relationships.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, governance, and operational excellence.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Technology, Computer Science, Law, or related field.
  • MBA, Master's degree, CFA, JD/LLB, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in financial services, capital markets, asset management, fintech, digital assets, or blockchain-related sectors.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior executive leadership role.
  • Proven experience with digital assets, tokenization, digital securities, custody, or blockchain-enabled financial products.
  • Strong understanding of capital markets, financial regulations, custody operations, and digital asset ecosystems.

Key Competencies

  • Digital Assets Strategy
  • Tokenization & Digital Securities
  • Capital Markets & Asset Management
  • Blockchain & Distributed Ledger Technology
  • Digital Asset Custody & Operations
  • Cryptocurrency & Stablecoin Ecosystems
  • Regulatory Compliance & Governance
  • Risk Management
  • Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
  • Product Innovation & Commercialization
  • Executive Leadership
  • Financial Services Transformation

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Full Time - Sioux City

Job Location: Work at Home, Iowa, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

40

Full time

$78,331.00 - $168,714.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

Ready to do work that actually excites you?
The Management Accountant supports the day-to-day finance function for the client's online learner instructor marketplace, with primary ownership of transactional accounting and shared responsibility for month-end close activities across our Australian and UK entities.
Reporting to the Head of Finance, the role ensures the integrity of the general ledger, the accuracy and timeliness of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations, and the smooth running of routine month-end tasks. The successful candidate will take on increasing responsibility for balance sheet reconciliations, accruals
and prepayments, fixed asset accounting, and draft management reports, working remotely with core hours aligned to Australian time.
Position Description
The Finance function underpins the client's growth by delivering accurate accounts, actionable insights, and strong control over cash and compliance. This role partners closely with the existing Senior Management Accountant to keep the accounting cycle running on time and to a high standard and owning the transactional layer end to end and progressively taking on month end and reporting work.
The following are the descriptions of the essential skills, knowledge and experience on which performance will be measured.
What You’ll Do
Bookkeeping & Month End Close
  • Maintain finance email inboxes; process supplier invoices, employee reimbursements, and customer receipts accurately and on time; perform daily bank and credit card reconciliations across AU and UK entities.
  • Manage AP/AR ageing; prepare payment runs for review, follow up overdue invoices, and resolve supplier and customer queries.
  • Prepare and post month end journals (accruals, prepayments, depreciation); reconcile assigned balance sheet accounts and support delivery of the close within the agreed timetable.
Fixed Assets, Intercompany & GL Integrity
  • Maintain the fixed asset register; calculate and post monthly depreciation and record asset additions and disposals.
  • Reconcile intercompany balances between AU and UK entities, clear in transit items, and maintain Xero GL integrity (correct coding, GST/VAT treatment, tracking categories).
Reporting & FP&A Support
  • Assist with the preparation of monthly management reporting packs in Xero/Fathom and Google Sheets; draft P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reports for review.
  • Support budgeting and quarterly rolling forecasts by preparing data extracts, variance schedules, and supporting analysis; help maintain the 13 week cash flow forecast.
Compliance & Audit
  • Prepare BAS and VAT working papers for review; ensure accurate GST/VAT coding throughout the month and support payroll, superannuation, and PAYG reconciliations.
  • Assist with year end audit preparation, pulling supporting documentation and responding to auditor queries under the direction of the Head of Finance.
Process Improvement & Ad Hoc
  • Identify opportunities to streamline transactional and month end processes; help maintain documentation of accounting policies and procedures; undertake ad hoc finance tasks as directed.

Requirements

What You Bring
We’re looking for someone who:
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to interact professionally with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and customers.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over data accuracy.
  • Proactive, problem solving mindset; willing to ask questions, raise issues early, and contribute to process improvement.
  • Well organised, with the ability to manage competing deadlines and deliver accurate work at pace in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with a small remote finance team; discreet and trustworthy with confidential financial information.
Education and Technical Knowledge
  • Essential: Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy or equivalent; minimum 6+ years’ hands on accounting experience covering AP, AR, bank reconciliations, and month end journal processing.
  • Essential: Proven Xero proficiency (including bank feeds, tracking categories, and multi currency); solid Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills (formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP).
  • Preferred: CPA qualified or actively progressing toward CPA; experience supporting Australian (BAS/GST) and/or UK (VAT) compliance.
  • Preferred: Exposure to Looker Studio; prior experience with Australian or UK clients/entities, or in a tech, SaaS, or online marketplace environment.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here
  • HMO, Dental, and Life Insurance for you and one free dependent from day one (with the option to enroll additional dependents)
  • Paid Leaves: Birthday, Vacation, Medical, and Maternity (up to 6 Vacation Leaves are convertible to cash on your anniversary)
  • Employee Engagement Activities: Year-End Party, Family Day, Team Building, and more!

Job Description:

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and systems to support data processing, analysis, and visualization. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements, optimize data workflows, and ensure data quality and reliability.

Responsibilities:

1. Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, and optimize data pipelines to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into data warehouses or data lakes, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency.

2. Data Modeling: Develop and maintain data models and schemas to support business analytics, reporting, and machine learning applications, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and performance.

3. Data Integration: Integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, streaming platforms, and third-party systems, to provide unified views of data for analysis and reporting purposes.

4. Data Quality Assurance: Implement data quality checks and monitoring processes to identify and rectify data anomalies, inconsistencies, and errors, ensuring high data quality and reliability.

5. Performance Optimization: Optimize data processing and query performance through indexing, partitioning, and caching techniques, leveraging distributed computing frameworks and database technologies.

6. Infrastructure Management: Manage and maintain data infrastructure components, including databases, data warehouses, ETL pipelines, and data processing clusters, ensuring availability, scalability, and security.

7. Collaboration and Documentation: Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs. Document data pipelines, workflows, and system configurations for knowledge sharing and future reference.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Proven experience 4 years as a Data Engineer or similar role, with a strong track record of designing and implementing data pipelines and systems.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala, and experience with data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or Hadoop.
  • Solid understanding of database technologies, including SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and experience with cloud-based data services (e.g., AWS Redshift, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, Google BigQuery).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Yaqeen is a nonprofit on a mission to pioneer Islamic research in creative, cutting-edge formats tailored to meet people where they are. We work to dismantle doubts through well-researched truths, nurture conviction by strengthening belief with practical, spiritual guidance, and inspire contribution by reviving our tradition of faithful changemakers, insha’Allah. We’re seeking like-minded professionals who embody Islamic values including sincerity, excellence, and compassion, and want to make a difference in the faith of people worldwide.

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Data Engineer to join our Engineering team for 6 months as a contractor. You will design, build, and operate the data platform that powers analytics, research, and product decisions across the organization. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable modeling complex datasets, engineering resilient pipelines, and managing the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will own systems from ingestion and transformation through to the warehouse layer, and you will set the standards that keep our data trustworthy. Beyond building, you will partner closely with analytics, product, and platform teams to define how data moves through the organization and to raise the bar for reliability, quality, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

Data Modelling & Transformation

  • Model and structure data for analytical and operational use, owning the transformation layer and its tooling, including dbt
  • Design data models that are clear, well documented, and easy for downstream teams to build on
  • Define and enforce data contracts and schema standards in collaboration with upstream and downstream engineering teams

Pipelines & Orchestration

  • Design and build scalable batch and streaming data pipelines across ETL, ELT, and change data capture patterns
  • Orchestrate and schedule workflows using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
  • Ensure pipelines are observable, recoverable, and well instrumented, with monitoring and data quality checks that catch issues before they reach consumers

Data Warehousing & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize our modern data warehouse, including storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration
  • Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure as code, and manage deployment and container orchestration
  • Implement privacy, anonymization, and governance controls to keep sensitive data protected and compliant

Collaboration & Communication

  • Participate in planning and requirements discussions to raise data quality and modeling concerns before development starts
  • Translate requirements from analysts, researchers, and product engineers into robust data models and reliable delivery
  • Keep engineering and the wider organization connected through transparent, timely communication

Qualifications

  • Experience in working with financial and payment data
  • Exposure to payment APIs and automated reconciliation
  • Advanced SQL, including performance tuning and complex analytical query design
  • Advanced Python for pipeline development, tooling, and automation
  • Familiarity and hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, or an equivalent
  • Data warehousing: expert knowledge of one modern platform (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift), including architecture, storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration
  • Experience developing and orchestrating data pipelines across ETL, ELT, CDC, and stream processing
  • Data modeling and tooling expertise, including dbt
  • Experience with modern orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure tooling, including Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes or equivalent
  • Experience defining and enforcing data contracts or schema standards in collaborative engineering environments
  • Exposure to privacy and anonymization implementations
  • Background in a SaaS, startup, or product-led environment is a plus
  • Familiarity with data observability and lineage tooling such as Sentry or Datadog is a plus

Assignment

  • Technical assessment assigned after candidate screening.

Yaqeen Institute embraces a philosophy that values and promotes diversity. Our goal is to attract, develop, retain, and advance a talented and diverse workforce within a culture where all employees are empowered to reach their fullest potential.

Please note that all career opportunities at Yaqeen Institute are subject to a three-month probationary period, during which we assess performance, alignment with our values, and mutual fit to ensure long-term success in the role.

  • Comfort working within file-size and memory budgets, including compressed web and mobile formats

  • The ability to turn a written brief and reference tracks into finished audio within agreed revision rounds

  • Clear written English and reliable async communication

Nice to Have:

Hiring Senior Golang Developer | Remote from Pakistan

﻿Europe based IT Firm that engages in software architecture and scalable engineering for growing product teams.

﻿Role Overview – Senior Backend Engineer

You will be joining the Video Platform team within an OTT business vertical, building and scaling a video content platform used by over 100 million users with nearly 1 billion views. The team is responsible for delivering reliable, scalable, and high-performance backend systems that power video delivery, partner integrations, and publishing workflows.

This is a senior-level engineering role requiring strong backend engineering expertise, architectural thinking, and production experience. While the ideal experience range is 6–10 years, candidates with lower experience levels who demonstrate technical maturity and strong fundamentals are encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend systems that power large-scale video platforms. Your responsibilities include:

  • Building and continuously improving backend services using Go and Node.js in a microservices architecture

  • Developing REST APIs and event-driven services using platforms such as AWS EventBridge, SQS, and RabbitMQ

  • Writing high-performing, maintainable, well-structured, and well-tested code following SOLID principles

  • Contributing to system design discussions and evolving service architecture using serverless and event-driven patterns

  • Ensuring high availability, scalability, performance, and fault tolerance in production systems

  • Working with databases including PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, and Redshift depending on service needs

  • Deploying and operating services using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS

  • Contributing to CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions for build and test and ArgoCD for deployment

  • Using observability tools such as Honeycomb, Grafana, Prometheus, and CloudWatch to monitor, debug, and improve system behavior

  • Partnering with DevOps and SRE teams to evolve infrastructure, deployment workflows, and operational practices using Terraform and GitOps patterns

  • Working in a collaborative engineering culture following practices such as pair programming, mob programming, YAGNI, and Test-Driven Development

  • Participating in on-call rotations and supporting production systems

  • Contributing to organization-wide backend engineering efforts and knowledge sharing across teams

Requirements:

You bring strong backend engineering expertise with experience in cloud-native systems:

  • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) and working knowledge of Node.js

  • Experience building distributed microservices and API-driven systems

  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and event-driven backend systems

  • Solid experience working with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, and/or Redshift

  • Experience working with AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) in production environments

  • Exposure to Docker-based service development and deployment

  • Experience using Terraform for infrastructure management

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD

  • Experience operating and debugging systems using observability tools such as Honeycomb, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
