The IRC is actively investing in enterprise AI to improve the speed, quality, and scale of its programs and operations. As the organization expands its use of AI platforms, including tools from Anthropic, OpenAI, and integrated data environments, the IT department is building dedicated technical capacity to keep these systems running reliably, securely, and effectively.

The IRC is investing in enterprise AI to improve the speed, quality, and scale of its programs and operations. As that investment grows, so does the need for someone to own the technical layer underneath it: the systems, integrations, and infrastructure that make AI tools work at scale.

The AI Platform Engineer is that person. This is a technical operations role, not a user-facing one. This role is responsible for keeping the IRC's enterprise AI environment running managing platform configurations and API access, building and maintaining integrations between AI tools and IRC systems, writing scripts and automations, and serving as the technical point of contact for data engineering and InfoSec. Day-to-day, this person is more likely to be reading logs, troubleshooting a broken pipeline, or pushing a configuration change than answering questions from end users.

The role works in close coordination with the AI Platform Support Director, who owns vendor relationships, licensing, and adoption strategy. This role owns the technical execution underneath that, ensuring the systems are reliable, observable, and properly connected to the rest of the IRC's data and operational environment.

Major Responsibilities

AI Systems Administration & Operations (40%)

  • Serve as primary technical administrator across IRC enterprise AI environments, currently including Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI platform deployments
  • Manage user access, API key governance, workspace configurations, and environment-level settings across AI platforms
  • Monitor system health, usage patterns, and API performance across AI tools; triage and resolve operational issues as they arise
  • Maintain and improve observability across AI systems
  • Tracking uptime, error rates, token consumption, and integration reliability
  • Oversee and document configuration changes, environment updates, and deployment procedures across managed platforms
  • Support responsible use by flagging anomalous usage patterns and coordinating with InfoSec on policy adherence and access controls

Integrations & Technical Implementation (35%)

  • Coordinate with the DevOps, SW Engineering and Data Engineering team(s) on deployment processes, environment access, and infrastructure dependencies required to build and maintain AI integrations
  • Follow established change management procedures for all configuration changes, environment updates, and integration deployments, including documentation, testing, and appropriate approvals before pushing to production
  • Develop lightweight scripts, connectors, and automations to support AI-assisted workflows across teams, primarily in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, data flow issues, and API connectivity problems across the AI ecosystem
  • Collaborate with the data engineering team on AI/KM pipeline work, including vector store ingestion, retrieval configuration, and source data connections
  • Contribute to technical design discussions with engineering partners, translating operational requirements into implementable solutions
  • Maintain technical documentation for all integrations, including architecture notes, runbooks, and dependency maps

Monitoring, Resource Optimization & InfoSec Liaison (15%)

  • Track and report on AI resource utilization across platforms, identifying opportunities to reduce waste and improve cost efficiency in coordination with the AI
  • Serve as the technical point of contact with the InfoSec team on matters related to AI system security, data handling, access controls, and compliance requirements
  • Support risk assessments and security reviews for new AI tools or integrations by providing accurate technical context on system behavior and data flows
  • Contribute to the development of technical SOPs and best-practice guidelines for AI system use, in coordination with the AI Platform Support Director and relevant stakeholders

Stakeholder Support & Collaboration (10%)

  • Act as a technical resource for program and operations teams adopting AI tools, including answering implementation questions, supporting troubleshooting, and identifying configuration solutions
  • Participate in rollout planning for new AI capabilities, providing grounded input on technical feasibility, integration requirements, and operational readiness
  • Collaborate with the AI Platform Support Director on onboarding documentation and technical guidance materials for end users
  • Contribute to sprint and project planning with accurate estimates on technical effort and dependencies

Required Experience & Skills

AI & Cloud Platforms

  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or comparable tools), including API management, access controls, and environment configuration
  • Familiarity with LLM application infrastructure: prompt pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP), other tool-calling integration frameworks, vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, and embedding workflows
  • Experience working with Databricks or comparable data/ML platforms is a strong plus

Integration & Development

  • Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript for scripting, automation, and lightweight integration work
  • Experience building and maintaining REST API integrations, including authentication patterns, webhook handling, and error management
  • Comfort reading and working within existing codebases without requiring significant architectural guidance
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and standard deployment practices for scripts and integrations

Systems Administration & Monitoring

  • Experience monitoring distributed systems or SaaS platforms, including setting up alerting, reviewing logs, and diagnosing performance or availability issues
  • Familiarity with usage/cost monitoring for cloud or API-based services
  • Comfort operating in live production environments where reliability and data integrity are critical

Security & Compliance

  • Working knowledge of information security principles as they apply to SaaS and API-based systems: access controls, credential management, data handling, and audit logging
  • Ability to engage constructively with InfoSec teams, providing clear technical context to support reviews and risk assessments

Collaboration & Communication

  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues and program staff
  • Experience contributing to cross-functional teams alongside product, engineering, and operations stakeholders
  • Strong documentation habits: runbooks, SOPs, architecture notes, and internal guides

Working Environment

This role is remote, with the possibility of in-person work depending on location. Stakeholders are located across multiple time zones (GMT-8 to GMT+3), which may require occasional early or late meetings.

Compensation: ($88,277 - $102,451/annual). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements

Who we are

Bloom Works is a women-owned civic technology consultancy. Our mission is to build government capacity to deliver services well, so that people get the public services they need, frictionlessly and with dignity. We partner with government agencies and purpose-driven organizations through product thinking, user experience design, content strategy, research, and technical strategy, working at the intersection of human-centered design, policy, and implementation.

What this role does

We're looking for a Director of Product & Delivery to lead and develop our Product and Delivery practice, set the standard for how we support our clients, and raise Bloom's profile as a product partner in government. You'll manage and develop a team of Product and Delivery Managers (PDMs), help client teams grow their own product capability, and build the external relationships and field presence that bring Bloom's product expertise to more government teams.

In this role, you will:

Build client capacity in product thinking

The measure of our product work is whether clients can run well without us.

  • Help clients see and learn the value of product thinking firsthand on engagements (both by fostering a team that is extraordinary at this, and by working directly with clients as an advisor and subject-matter expert when needed).
  • Support clients in adding product roles, capability, and team structures of their own, with structured support that outlasts the engagement.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to government leaders on setting up product leaders and teams for success, increasingly at senior and strategic levels.
  • Define and maintain the standards, workflows, and rituals that let teams deliver well and sustainably, and make room for experimentation and iteration.
  • Establish how the practice measures progress, learns, and adjusts as conditions change.
  • Set up knowledge management so lessons carry forward instead of getting rediscovered.

Lead and grow the Product & Delivery practice

  • Support a team of 7 to 10 seasoned PDMs through regular 1:1s, candid feedback, and coaching at the moments that matter, while trusting them to run their projects day to day.
  • Grow senior practitioners toward broader scope and leadership, so the practice gets stronger over time.
  • Hire PDMs and place them on projects where they will thrive and serve the mission.
  • Set the practice's direction and norms for collaboration and candor, so the team can deliver without you in the middle of every call.
  • Step in on hard team dynamics when needed, and work toward resolution in the open while modeling resilient conflict patterns.

Advance the role of product in public interest tech, and Bloom’s expertise specifically

  • Shape and contribute to the ecosystem-wide conversation on the importance of product in delivering user-centered public services
  • Raise the visibility of Bloom's product expertise with government teams and partners: publishing tools and points of view, speaking at and attending field events, and getting reusable resources into the hands of gov teams.
  • Build relationships with potential partners and clients, and connect Bloom's product perspective to the problems they're working on.
  • Represent Bloom's product practice in the field, shaping how the wider civic technology community understands product in government.

Contribute to Bloom's growth as a director

  • Work with Bloom's leadership team on tactical and strategic decisions, especially hiring, staffing, culture, and business development.
  • Scope proposed work with appropriate time and cost estimates, and set strategic direction for proposals.
  • Take a long-term view, make decisions aware of second-order effects, and keep moving amid ambiguity.

What we're looking for

  • At least 10 years of product and delivery experience, including leading teams in a consulting-like environment
  • Experience leading and maturing a team or practice, including developing senior practitioners
  • A track record of building client capacity: helping client teams grow their own product capability, and advising senior leaders on standing up product roles and teams
  • A history of representing product approaches in public interest technology through speaking, writing, or partnership-building
  • Comfort in a remote, distributed team, with exceptional communication, ease in ambiguity, and a collaborative, low-ego style
  • Fluency in agile, iterative, user-centered delivery
  • Experience in business development and government procurement: scoping work, shaping proposals, and navigating how government buys
  • Deep familiarity with the public interest technology landscape and the challenges of digital service delivery
  • A thoughtful, curious, and technically savvy stance toward emerging technology, including AI: willing to use it, ready to help the team build its own fluency, and able to judge where it helps and where it carries risk for government and the people these services serve

Salary and term

  • $180,000 - $205,000 annually

Benefits

In your first year, some benefits are prorated based on when you join.

  • An environment that empowers you to apply your skills and experience for the public good
  • Remote/distributed work environment
  • Health and wellness benefits (medical, dental, vision, life & AD&D, FSA, STD, LTD, & 401k + 3% match)
  • PTO, sick, and national holidays
  • Paid company closures during the week of July 4th and between Christmas and New Years Day

More about our team, and commitment to building a diverse workforce

Bloom Works believes a diverse workforce enhances our ability to improve public services. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

As a public interest technology company, we see diversity and equity-building as integral to both our mission and our research practices. We are committed to disrupting power dynamics and equity barriers in our work. We strive to recruit employees and partners who reflect the demographics of targeted end users, and we analyze, test, and iterate to make sure everyone can easily access and use the digital tools we build. As a public benefit company, we are compelled to generate social and public good, and to operate in a responsible and sustainable manner.

Background check and work authorization

Successful candidates will need to complete a background check before starting work.

We participate in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.

  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.

This team operates at the intersection of product strategy, field execution, and customer impact, partnering across every major function at Zoom to define what modern work looks like at scale. jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate, creative, and strategic Social Media Manager to lead how Paw Prosper's D2C consumer brands show up across organic social media, building engaged audiences and supporting the customer journey through relevant, useful, and engaging content.

As part of the Marketing team and reporting to the Director of Content & Community, this role will oversee the organic social presence of Paw Prosper's growing portfolio of 8 D2C brands and growing. You'll help create a scalable approach that allows each brand to maintain its own voice, audience, and purpose while benefiting from a shared content and marketing ecosystem.

This role combines strategy with hands-on execution. You will own organic social calendars and channel strategies, nurture audiences through meaningful two-way engagement, uncover UGC and customer stories, and maximize our existing content bank by adapting and repurposing assets for organic social. You will own the day-to-day organic social function, while the overall content and community strategy will be developed in partnership with and under the oversight of the Director of Content & Community.

You'll work closely with Growth and other marketing partners who develop content and activate audiences across paid and performance channels, while owning how our brands, content, and stories come to life organically.

This is a remote position, with candidates located in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) considered an asset due to the collaborative nature of our Marketing team.

Key Responsibilities

Organic Social Strategy & Channel Ownership

  • Own and evolve the organic social strategy across Paw Prosper's growing portfolio of D2C consumer brands in partnership with the Director of Content & Community.

  • Define how each brand shows up organically, including channel purpose, content pillars, voice, audience experience, and engagement approach.

  • Own organic social calendars from planning through publishing, engagement, optimization, and reporting.

  • Translate campaigns, launches, promotions, educational initiatives, customer stories, and brand priorities into compelling, platform-specific organic content.

  • Support D2C priorities across the customer journey through organic social, balancing brand building and audience engagement with product discovery, education, launches, promotions, and advocacy.

  • Monitor platform trends, audience behavior, emerging formats, and new channel opportunities to continuously evolve our approach.

  • Partner with the Director of Content & Community and Growth to align organic social with broader D2C campaigns and priorities while maintaining a distinct organic channel strategy and audience experience.

Audience Engagement & Nurturing

  • Build and nurture engaged audiences across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant organic social platforms.

  • Create welcoming organic environments that encourage conversation, participation, sharing, and connection with our brands.

  • Manage and proactively engage with comments, direct messages, tags, questions, brand mentions, relevant accounts, and social conversations.

  • Identify and nurture highly engaged followers, customers, super-users, and advocates, helping turn passive followers into active participants.

  • Identify relevant trends, cultural moments, and conversations our brands can authentically participate in.

UGC & Audience Storytelling

  • Proactively discover and collect UGC, testimonials, pet stories, product experiences, and other customer stories for organic social.

  • Own the process for sourcing, securing permissions for, organizing, and tracking UGC across consumer brands.

  • Build relationships with customers who create authentic brand content and identify opportunities to turn their experiences into ongoing organic storytelling.

  • Partner with Customer Experience to uncover customer stories and with Growth when UGC has potential for paid, affiliate, creator, or performance activation.

Content Activation & Audience Insights

  • Maximize Paw Prosper's broader content bank by repurposing photography, video, UGC, testimonials, educational materials, and campaign assets into platform-appropriate organic content.

  • Write and adapt captions, hooks, Stories, carousels, short-form video concepts, and other organic-first executions, creating lightweight social-first content when needed.

  • Identify opportunities to extend the lifespan of strong content through new formats, angles, edits, and storytelling approaches.

  • Identify gaps in the content bank based on organic channel and audience needs and communicate those needs to the appropriate teams.

  • Monitor conversations, sentiment, questions, and audience behavior to identify insights and opportunities that can strengthen content, messaging, and the customer experience.

  • Leverage AI tools to improve content organization, discovery, repurposing, ideation, and workflow efficiency across our multi-brand content ecosystem, while maintaining human oversight for brand voice, accuracy, and authenticity.

Performance & Optimization

  • Set goals and report on organic audience growth, engagement, advocacy, UGC, content performance, and contribution to D2C objectives.

  • Analyze content performance and audience behavior to understand what is resonating and why.

  • Translate insights into actionable improvements to content, platform, and engagement strategies, sharing relevant learnings with the Director of Content & Community and internal teams.

  • Continuously test new formats, platform features, and audience-building opportunities to strengthen organic performance.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Social Media Coordinators and other organic social team members.

  • Review calendars, copy, social executions, and engagement while helping the team prioritize work, remove blockers, and successfully manage multiple brands.

  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and proactive team culture through regular feedback, 1:1s, and professional development.

  • Keep the Director of Content & Community informed of team priorities, performance, challenges, and resourcing needs.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

  • Build a strong understanding of our D2C brands, audiences, organic channels, and content ecosystem.

  • Take ownership of organic social planning and execution, establishing consistent calendars, channel strategies, and audience engagement across priority brands.

  • Align organic social priorities, processes, and execution with the broader content and community strategy in partnership with the Director of Content & Community.

  • Establish scalable processes for UGC collection, content organization, repurposing, and audience nurturing across our growing portfolio.

  • Build strong working rhythms with the Director of Content & Community, Growth, Marketing, Customer Experience, and other key partners.

  • Establish baseline performance and identify clear opportunities to strengthen organic audience growth, engagement, and content performance.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 4–6+ years of progressive experience in organic social media, social strategy, audience engagement, or brand social, ideally supporting multiple D2C or consumer brands.

  • Agency Experience: Experience working in an agency environment is an asset, particularly experience managing multiple brands, clients, timelines, and priorities.

  • Organic Social Strategy: Demonstrated experience independently developing and executing organic social strategies, not solely scheduling or publishing content.

  • Audience Building & UGC: Strong understanding of how to attract, engage, nurture, and retain organic audiences, including experience sourcing and activating UGC and customer stories.

  • Content Skills: Strong ability to turn photography, video, UGC, customer stories, and campaign assets into engaging organic content, with excellent social copywriting skills.

  • Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube, including how audience behavior and content expectations differ across platforms.

  • Strategic & Analytical Thinking: Ability to translate organic social performance and audience behavior into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.

  • AI & Tools Fluency: Comfortable using AI and social media, listening, content management, productivity, and analytics tools to improve workflow efficiency and scale.

  • Communication & Judgment: Exceptional communication skills, high emotional intelligence, and sound judgment when representing brands and engaging directly with customers.

  • Organization & Leadership: Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple brands and priorities while mentoring junior team members and providing strategic direction.

  • Self-Starter: Proactive, curious, solutions-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across teams.

  • Passion for the Work: Must love animals. ❤️

Compensation: The annual base salary for this position is $85,000–$100,000 CAD, plus performance-based bonuses.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

Job Role: Senior Paid Media Specialist(Meta & Google Ads)

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is a boutique Australian marketing consultancy that specializes in helping healthcare professionals grow through clear, practical, and data-driven marketing strategies. They’re known for their approachable, down-to-earth working style and focus on delivering real, tangible results rather than overcomplicated agency talk. With a small and collaborative team, they offer a supportive environment where new team members can contribute meaningfully, learn quickly, and be involved in a variety of marketing and administrative initiatives.

Role Overview: Our client is a digital agency replacing their paid media specialist. We need an extremely senior, Philippines-based specialist who will own Meta Ads and Google Ads strategy and execution across our client portfolio. Our clients are bricks-and-mortar local healthcare businesses, selling both general services and high-ticket treatments. All of our work is lead generation on Meta and Google Ads.

This is a full-time, long-term remote role. The person must have built their career inside agencies, not as a freelancer. They will work with a high degree of autonomy, act as the senior paid media voice for our clients, and be accountable for results.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own strategy, structure and day-to-day management of Meta and Google Ads across a portfolio of client accounts.
  • Plan and run creative testing on Meta, and brief creative based on performance data.
  • Manage Google Search, Performance Max and local campaigns, including query mining, location targeting and bidding strategy.
  • Set up, audit and maintain conversion tracking: Meta Pixel and Conversions API, Google Ads conversions, GA4, call and form tracking, and server-side tagging where relevant.
  • Tie account performance to client business outcomes such as cost per lead, cost per booked appointment and revenue per patient, and set budgets accordingly.
  • Prioritise time across many accounts, spotting problems and opportunities before clients or management do.
  • Write client reports and updates, and join client calls to present results and recommendations.
  • Audit new client accounts during onboarding and pitches.
  • Document account structures, tests and processes so knowledge stays with the agency.

Requirements

  1. Agency background. At least 7 years in paid media, with most of that time employed by digital or performance agencies.
  2. Senior agency role. A recent title such as Senior Paid Media Manager, Performance Lead or Head of Paid, ideally with experience leading or mentoring others.
  3. Portfolio management. Has managed 8 or more client accounts at the same time, mostly lead generation for local service businesses.
  4. International clients. Has worked on Australian, US or UK client accounts.
  5. Expert on both Meta and Google Ads. Hands-on depth on both platforms, not strong on one and passable on the other. This includes Advantage+ and creative testing on Meta, and Search, Performance Max and local campaigns on Google. Knows Meta and Google healthcare advertising policies and how to keep health ads approved.
  6. Measurement. Strong working knowledge of Conversions API, GA4, Google Tag Manager and attribution. Understands the limits of in-platform reporting and can talk about incrementality.
  7. Creative instinct. Can analyse creative performance and write clear creative briefs.
  8. Business thinking. Talks about results in terms of cost per lead, cost per booked appointment and revenue per patient, not just CTR and CPM.
  9. Verifiable track record. Can state total monthly spend managed and walk through real accounts with measurable results. References from agency employers are available.
  10. Exceptional English. Near-native written and spoken English, confident leading client calls and writing client-facing reports without editing.

Nice-to-haves

-Experience with GoHighLevel for tracking leads through to booked appointments and sales.
-Healthcare advertising experience, especially high-ticket treatments with longer decision cycles.

-Call tracking tools such as CallRail.

-Offline conversion imports from a CRM back to Meta and Google.
-Experience with Looker Studio or similar reporting tools.
-Has trained or managed junior paid media staff.

Exclusions and red flags

-A career built mainly on freelancing through Upwork, OnlineJobs.ph, Fiverr or similar platforms.
-CVs made up mostly of short contracts or "various clients" with no named agency
employers.
-Titles such as "Virtual Assistant" or "Freelance Ads Manager" as their main experience.
-Experience limited to in-house roles for a single brand, or mainly e-commerce with
little lead generation work.
-Strong on only one of Meta or Google Ads.
-Unable to name the agencies they worked for, the types of clients, or the spend they
managed.
-Relies on certifications instead of real account results.
-English that is good but not client-ready.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Position: Full-Stack Digital Marketing Manager

Salary: Up to PHP 95,000 per month for a highly experienced candidate

Working Hours & Conditions: Full-time remote position working Australian business hours

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Our client is an Australian training provider offering accredited qualifications, micro-credentials and short courses across professional make-up artistry, screen and media, special effects, hairdressing and beauty therapy.

Our client is a globally recognized professional make-up brand serving make-up artists, creative professionals and consumers through ecommerce, product education and an established professional community.

The Digital Marketing Manager will work across both businesses, adapting marketing activity to two distinct commercial objectives:

  • Generating qualified enquiries and student enrolments.
  • Increasing ecommerce sales, customer engagement and brand awareness for the client.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

A premier Australian vocational training provider and an internationally recognized professional cosmetics brand are seeking an experienced, hands-on Digital Marketing Manager. In this dual-focused, highly autonomous role, you will drive full-funnel digital strategy, performance marketing, and conversion optimization across two distinct commercial models: student enrolment generation for creative arts courses and high-volume ecommerce acquisition for professional artists and consumers. By pairing data-driven advertising and AI-enhanced SEO with agile content creation, you will execute end-to-end campaigns that deliver measurable revenue growth across both brand portfolios during Australian business hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conversion Rate Optimization & Landing Pages: Design, build, test, and refine high-converting landing pages across WordPress and Magento to drive qualified course inquiries, student enrolments, and ecommerce sales.
  • Paid Performance Marketing: Build, manage, and optimize multi-channel ad campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, PMax) and Meta Ads Suite (Facebook & Instagram), expanding into TikTok or LinkedIn where relevant.
  • AI Search Optimization (AEO) & Local SEO: Execute AI-driven search strategies, conducting intent-based keyword research, on-page optimization, metadata planning, and Google Business Profile management for local campus visibility.
  • Multichannel Content Creation & Short-Form Video: Produce, edit, and repurpose written, visual, and short-form video assets tailored to prospective students, professional makeup artists, and beauty consumers across digital platforms.
  • Website Management & E-Commerce Merchandising: Maintain, update, and optimize site content, internal links, and user journeys across WordPress (educational portal) and Magento (ecommerce store).
  • Lifecycle Email Marketing & Automation: Design, segment, and deploy conversion-driven email campaigns, building automated sequences for lead nurturing, enrollment onboarding, abandoned cart recovery, and customer retention.
  • AI-Enabled Workflow Integration: Implement modern generative AI tools and repeatable workflows to accelerate content production, SEO research, copywriting, and ad testing while ensuring strict brand alignment and accuracy.
  • Commercial Analytics & Attribution Reporting: Set up and maintain accurate tracking tags across GA4 and Google Tag Manager, delivering clear performance reports focused on ROAS, CAC, conversion rates, and revenue.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of practical, hands-on digital marketing experience across paid search, paid social, SEO, and website management.
  • AI Workflow Mastery: Demonstrated ability to leverage generative AI tools to systematically improve campaign speed, SEO output, and content volume without sacrificing brand quality.
  • CMS & Tech Stack: Hands-on operational experience managing content and user journeys on both WordPress and Magento platforms.
  • Performance Advertising: Proven track record managing budget-allocated ad spend in Google Ads Manager and Meta Business Suite with strict target Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) and ROAS goals.
  • Content & Video Production: Strong practical capability in graphic design and short-form video editing using tools such as Canva, CapCut, or Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Operational Setup: Reliable high-speed remote environment and full availability to work during Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED):

  • Prior experience in lead generation for vocational education, Registered Training Organizations (RTOs), or tertiary institutions.
  • Direct experience within the beauty, cosmetics, or professional creative arts industries.
  • Industry certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), or Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate.
  • Technical SEO knowledge, including schema markup, structured data implementation, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
  • Portfolio showcasing live high-converting landing pages, paid ad creatives, edited short-form videos, email sequences, and AI-driven workflows.

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Job Purpose


The Director of US Portfolio Delivery (“US Local Delivery Lead Director”) provides leadership, oversight and local US delivery of studies in support of global R&D programs. The LDL-Director is accountable for a portfolio of assets, and manages the activities of US Program Leads (PLs) and US Local Delivery Leads (LDLs) to ensure the delivery of clinical studies to the required quality standards, GSK written standards and ICH GCP. The LDL-Director operates independently and effectively in a highly complex, high volume, strategic market.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Lead a team of LDLs operating in a highly complex environment due to scale (number of subjects/sites per study) and number of US studies conducted. Provide training, coaching, mentoring, line and performance management.
  • Responsible for effectively managing capacity utilization of LDL ensuring alignment of capabilities with study requirements, resource availability and business priorities.
  • Contribute to overall management of clinical research within the LOC via involvement in applicable leadership teams to ensure consistency and utilization of resources and best practice.
  • Accountable for ensuring the completion of all deliverables for studies within assigned portfolio to agreed timelines, budget and quality standards. The LDL-Director works with the LDLs to identify and resolve or escalate risks and issues that may impact study delivery.
  • Responsible for identifying and sharing best practices, standardizing across the US and representing local/regional clinical operations on global and cross functional initiatives.
  • Recruits and develops LDLs. Evaluates capabilities and competencies of internal staff, identifies and coordinates implementation of personal development plans for direct reports.
  • Partners with local and central teams to ensure robust study feasibility with reference to study complexity, clinical facilities and monitoring resource.
  • Establishes and manages key strategic relationships with external vendors to ensure clinical studies are appropriately resourced and executed as necessary.
  • Ensures that critical study timelines related to study activities are accurately forecasted and achieved and that recruitment targets, patient recruitment cycle times, data and audit quality and site related milestones are met. Provides trouble-shooting and problem resolution support for LDLs to ensure productive, efficient study delivery.
  • Assists with audits/inspections of local clinical operations department & study / sites in the country, as required.
  • Continuous development of knowledge in the areas of GCP, internal company guidelines, SOPs, new monitoring technologies and capabilities.
  • Leads or participates in regional/global clinical operations projects (as appropriate).
  • Available and willing to travel as job requires.

Why You?

Basic Qualifications:


  • University degree in Sciences (Medicine, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Biology or related fields) or equivalent demonstrable professional experience in the area
  • At least 10 years of experience in clinical operations delivery within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, including leadership of complex, multi‑site clinical studies in the US.
  • At least 5 years of experience leading and developing clinical operations leaders or managers (e.g., LDLs, study managers, CTMs) in a high‑volume, high‑complexity environment.
  • Demonstrated accountability for study delivery to timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements, including risk identification, issue escalation, and problem resolution.
  • Strong working knowledge of ICH‑GCP, GSK written standards, and US regulatory expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading delivery across late phase and/or registrational cardiovascular, vaccines and/or steatotic liver disease studies is highly valued.
  • Experience leading delivery of a portfolio of studies across multiple asset teams.
  • Experience delivering clinical trials in the US, including studies with large site networks, complex protocols, and competitive enrollment environments.


Skills

Agile Thinking, Business Acumen, Clinical Development, Clinical Trial Designs, Communication, Creativity, Decision Making, Fostering Collaboration, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Influencing Without Authority, People Management, Pharmaceutical Industry, Project ManagementThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $153,750 to $256,250. GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. jobs.excerpt: O roliStoryous pomáhá lokálním podnikům řídit jejich každodenní provoz.
jobs.description:
O roli

Storyous pomáhá lokálním podnikům řídit jejich každodenní provoz. K tomu potřebujeme rozvíjet kvalitní spolupráci s technologickými, obchodními a oborovými partnery a zároveň zajistit, aby naše integrace přinášely skutečnou hodnotu zákazníkům i společnosti.

Hledáme člověka, který převezme plnou odpovědnost za dvě propojené oblasti:

  • Integrations: řízení a rozvoj integračního portfolia, spolupráce s technologickými partnery a vedení nových integračních iniciativ od nápadu až po stabilní provoz.

  • Partnerships: vyhledávání, vyjednávání a rozvoj partnerství, která pomohou Storyous oslovit více relevantních zákazníků a rozšířit hodnotu našeho produktu.

Nejde o roli, ve které člověk pouze předává požadavky dál. Budeš vlastníkem výsledku: pochopíš obchodní příležitost, vyhodnotíš její potenciál, navrhneš model spolupráce, vyjednáš podmínky, zajistíš realizaci, prosadíš potřebné změny napříč firmou a následně změříš, zda iniciativa přináší očekávanou hodnotu.

Tvoje mise

Vybudovat a řídit portfolio integrací a partnerství, které:

  • zvyšuje hodnotu Storyous pro zákazníky;

  • podporuje růst obchodních výsledků a akvizici nových zákazníků;

  • vytváří nové distribuční a obchodní příležitosti;

  • zlepšuje produktovou nabídku a uživatelskou zkušenost;

  • má jasný účel, odpovědnost, měřitelné cíle a udržitelný provozní model.

Co budeš dělat

1. Vlastnictví integračního portfolia

  • Převezmeš ownership nad stávajícími i novými integracemi Storyous.

  • Zmapuješ jejich obchodní účel, technický a provozní stav, zapojené týmy, náklady, přínosy a největší rizika.

  • Nastavíš jasný lifecycle integrace od prvotního posouzení přes realizaci a uvedení do provozu až po dlouhodobé vyhodnocování.

  • Budeš hlavním kontaktem pro klíčové technologické partnery.

  • Zajistíš, aby integrace nebyly pouze technicky funkční, ale také srozumitelné, obchodně uchopitelné a dlouhodobě udržitelné.

  • Společně s Product, Engineering a Operations budeš hledat možnosti standardizace, automatizace a zjednodušení podpory.

2. Vyhledávání a rozvoj partnerství

  • Vytvoříš partnerskou strategii v souladu s prioritami Storyous.

  • Budeš aktivně vyhledávat nové příležitosti mezi relevantními firmami, odborníky, distribučními kanály a dalšími subjekty s vazbou na cílový segment.

  • Zmapuješ, kde má partner obchodní motivaci Storyous doporučovat, prodávat, integrovat nebo společně nabízet zákazníkům.

  • Povedeš celý proces od identifikace a kvalifikace partnera přes návrh spolupráce a vyjednávání až po onboarding, launch a další rozvoj.

  • Navrhneš vhodný model spolupráce podle konkrétní příležitosti — například referral, reseller, co-selling, společná nabídka nebo strategická spolupráce.

  • Budeš hledat způsoby, jak partnerské vztahy převést do konkrétního obchodního dopadu, nikoliv pouze do počtu podepsaných smluv.

3. Business case, ekonomika a vyjednávání

  • Pro významné iniciativy připravíš business case založený na dostupných datech a realistických předpokladech.

  • Posoudíš potenciální obchodní přínos, náklady, kapacitu interních týmů, provozní náročnost a hlavní rizika.

  • Budeš navrhovat obchodní podmínky a ekonomický model integrací a partnerství ve spolupráci s relevantními týmy.

  • Povedeš jednání o obchodním modelu, odpovědnostech, podpoře, datových a provozních podmínkách i dalších klíčových tématech.

  • Budeš připravovat rozhodovací materiály pro leadership a umět doporučit, zda iniciativu realizovat, upravit, pilotovat nebo odložit.

4. Product a Engineering enablement

  • Přeložíš obchodní potřebu do jasného produktového a technického zadání.

  • Budeš rozumět principům integrací a produktového vývoje natolik, abys dokázal/a vést kvalifikovanou diskusi s interními i externími technickými stakeholdery.

  • Zajistíš, že požadavky mají jasný účel, rozsah, očekávaný přínos, prioritu a vlastníka.

  • Pokud bude pro realizaci potřeba kapacita Product nebo Engineering, převezmeš odpovědnost za prosazení priority a sladění stakeholderů.

  • Budeš hlídat, aby nové iniciativy měly odpovídající míru standardizace, opakovatelnosti a dlouhodobé udržitelnosti.

  • Zajistíš připravenost onboardingu, dokumentace, podpory, měření výsledků a provozní odpovědnosti před uvedením do provozu.

5. Go-to-market a adoption

  • Ve spolupráci se Sales, Marketingem, Customer Care a Product vytvoříš plán uvedení relevantních integrací a partnerství.

  • Připravíš value proposition, obchodní argumentaci, kvalifikační kritéria a podklady pro interní týmy i partnery.

  • Zajistíš, aby partner rozuměl nabídce Storyous, cílovým zákazníkům a způsobu předávání příležitostí.

  • Budeš sledovat nejen počet aktivovaných partnerů, ale především skutečné využívání a obchodní dopad.

  • Identifikuješ překážky v onboardingovém procesu a budeš je odstraňovat ve spolupráci s interními týmy i partnery.

6. Reporting, governance a kontinuální zlepšování

  • Nastavíš pravidelný reporting portfolia integrací a partnerství pro management.

  • Budeš sledovat vývoj pipeline, obchodní výsledky, aktivaci, využívání, náklady, přínosy a kvalitu provozu.

  • Zavedeš pravidelné business reviews s klíčovými partnery.

  • Budeš udržovat přehlednou evidenci smluv, vlastníků, obchodních podmínek, provozního stavu a dalších klíčových informací.

  • Budeš průběžně vyhodnocovat, které integrace a partnerství rozvíjet, standardizovat, renegociovat nebo ukončit.

    Rozhodovací pravomoc a odpovědnost

Od této role očekáváme skutečný ownership, nikoliv pouze koordinaci. Budeš mít odpovědnost za to, aby:

  • každá prioritní iniciativa měla jasný cíl, business case, rozsah a měřítko úspěchu;

  • partnerství byla ekonomicky smysluplná a měla jasně definované odpovědnosti;

  • technické a produktové požadavky byly srozumitelné a měly odpovídající prioritu;

  • interní stakeholderové byli včas informováni a rozhodnutí se dotahovala;

  • problémy byly řešeny přímo a včas, včetně eskalace na správnou úroveň;

  • výsledek byl po uvedení do provozu měřen a případně korigován.

Budeš fungovat jako seniorní individual contributor: bez nutnosti velkého týmu pod sebou, ale s dostatečným vlivem a autoritou pro řízení komplexních iniciativ napříč Commercial, Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Care, Finance a Legal.

Jak poznáme úspěch:

Po 6–12 měsících budeš mít:

  • transparentní přehled integračního portfolia a jasný plán jeho rozvoje;

  • prioritizovaný pipeline nových integrací a partnerství s kvalitními business casy;

  • nové partnerské příležitosti, které generují relevantní obchodní výsledky;

  • zavedený proces od prvotního posouzení po uvedení do provozu a následné měření výsledků;

  • funkční reporting výkonu partnerství a integrací;

  • méně ad-hoc eskalací díky jasným vlastníkům, dokumentaci a provozním procesům;

  • prokazatelný dopad na akvizici zákazníků, revenue, retenci nebo produktovou hodnotu.

    Konkrétní cíle a KPI nastavíme podle priorit Storyous v daném období. Mohou zahrnovat zejména:

  • kvalitu a vývoj partnerské pipeline;

  • počet a kvalitu leadů z partnerského kanálu;

  • obchodní výsledky a návratnost vybraných iniciativ;

  • aktivaci a využívání integrací;

  • rychlost uvedení prioritních iniciativ do provozu;

  • kvalitu provozu, podporu a spokojenost zákazníků i partnerů.

Co potřebuješ

Zkušenosti a odborné znalosti

  • Několik let zkušeností v business developmentu, partnerships, B2B sales, product partnerships, platform businessu nebo podobné komplexní roli.

  • Prokazatelnou zkušenost s vedením partnerství od prvního kontaktu až po dlouhodobý provoz.

  • Zkušenost s vyjednáváním obchodních podmínek a schopnost připravit i obhájit business case.

  • Praktickou zkušenost s projektovým řízením a koordinací více týmů bez přímé řídicí pravomoci.

  • Schopnost pracovat s daty, tabulkami a finančními modely.

  • Základní technické porozumění integracím a produktovému vývoji. Nemusíš být developer/ka, ale musíš umět technické téma pochopit, rozebrat a dotáhnout.

  • Zkušenost z fintechu, SaaS, payments, hospitality, retailu nebo podobného prostředí je výhodou.

    Osobnost a způsob práce

  • Jsi samostatný/á, iniciativní a umíš si vytvořit vlastní plán práce.

  • Přemýšlíš obchodně, ale rozhoduješ se na základě dat a návratnosti.

  • Umíš být důsledný/á a dostatečně „pushy“, když projekt potřebuje posunout.

  • Dokážeš vést jednání s externím partnerem i interně prosadit potřebné rozhodnutí.

  • Umíš pracovat s nejasností, rozdělit komplexní problém na konkrétní kroky a dotahovat věci do konce.

  • Komunikuješ jasně, věcně a přizpůsobíš styl různým stakeholderům.

  • Nečekáš, až ti někdo předá hotový proces — umíš ho navrhnout, zavést a průběžně zlepšovat.

Jazyky

  • Plynulá čeština nebo slovenština.

  • Dobrá pracovní angličtina pro jednání s partnery a spolupráci v rámci Teya

    Co nabízíme

  • Seniorní roli s reálným vlivem na produkt, obchodní výsledky a další směr Storyous.

  • Možnost vlastnit agendu od strategie a business case až po realizaci a měřitelný výsledek.

  • Spolupráci s Commercial, Product, Engineering a Operations týmy v Česku i v rámci Teya.

  • Hybridní režim práce a flexibilitu.

  • Férovou fixní mzdu a motivující bonusovou složku.

  • 26 dní dovolené a 3 sick days.

  • Interní integrovaný Glean AI k vyhledávání informací v rámci celé společnosti s využitím nejmodernějších LLM

  • Přístup k Elredo audioknihovně

  • BenefitPlus kartu

  • Pravidelné týmové setkání v Praze a prostředí, kde se očekává iniciativa, otevřenost a odpovědnost.

Proč právě Storyous a Teya?

Storyous je součástí Teya — technologického partnera lokálních podniků v Evropě. Naším cílem je zjednodušovat každodenní provoz našich zákazníků prostřednictvím integrovaného softwaru, plateb a služeb, které jim pomáhají růst.

V této roli budeš mít příležitost ovlivnit, s kým Storyous spolupracuje, jaké služby zákazníkům nabídne a jak se tyto služby obchodně i produktově promítnou do našeho řešení. Je to role pro člověka, který nechce pouze spravovat existující vztahy, ale chce vytvořit fungující systém propojující partnerství, integrace a růst merchant base.

Náborový proces

Proces chceme držet rychlý a férový. V jednotlivých kolech se potkáš s lidmi, kteří budou hodnotit zejména:

  • schopnost rozpoznat a vyhodnotit obchodní příležitost;

  • kvalitu uvažování o partnerském a integračním modelu;

  • schopnost vést komplexní iniciativu napříč týmy;

  • způsob vyjednávání a práce s externími stakeholdery;

  • schopnost převzít ownership a dotahovat výsledek.

jobs.description:
At Greenbrier, we do the hard work that matters. The Greenbrier Companies (NYSE:GBX) is powering the movement of products around the world as a leading designer, manufacturer and supplier of freight rail transportation equipment and services.

Greenbrier’s heritage of hard work and industrial innovation is celebrated at every level of our organization. We structure our business to support teams that deliver innovative solutions for our customers while positively impacting the world around us.

Greenbrier’s success begins with people. We believe in supporting our global workforce through our unwavering attention to Safety, Quality, Respect for People and Customer Satisfaction. Our Inclusion, Diversity, Engagement, Access and Leadership (IDEAL) commitment is rooted in these values, which lead to a culture where employees are engaged and feel good about coming to work every day.

Summary

The Senior Internal Audit Manager develops and leads a team of internal audit professionals in executing Greenbrier’s global risk-based internal audit plan, including operational, compliance, financial, and technology audits, to ensure consistent application of the Institute of Internal Auditors’ Global Internal Audit Standards and industry best practices.

Duties and Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully an individual must be able to perform the following essential duties satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned to address business needs and changing business practices.

  • Assist with the development of the annual risk-based internal audit plan by conducting risk assessment interviews with key stakeholders and analyzing risk factors including, but not limited to, likelihood, significance, velocity of change, and susceptibility to fraud.
  • Review engagement level risk assessments and scope. Review audit programs, flowcharts, test plans, and audit reports to ensure high-quality deliverables that are consistent with the IIA’s Global Internal audit Standards and industry best practices.
  • Validate reportable issues, consult on management action plans, and maintain an up-to-date status report.
  • Prepare clear and concise audit reports, summarizing findings, recommendations, and management responses.
  • Manage and provide timely feedback to team members, in support of high-quality deliverables and professional development. Develop internal audit team staff and provide coaching and feedback to team members.
  • Build effective working relationships with business and functional partners and ensure stakeholders are kept informed of audit status. Collaborate with business and functional partners to identify value-add opportunities through streamlining processes, improving efficiency, reducing cost, and increasing control effectiveness.
  • Implement procedures and templates to track internal audit activities and resources and to demonstrate adherence to professional standards.
  • Support and champion business transformation, automation and AI efforts as they are implemented at the Company and proactively lead such initiatives within the internal audit team.
  • Keep abreast of key initiatives at Greenbrier, within the manufacturing industry, and within the internal audit profession.
  • Perform special projects as directed by the Senior Director of Internal Audit, including occasional assistance with SOX compliance activities.

Qualifications

The following generally describes requirements to successfully perform the assigned duties.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, business, IT, or related field required; master’s degree desirable
  • CIA required; may be substituted with 10+ years of experience in internal audit plus commitment to complete certification within 1 year of start date
  • Other certifications such as CPA, CISA, CRMA and/or CFE are desirable
  • 10+ years of experience in internal audit, public accounting, or consulting with increasing responsibilities, including experience managing and developing teams; manufacturing or leasing experience preferred
  • Thorough understanding of professional standards and frameworks (e.g. Global Internal Audit Standards, COSO)
  • Experience preparing and reviewing process flowcharts, risk assessments, and audit work programs
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and IT control environments; technology audit experience desirable
  • Effective, concise, and persuasive verbal and written communications
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to gain respect and confidence of stakeholders at all levels from staff to senior management
  • Business mindset and strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Skill, ability, and flexibility to perform multiple tasks and functions including effective time management to meet deadlines and balance priorities
  • Proven background in being self-managed and self-motivated
  • Foreign language capability and/or experience working with international teams is desirable

Preferred Qualifications

  • Du hast nie ausgelernt, bis offen und neugierig für Neues und entwickelst dich gerne weiter: D.h. du hältst dich auf dem Laufenden, kannst dir neues Wissen kurzerhand selbst aneignen und nutzt Kritik und Feedback professionell zur Optimierung.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Engage directly with business stakeholders (warehouse operations, supply chain, field operations, inventory management) to gather, document, and validate business requirements
Author Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Design Documents (FDDs), and Configuration Design Documents (CDDs) for IM and EWM scope
Conduct fit-gap analysis between current-state warehouse and inventory processes and SAP S/4HANA standard capabilities
Define the functional design for inbound, outbound, internal, and inventory counting processes across IM-managed and EWM-managed warehouses
Design integration touch points between SAP EWM/IM and third-party systems (e.g. Maximo, MMA, STORMS, external WMS, transportation management, field mobility platforms)
Configuration and Build
Configure SAP S/4HANA Embedded EWM including warehouse structure (warehouse numbers, storage types, sections, bins, activity areas), putaway and stock removal strategies, wave management, resource and queue management, replenishment rules, and RF/mobile transaction framework
Configure SAP S/4HANA IM including plant and storage location setup, movement types, goods receipt/issue processing, physical inventory, batch management, and stock transfer processing
Configure the IM-to-EWM integration layer including distribution model, RFC connectivity, logical system assignments, and qRFC queue management
Design and configure integration interfaces with third-party systems — defining message formats, field mappings, transformation rules, error handling, and monitoring requirements in collaboration with the integration and technical teams
Testing and Validation
Develop Functional Unit Test (FUT) scripts for all configuration and RICEFW objects with detailed test scenarios, expected results, and traceability to functional design
Execute and support FUT, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles
Investigate and resolve functional defects, data issues, and integration failures during all testing phases
Validate end-to-end warehouse processes on RF/mobile devices including putaway, picking, packing, goods issue, physical inventory, and stock transfers
Integration and Interface Management
Own the functional design of interfaces between SAP IM/EWM and external systems — including file-based batch interfaces, API-based real-time integrations, and IDoc/middleware (SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft) message flows
Define validation rules, error handling logic, exception notification requirements, and rerun/recovery procedures for each interface
Collaborate with the integration team on SAP Integration Suite iFlow design, message mapping, and monitoring setup
Support the technical team in translating functional requirements into technical specifications for custom ABAP, CDS views, OData services, and enhancement implementations
Data Migration and Conversion
Define functional requirements for data migration of warehouse master data (product master, storage bins, warehouse structure) and inventory stock loading
Support stock conversion activities for EWM stock upload and LSMW/Migration Cockpit for batch master and material master loading
Define and execute reconciliation procedures (EWM vs S/4HANA stock checks, count comparisons) to validate data migration completeness and accuracy
Cutover and Go-Live Support
Participate in cutover planning and dress rehearsal activities for the IM and EWM workstream
Support go-live execution including final stock load, reconciliation sign-off, first MRP run, and warehouse operations readiness confirmation
Provide hypercare support post go-live — monitoring interfaces, resolving functional issues, and supporting business users during stabilisation
Team Coordination and Governance
Coordinate with offshore and onshore functional, technical, and integration team members to ensure delivery alignment
Track risks, dependencies, and action items for the IM/EWM workstream and escalate blockers proactively
Participate in programme governance forums including design authority reviews, status reporting, and issue resolution meetings
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
9+ years of SAP EWM functional experience including at least one full-cycle S/4HANA implementation or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration
Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Embedded EWM configuration — warehouse structure, process types, putaway/picking strategies, wave management, RF framework, and resource management
Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management — goods movements, stock types, batch management, physical inventory, and material valuation
Experience designing and supporting interfaces between SAP and third-party systems (WMS, field mobility, work order management, transportation)
Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, or SAP PI/PO middleware for interface design
Strong documentation skills — ability to author clear, structured BRDs, FDDs, CDDs, and FUT scripts
Experience working in large-scale programme environments with multiple workstreams, offshore/onshore delivery models, and formal governance
PREFERRED SKILLS
Experience with utilities, energy, or asset-intensive industries
Knowledge of SAP PM/EAM integration with EWM (work order-driven material demand)
Experience with ITS Mobile / RF device configuration for warehouse floor operations
Familiarity with SAP MRP (MRP Live, special procurement keys, stock transfer requisitions)
Experience with batch management and shelf-life handling in EWM
ABAP debugging awareness for functional troubleshooting

  • A diverse and inclusive global team with a strong culture focusing on employee health and wellbeing.
  • The possibility to make a positive contribution to our planet and use your world class marketing knowledge to set new standards in Renewable Energy.
