Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (U.S. based; must be available to work PST/MST hours)

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As In-House Counsel, you will serve as the company’s top legal advisor and a strategic business partner to the executive team, reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer. You will oversee all legal matters, including contracts, corporate governance, compliance, and risk mitigation, with a strong focus on construction law and commercial contracting. In this role, you will lead and develop our contracts function, managing the contracts team and partnering closely across Operations, Finance, Sales, and Executive Leadership. You will ensure we scale responsibly, protect the business, and operate with excellence and integrity while enabling speed and innovation. This is a unique opportunity to build and shape the legal infrastructure for a mission-driven, fast-growing climate-tech company protecting homes and communities from wildfire risk.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contracts Oversight: Oversee the company’s contracting function across construction, hardware procurement, and SaaS-enabled services. Set contracting standards, approval authority, templates, and negotiation positions; personally handle the highest-value and most complex agreements, including strategic partnerships; and serve as the final escalation point for the contracts team.
  • Legal and Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the company and its projects comply with local, state, and federal laws and regulations, including contractor licensing across multiple states, building codes, consumer protection, labor laws, and environmental standards. Assist with obtaining required permits and approvals.
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify potential contractual risks and liabilities, developing strategies to mitigate them through careful contract language and negotiation.
  • Dispute Resolution: Manage all claims, disputes, and litigation, working toward practical resolutions while protecting the company's interests. This includes selecting and directing outside counsel, managing legal spend, and leading the company's strategy in mediation, arbitration, and other proceedings.
  • Corporate Governance: Regularly review and update corporate legal documents and internal policies to ensure compliance with current legal and regulatory standards, mitigating risks. Involve stakeholders for feedback to align documents with organizational values and practices.
  • Employment: Advise HR and leadership on employment matters, agreements, and policies for a remote, multi-state workforce.
  • Privacy & Data: Oversee privacy and data protection compliance for the company’s connected monitoring software and customer data.
  • Consumer & Product Matters: Advise on homeowner-facing agreements, warranties, product liability exposure, and marketing and advertising claims.
  • Legal Function Leadership: Lead the legal and contracts department: developing automation and creating scalable processes for the team; manage outside counsel relationships.

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) Degree: must be obtained from an accredited institution, along with active membership and good standing with a state bar.
  • Minimum: 10 years of experience as a practicing attorney, including at least 3 years in-house
  • Must have proven experience in construction law, including understanding complex construction contracts, defect claims, and related legal issues.
  • Nice to have: Experience with IP; in-house experience at a high-growth or venture-backed company; supporting fundraising, M&A, or board matters; and consumer-facing product, warranty, or product liability matters
  • Contractual Skills: proven experience in negotiating and drafting complex contracts.
  • Leadership and Management: demonstrated experience managing attorneys or contracts professionals, directing outside counsel, and managing projects.
  • Communication Skills: exhibits exceptional written and verbal communication skills for engaging effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analytical and Strategic Thinking: capable of critically analyzing situations, proactively identifying potential risks, and developing effective solutions.
  • Business Acumen: possesses a solid understanding of the business dynamics and market trends specific to the construction industry.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $175,000 - $200,000 DOE + equity options
  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

  • Prove it works. Track followers, engagement, website traffic, inbound enquiries, RFQs and, ultimately, revenue generated by content.
  • Lead a small team. Manage and mentor a Junior Content/Social Media Coordinator, and coordinate freelance video and design talent.

Who you are

  • You have 5-8+ years of B2B content, editorial or thought leadership experience in a technical industry. Relevant areas include semiconductors, electronic components, data centres, AI infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing, aviation or similar.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to procurement, supply chain or the independent distribution market
  • Experience producing data-led reports or market research

This role is not for you if your main experience is scheduling posts and managing community comments. We need a strategist, storyteller and researcher first.

Why join

  • You'll report directly to the CEO, with real influence and a seat at the table.
  • You'll build a function from scratch, with a team and a budget behind you.
  • You'll get first-hand access to market intelligence most content professionals never see.

jobs.description:
We are looking for software engineers to join our development efforts in the area of sparse linear algebra kernels for high-performance libraries such as cuSPARSE and cuDSS. Around the world, leading commercial and academic organizations are revolutionizing AI, data analytics, and scientific and engineering simulations, using data centers powered by GPUs and high-performance linear algebra libraries. Applications of these technologies include computer aided engineering (CAE), electronic design automation (EDA), quantum chemistry, autonomous vehicles, LLMs, and countless others. Did you know our team develops the GPU accelerated libraries and SDKs that help make these possible?

In this role, you will work together with other developers on designing, developing, and optimizing kernels for various algorithms including basic sparse BLAS operations like matrix-vector-products and matrix-matrix-products, direct sparse solvers, iterative sparse solvers, preconditioners, and algebraic multigrid (AMG). Ideal candidates will not only have experience developing accelerated computing kernels, but also be motivated to advance the state-of-the-art in a variety of accelerated computing domains. If this sounds exciting, we would love to meet you!

What you will be doing:

  • Designing, implementing and optimizing scalable high-performance numerical sparse linear algebra software for existing and future GPU architectures

  • Working with library engineers, QA engineers, and interns on topics ranging from sparse BLAS operations to advanced direct and iterative sparse solvers

  • Working closely with product management and other internal and external partners to understand feature and performance requirements and contribute to the technical roadmaps of libraries

  • Finding and realizing opportunities to improve library quality, performance and maintainability through re-architecting and establishing innovative software development practices

What we need to see:

  • PhD or MSc degree (or equivalent experience) in Computational Science and Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related science or engineering field is preferred

  • 5+ years of overall experience in developing, debugging and optimizing high-performance sparse linear algebra software using C++ and parallel programming; ideally using CUDA, MPI, OpenMP, OpenACC, pthreads, or equivalent technologies

  • Strong fundamentals in floating point arithmetic and implementation of sparse linear algebra primitives like matrix-vector and matrix-matrix products

  • Experience in developing , maintaining, and testing sparse linear algebra libraries

  • Strong collaboration, communication, and documentation habits.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Good knowledge of CPU and/or GPU hardware architecture and low-level GPU performance optimization

  • Familiarity with technologies such as multi-frontal factorizations, iterative solvers, preconditioners, and algebraic multigrid

  • Experience with adopting and advancing software development practices such as CI/CD systems and project management tools such as JIRA

  • Understanding of large-scale computing technologies such as PDE solvers, eigenvalue solvers and time-domain simulation methods (e.g., CFD, FEA)

  • Working experience in a globally distributed and agile organization

NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing for science and engineering. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 218,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4.

jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a visionary, highly accomplished Senior Responsible AI Researcher to lead state-of-the-art research initiatives at the intersection of frontier models, Trust & Safety (T&S), model evaluation, and adversarial robustness.

In this role, you will bridge deep academic rigor with practical, real-world AI safety challenges. You will drive self-initiated research, design evaluation methodologies for emerging risks (e.g., persuasion, manipulation, sycophancy, agentic safety), and build safety benchmarks across Generative AI modalities (Text, Image, Multimodal, and Autonomous Agents). You will also serve as a key technical authority collaborating directly with top-tier AI labs, academic institutions, and enterprise partners.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontier AI Safety & Evaluation Research

  • Design, build, and deploy new evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and "Agentic Safety Gyms" to measure model capabilities, vulnerabilities, and alignment across diverse risk domains (e.g., Hate Speech, Misinformation, Elections Preparedness, IP/Copyright, Child Safety).
  • Develop advanced adversarial prompting methodologies, red-teaming strategies, and behavioral suites to stress-test Large Language Models (LLMs), Multimodal systems, and AI Agents.
  • Investigate emerging safety risks, including model persuasion, manipulation, sycophancy, bias, and jailbreaking tactics across multimodal and autonomous architectures.

2. Research Leadership & Outbound Impact

  • Lead high-impact collaborative research projects with external academic institutions (e.g., Oxford, Harvard, MATS, GovAI) and industry partners (e.g., OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic, Microsoft, Nvidia).
  • Represent the organization as a thought leader and speaker at top-tier international conferences, technical AI safety summits, and industry events.
  • Publish groundbreaking research findings in top AI and safety venues.

3. Strategic Client & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Go-To-Market (GTM), Policy and Delivery teams to translate research discoveries into scalable safety products, client-facing offerings, and delivery methodologies.
  • Engage directly with technical stakeholders and enterprise clients to translate complex safety and governance requirements into actionable research questions, experiments, and evaluation suites.

4. Mentorship & Team Augmentation

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior researchers, data scientists, and engineers.
  • Bridge interdisciplinary gaps by integrating social science, policy, and technical perspectives into robust safety tooling and methodologies.

Requirements

Must Haves:

﻿Education & Track Record

  • PhD in Science, Technology and Society Studies (STS), Machine Learning, AI Ethics, Social Data Science or a closely related research domain.
  • Proven Research Record: Demonstrated academic excellence with a strong portfolio of peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations at top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, IEEE, CVPR, or dedicated AI Safety conferences).

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Deep Domain Expertise: Substantial experience in AI Safety, Responsible AI (RAI), Trust & Safety, or Model Evaluation.
  • Technical Mastery: Strong hands-on capabilities in Python and modern ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Transformers).
  • Generative AI & Agentic Systems: Deep working knowledge of foundation models (LLMs, Text-to-Image, Multimodal), agents, reasoning systems, and current safety mitigation techniques.
  • Benchmarking & Methodology: Proven experience in designing datasets, benchmark suites, red-teaming protocols, or synthetic simulation platforms.

Mindset & Soft Skills

  • Ownership & Self-Starter Attitude: Proven track record of self-initiating research projects, bringing in external partnerships, and shaping technical vision.
  • Communication & Engagement: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, executives, and research peers.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Versatility: Ability to operate comfortably across technical data science, social science paradigms, and product execution.

﻿Preferred / Desirable Qualifications

  • Prior employment, consulting, advisory, or formal research collaboration with frontier AI labs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI) or leading safety research collectives (e.g., MATS, GovAI).
  • Experience in domain-specific safety applications, such as election integrity, psychological manipulation, or agentic behavioral safety suites.

About Alice

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

In a world where AI has fundamentally changed the nature of risk, Alice provides end-to-end coverage across the entire AI lifecycle. We support frontier model labs, enterprises, and UGC platforms with a comprehensive suite of solutions: from model hardening evaluations and pre-deployment red-teaming to runtime guardrails and ongoing drift detection.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

Data Scientist

Your Mission

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit & Analytics team at Teya and help build the models that underpin our lending products. You will support the development of the credit risk and pricing models that help us make better decisions for the small businesses we serve across multiple geographies.

You will work across the model lifecycle, from data exploration and feature development through to deployment and performance monitoring. Working alongside senior data scientists, you will learn how to develop models in a statistically sound way and see first-hand how they shape credit decisions, pricing and portfolio performance.

You will collaborate with Credit Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering and Data Engineering, building your understanding of how data science creates real business value. From day one, your work will contribute to live products used by our Members.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their data science career, with a quantitative background and a genuine interest in credit and lending, who wants to learn fast in a high-growth fintech.

Responsibilities

  • Model development: Build and test components of credit risk and pricing models, under guidance from senior team members.

  • Data exploration: Explore internal and external data sources, clean and prepare real-world datasets, and engineer features that could improve our models.

  • Analysis: Carry out analysis of merchant behaviour, repayment performance and product performance to answer well-defined business questions.

  • Model monitoring: Help track model performance, flag changes or drift, and support investigations into what is driving them.

  • Model deployment: Support Data Engineering with deploying models onto the ML Platform and integrating them into the credit decisioning system.

  • Documentation: Document your work clearly so models and analysis are easy to understand, review and build on.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering and Credit Strategy, and actively seek feedback from senior data scientists to develop your technical and commercial skills.

Requirements

  • Early in your data science career, with some experience in data science, quantitative analysis or a related field (including internships, research or substantial academic projects).

  • Degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • A grounding in statistics and an understanding of core machine learning techniques.

  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience handling and analysing real-world datasets.

  • Ability to explain analytical work clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curious, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a desire to understand how models drive business outcomes.

  • Eagerness to learn, take on feedback and grow within a collaborative team.

  • Exposure to credit risk modelling or financial services is a plus.

The Perks

  • Hybrid working: 4 days in our Central London office and 1 day from home. You choose which day you work from home, and you can change it whenever you need to.

  • We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Candidates must be located in the PST time zone and have flexible availability for some weekends and after hours work.

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will play a critical role in building the sales pipeline for Frontline Wildfire Defense. This role is responsible for engaging prospective customers, educating them about our system, qualifying opportunities, and scheduling appointments for the field sales team. The SDR will be the first point of contact for many customers and will represent our mission of protecting homes and communities with professionalism, energy, and empathy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively engage prospective customers via phone, email, text, and web chat to explain the Frontline Wildfire Defense system and address questions.
  • Conduct up to 10 consultations daily to educate customers, uncover needs, and secure commitment to move forward in the sales process.
  • Qualify leads using defined criteria and schedule appointments with the field sales team for further consultation.
  • Manage and nurture a pipeline of active, dormant, and cold leads through consistent outreach and personalized communication.
  • Meet follow-up service level agreements (SLAs) for new lead engagement to ensure no opportunities are missed.
  • Partner closely with field sales representatives to ensure a smooth and professional customer handoff.
  • Provide feedback to the sales leadership and field team regarding lead quality, customer trends, and process improvements.
  • Accurately track activities, document lead status, and update customer information in Zoho CRM.
  • Achieve or exceed key performance metrics, including number of consultations, appointments set, lead conversion rates, and response times.
  • Continuously develop knowledge of wildfire risk mitigation, home protection systems, and Frontline’s product offerings to better serve customers.

Performance Metrics

  • Daily/weekly number of consultations completed.
  • Number of qualified appointments set for the field sales team.
  • Lead engagement response time (SLA compliance).
  • Conversion rates from consultation to appointment.
  • CRM accuracy and completeness.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in sales development, inside sales, or a customer-facing role (preferably in technology, home services, or related industries).
  • Strong communication skills across phone, email, and text; able to build trust and credibility quickly.
  • Organized and disciplined with the ability to manage multiple leads, tasks, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working with sales tools and CRMs (Zoho experience preferred).
  • Resilient, goal-oriented, and motivated by hitting and exceeding performance targets.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, evolving environment and contribute to process improvements.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Company-provided cell phone and laptop
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible time off + 14 paid holidays (yes, your birthday is one of them!)
  • Work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup
  • Remote-first work environment, fostering work-life balance and autonomy
  • Company-provided equipment
  • Join a high-performing, mission-driven team doing work that truly matters
  • And much more!

Join Our Mission!

If you're excited about building technology that protects homes and families from wildfire disasters, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of a fast-growing team with purpose and innovation at its core.

Diversity and inclusion are essential values at Frontline. We know we'll do our best and most impactful work when we feel represented, and we belong. We encourage talented people from a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences to apply. jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are seeking an Alliance Partner Manager to lead the technical dimension of our alliances and partnering function for Luma, our AI-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence. Sitting at the intersection of business and engineering, you'll own how our platform connects with, integrates into, and creates value alongside the products of our strategic technology partners, such as Databricks and AWS.

This position is based in EMEA, working globally across time zones, with potential future expansion of channel partnerships into NAM. It is a senior role with broad scope, where you'll act as the bridge between partner engineering teams and our own product, engineering and commercial organizations, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales, as well as colleagues at Siemens, with room to design and build the technical alliance capability around you.

While the focus is strategic, this remains a hands-on role: you'll need enough technical depth to scope integrations credibly, validate them in sandboxes, and hold your own in a conversation with a partner's engineering team. We're looking for someone with an engineering-minded, "application scientist" type approach — comfortable understanding the technical requirements involved in onboarding a partner, and operating confidently within a large company mindset and environment.

In this role you will get to:

  • Define, build, and execute the technical partner strategy, prioritising which integrations and joint solutions to build, developing and implementing joint go-to-market plans (co-sell, co-build, co-deliver), aligning teams and facilitating sales enablement and training of partners.
  • Own engineering level relationships across partner organisations through effective communication, structured governance and business reviews, and joint business planning.
  • Scope integration feasibility early in partner conversations, translating vague partner asks into clear, buildable technical specifications and setting realistic expectations.
  • Oversee solution architecture, use-case mapping, partner product certification and sandbox / proof-of-concept development to design and validate joint solutions.
  • Engage partners to develop differentiated solutions through joint collaboration, market and competitive analysis, and the creation of joint marketing collateral.
  • Evangelise partnerships internally, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales stakeholders, and with colleagues at Siemens, feeding partner needs into the roadmap and organising collaborative events.
  • Define, track and analyse key partnership metrics, collaborating with partners to optimise performance, and represent Dotmatics/Siemens at alliance and partner conferences and events.
  • Focus specifically on systems integration partners, bringing on partners that will meaningfully increase the bottom line.

We are looking for candidate's who have 7+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, solution architecture or pre-sales engineering, including several years leading strategic technical partner or ISV relationships at enterprise scale. You've built integrations, not just managed them, and you can move fluently between a business review and a whiteboard session with a partner's engineers. You're comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy on complex, ambiguous pursuits, and you set realistic expectations that engineering can actually deliver on.

Just as importantly, you lead through influence. You can align engineering, marketing and sales teams, internally and across partner organisations, behind a shared plan without direct authority, and you're motivated by building a partnering function and team, not just running one. While not a traditional "sales" person, you're comfortable navigating sales-style conversations, combining technical knowledge with strong relationship management and communication skills.

Key Skills:

  • Technical partnership leadership - a proven track record defining and executing partner or alliance strategy with ISVs, technology platforms or system integrators, with measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue impact.
  • Hands-on integration fluency, including practical depth with APIs, authentication and data-exchange patterns, and the ability to scope, spec and validate integrations through sandboxes and proof-of-concept builds.
  • Joint go-to-market execution - experience developing co-sell, co-build and co-deliver plans, aligning internal and partner teams, facilitating sales enablement and creating the collateral that makes joint solutions land.
  • Executive-level relationship management - comfort owning senior stakeholder relationships across partner organisations, running structured business reviews (QBRs), and resolving conflict constructively when internal and partner priorities clash.
  • Data-driven partner management, with the habit of defining, tracking and analysing partnership KPIs and leading indicators of partner health and acting on them before issues escalate.

You may also have:

  • Experience with cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or OEM / embedded partnership motions.
  • Experience structuring and negotiating complex commercial and technical agreements alongside legal teams.
  • Familiarity with tiered partner certification programmes.
  • A background or interest in scientific, life-sciences or research software, or another domain-deep industry such as Oil & Gas or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist for our Integrated Risk Management team to help develop risk models and analytical frameworks that support key business decisions across credit, financial, and operational risk domains. In this role, you will work on complex quantitative challenges, build predictive and diagnostic models, and partner with stakeholders across the organization to improve risk visibility, portfolio performance, and decision-making.

Challenges that await you:

  • Develop and implement advanced statistical models for our credit portfolio at both per-account and aggregate levels to predict behavior and optimize performance
  • Create sophisticated Net Present Value (NPV) models and their core components on a per-account basis for our various credit products
  • Model critical financial metrics, including FX position, liquidity, reserves, and other balance sheet items to support robust financial management
  • Analyze and model not only expected outcomes but also their deviations, distributions, and uncertainty, recognizing the inherently probabilistic nature of financial and risk data
  • Design diagnostic and forecasting models that help identify, monitor, and mitigate risks across the organization
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to investigate model performance, understand deviations from expectations, and improve decision-making processes
  • Contribute to the development of quantitative methodologies and risk frameworks across credit, financial, and operational risk domains

What makes you a great fit:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or a related discipline
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Quantitative Analytics, Risk Modeling, or a similar role
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, probability theory, and uncertainty quantification
  • Experience developing predictive models and working with financial, risk, or other highly stochastic datasets
  • Strong proficiency in Python or R and experience with statistical and analytical libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels, Scikit-learn)
  • Experience with classical statistical methods, forecasting techniques, and modern machine learning approaches when appropriate
  • Experience modeling distributions, confidence intervals, and risk metrics rather than focusing solely on point estimates
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently drive analytical initiatives from problem definition to implementation
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Our ways of working:

  • Innovative Spirit: a commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions
  • Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication
  • Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community
  • Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together
  • High-Tech Environment: a team of smart and ambitious people who challenge the status quo of traditional finance

Our benefits:

  • Relocation support to one of our hubs — Mexico, Cyprus, Spain, Serbia, or Georgia — with assistance for the employee and their family

  • Healthcare Coverage

Overview

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be responsible for leading the strategic design, development, and maintenance of cutting-edge software systems for our healthcare SaaS platform. This role serves as a hands-on technical authority designing, coding, and scaling resilient AWS infrastructure and modern Agentic AI systems.

You will oversee large-scale projects, drive innovation, and collaborate with executive leadership to align technical solutions with business goals. You will lead the work of teams of Engineers working across departments within the organization.

Your work in guiding projects and teams helps assure that our solutions offer a high level of technical excellence with integrated, scalable, secure, well designed and automated modern engineering practices.

We create modern, efficient solutions for our customers using appropriate platforms. We do have some infrastructure in mainframe and mid-tier applications. You may be working in any of these areas, and we offer training to help hone your skills where needed.

Responsibilities

  • Leads the design and development of software applications and systems, ensuring architecture and product approvals are obtained and functional and non-functional requirements are addressed
  • Leads technical execution for autonomous AI agent integrations, LLM workflows, and multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI
  • Builds and champions production-grade CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and infrastructure-as-code practices using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation on AWS
  • Mentors senior engineers, conducts comprehensive code reviews, upholds code quality standards, guides technical team execution, and resolves complex architectural bottlenecks
  • Develops and implements high-quality, scalable, secure, and performant code using approved architectural patterns, coding standards, and enterprise engineering practices
  • Resolves complex technical issues through advanced troubleshooting, diagnosis, debugging, dependency analysis, and cross-team collaboration
  • Collaborates with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to define project scope, requirements, priorities, and timelines
  • Ensures software solutions comply with applicable healthcare industry standards, security expectations, regulatory requirements, and internal governance practices
  • Works as part of an Agile team, participates in Agile ceremonies, remains accountable for sprint deliverables, and supports disciplined SDLC execution
  • Drives continuous improvement, innovation, emerging technology adoption, regular upskilling, and knowledge sharing across the engineering organization
  • Participates in talent acquisition and performance management activities, including interviewing, candidate evaluation, goal setting, associate development, performance feedback, and review input
  • Provides technical direction across teams, influencing engineering standards, platform strategy, and architectural decisions without direct people-management authority

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Expert knowledge of cloud and DevOps engineering, including deep AWS expertise, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices
  • Proven ability to deploy Agentic AI models, autonomous AI agent integrations, LLM workflows, or multi-agent systems into production environments
  • Extensive experience with software engineering methodologies, Agile delivery practices, SDLC governance, and modern engineering best practices
  • Advanced full-stack development proficiency across user interface, middle tier, backend, APIs, integrations, and related technologies
  • Strong knowledge of modern software architecture, design patterns, scalability, resiliency, security, performance optimization, and non-functional requirements
  • Advanced knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including networking, compute platforms, storage, databases, middleware, systems management, and security practices
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale technical initiatives, estimate complex work, manage milestones, and guide technical teams through successful delivery
  • Strong leadership, mentoring, coaching, communication, and strategic planning skills, including the ability to influence senior engineers and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Exceptional problem-solving, analytical thinking, troubleshooting, debugging, and attention to detail in complex distributed systems environments
  • Ability to embrace emergent solutioning, iterative delivery, innovation, continuous improvement, and evolving technology trends, including AI-enabled engineering practices
  • Demonstrated responsiveness to internal and external customers, with the ability to balance technical excellence, business priorities, and stakeholder needs

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • We are a product company with legacy systems in use. Knowledge of mainframe and/or mid-tier applications programming (COBOL, ALC, DB2) and file utilities is preferred

Experience:

  • 8 years of experience in software engineering
  • 2 years of leadership experience, including leading teams and projects
  • Experience working with a complicated matrix of stakeholders
  • Proven track record of deploying Agentic AI models into production environments
  • Experience working with Public Clouds (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Required Training, Certification and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field or equivalent work experience

Preferred Training, Certification and Education:

  • Master’s degree in a related technical field

Working Conditions:

  • No travel required
  • Remote/Home Office
  • Must be able to use equipment at workstation for up to 8 hours daily

At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote, working from their home. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.

Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:

  • Choice of Blue Cross Blue Shield Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
  • Telehealthcare – for Medical and Behavioral visits

  • 9 Company holidays, a floating day off, and a day off for volunteering

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Scientist – Translational Safety & Risk Sciences (TSRS)

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead efforts to develop and integrate modern data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and visualization capabilities to support New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) and broader translational safety initiatives across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of discovery biology, nonclinical safety, NAMs, and translational medicine, requiring strong technical expertise combined with scientific curiosity and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally.

You will partner closely with scientists across Amgen and data engineering groups to develop a scalable, connected, and insight-driven data ecosystems for NAMs, upon which AI/ML can be applied, that will accelerate decision-making across Amgen Research.   • Develop and implement databases and registries using tools such as Databricks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including scientific, data engineering, IT, and AI/ML teams to harmonize and standardize data structures across nonclinical and clinical safety domains
  • Define metadata standards and ontology mappings for model systems, assays, samples, readouts, validation status, and context of use
  • Support data governance, data quality, and reproducibility best practices across TSRS platforms
  • Conceptualize, design, and build interactive dashboards and visualizations using platforms such as Spotfire to enable AI-supported and data-driven decision-making
  • Translate complex scientific and technical concepts into clear visualizations and actionable insights for diverse stakeholders

  • Apply AI/ML approaches to support translational safety analyses, predictive modeling, and emerging NAMs applications

Doctorate degree PhD

  • Familiarity with NAMs, complex in vitro models, translational in vitro/in silico platforms, toxicology, and/or translational safety approaches

What we're building

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

Why join Shadow?

  • Product Ownership You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.

  • Shape the Engineering Culture You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.

  • Work with Challenger Consumer Brands Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

The agency behind the product

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).

The role

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

Core Tech & Tools

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL

  • Cloud & Infra: Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

  • ML/AI: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

What you'll do

  • Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.

  • Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.

  • Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.

  • Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.

  • Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.

  • Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.

  • Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.

  • Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.

  • Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

Must haves

  • Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.

  • Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.

  • Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.

  • Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.

  • A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.

  • Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.

  • Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.

  • Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private.

  • Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers.

Nice to haves

General Manager – Scotch Whisky Projects & Business Development

Company: Whiskey Cask Group
Industry: Scotch Whisky | Independent Bottling | Private Label | Luxury Spirits
Location: UK or Dubai, UAE – Remote / Hybrid Working Available
Employment Type: Full-time or Consultancy (depending on experience)
Seniority: Senior Management
Remuneration: Competitive package based on experience, with performance-related incentives

About Whiskey Cask Group

Whiskey Cask Group is a specialist Scotch whisky business focused on developing exclusive whisky products and bespoke bottling programmes for private clients, corporate customers and international brands.

Our services include private-label Scotch whisky, limited-edition bottlings, corporate gifting, exclusive cask projects and premium whisky collections.

We work with established industry partners to manage everything from whisky sourcing and product development to bottling, packaging and international delivery.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced whisky industry professional to help manage our commercial activities, develop new business opportunities and oversee the successful delivery of client projects.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced General Manager – Scotch Whisky Projects & Business Development to play a key role in growing Whiskey Cask Group.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining business development, project management, supplier relationships and general business operations.

We are particularly interested in candidates who already have extensive experience within the Scotch whisky industry and an established network of contacts across distilleries, independent bottlers, cask suppliers and specialist production partners.

The successful candidate will be comfortable managing the complete lifecycle of a whisky project, from identifying a commercial opportunity and developing a proposal through to coordinating production and final delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone with genuine whisky industry knowledge who can combine commercial thinking with practical project delivery and operational management.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Commercial Growth

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with private clients, corporate customers, luxury brands and international partners.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients and commercial projects.
  • Develop proposals, commercial pricing and project budgets.
  • Manage client relationships from initial enquiry through to contract negotiation and delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, new products and international expansion.
  • Support the directors in developing and implementing the company's commercial strategy.

Whisky Sourcing & Industry Relationships

  • Maintain and develop relationships with Scotch whisky distilleries, independent bottlers, cask brokers and suppliers.
  • Source appropriate whisky stocks and bottling solutions for bespoke client projects.
  • Coordinate with bottling facilities, packaging suppliers, designers and logistics partners.
  • Negotiate pricing, production schedules and commercial agreements.
  • Identify reliable partners capable of delivering premium-quality whisky products.

Private Client & Bespoke Whisky Projects

  • Manage bespoke whisky projects from concept to completion.
  • Work directly with clients to understand their requirements, budgets and expectations.
  • Coordinate whisky selection, bottling, labelling, packaging and product presentation.
  • Oversee production schedules, supplier performance and quality control.
  • Manage project budgets, timelines and profitability.
  • Coordinate international fulfilment, export documentation and specialist delivery requirements.

General Management & Operations

  • Support the day-to-day commercial and operational management of Whiskey Cask Group.
  • Develop efficient processes for managing projects, suppliers and customers.
  • Monitor financial performance, project costs and commercial margins.
  • Manage multiple client projects and business development opportunities simultaneously.
  • Provide regular progress reports and commercial updates to the directors.
  • Help establish the systems, partnerships and operational infrastructure required to scale the business.

Essential Experience & Skills

Direct experience within the Scotch whisky industry is essential for this position.

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate:

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience within the Scotch whisky industry.
  • An established professional network within the bottling, distilling, whisky sourcing or independent bottling sectors.
  • Experience developing or managing private-label, bespoke bottling or exclusive whisky projects.
  • Strong commercial and business development capabilities.
  • Proven project management and supplier coordination experience.
  • Understanding of whisky production, sourcing, bottling, packaging and associated commercial costs.
  • Excellent client relationship management and negotiation skills.
  • Strong organisational and financial management capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and take ownership of business activities.

Desirable Experience

Additional experience in the following areas would be advantageous:

  • Independent Scotch whisky bottling businesses.
  • Private cask ownership and bespoke bottling programmes.
  • High-net-worth individuals and luxury private clients.
  • Corporate gifting and premium branded whisky programmes.
  • International whisky distribution and export.
  • Product development, packaging and brand creation.
  • Managing specialist bottling and international fulfilment partners.
  • Experience growing or managing a small or medium-sized whisky business.

Location & Flexible Working

We recognise that experienced whisky industry professionals may be based in different locations.

This role offers flexibility, including the opportunity to work remotely from Dubai, UAE, or the United Kingdom.

The IT Support Technician provides the first point of contact between internal staff and the Corporate IT department.   • Liaise with local/global vendors and suppliers
  • Support and manage company phone devices predominantly within EMEA while supporting other regions as required. Support the ordering and setup of devices as per company standards and liaise with phone carrier vendors, as and when required
  • Interpret data and analyze results with the intention of sharing information related to IT Service tickets, and suggest opportunities to reduce ticket volume and enhance service
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of documentation & Knowledge Base articles regarding IT processes, systems, and issues, with the intention of promoting self-service.
  • Participating in the weekend On-Call L1 support rota and respond outside of business hours where necessary
  • Respond to P1 calls during regular business hours on weekdays as required
  • Deliver end-user training on IT Services where necessary
  • International travel, including travel within EMEA may be required on an ad hoc basis to support the business, a valid passport is required.
  • Other duties as required

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 3-5 years of IT Service Desk experience providing remote end-user support across multiple locations.
  • Post-secondary education (degree or diploma) in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • ITIL, A+, Network+, and/or MCSA certifications are considered an asset.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply sound judgment in resolving technical and operational challenges.
  • Strong customer service skills with experience assessing end-user requests, delivering effective solutions, and communicating technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to build rapport and collaborate effectively with fellow technicians and end-users.
  • Strong experience working with ticketing and self-service platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Strong experience supporting enterprise technologies, including Windows and Mac OS, Active Directory, BitLocker, VPN, Okta, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, RDP, cloud solutions, Intune MDM, and OS patch management; experience with Exchange Online is an asset.

#ntryLevel, #Fresher, #Associate

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner Part Time - Kirksville

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part-time Nurse Practitioner to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:
  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Unser Point-of-Care-Diagnoseportfolio umfasst wichtige Gesundheits- und Therapiebereiche, darunter Infektionskrankheiten, Kardiometabolische Erkrankungen und Toxikologie.

Unsere diagnostischen Lösungen werden in Krankenhäusern, Laboren und Kliniken rund um den Globus eingesetzt. Die entscheidenden Informationen, die aus unseren Tests und Instrumenten gewonnen werden, sind oft der erste Schritt bei der Entscheidungsfindung in der Patientenversorgung für Hunderte von Gesundheitszuständen, von Herzinfarkten über Blutkrankheiten bis hin zu Infektionskrankheiten.

  • Identifikation, Analyse und adressatengerechte Darstellung von Kundenherausforderungen und Geschäftspotenzialen, mit dem Ziel langfristige, strategische Partnerschaften von nationaler Bedeutung aufzubauen und abzusichern

The Vice President, Quality & Accreditation is the enterprise executive accountable for clinical quality performance across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial. This role owns HEDIS strategy and operations, accreditation (NCQA, URAC, and applicable state/federal standards), clinical quality programs, and the vendor ecosystem that supports HEDIS data collection, abstraction, and reporting.

This executive unifies quality functions historically siloed by line of business into a single operating model, ensuring consistent measurement, documentation, and improvement practices across Medicare and Commercial populations.

The role is accountable for HEDIS rates and audit results, accreditation status and survey outcomes, clinical quality program performance, and vendor ecosystem governance and cost.

Key Responsibilities:
Enterprise Quality Leadership & Operating Model
• Build a unified quality operating model across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial.
• Establish enterprise governance for clinical documentation integrity supporting quality measurement.
• Serve as the executive owner of enterprise HEDIS performance and accreditation status.
• Oversee all HEDIS operations, hybrid strategy, supplemental data, and provider documentation improvement, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Develop best-in-class intervention playbooks for each HEDIS measure.

Clinical Quality

  • Lead enterprise clinical quality programs, including quality improvement initiatives, clinical practice guideline adoption, and provider quality performance programs.
    • Ensure alignment with care management and population health functions on shared clinical priorities.
    • Partner with COO, CFO, Network, Pharmacy, Stars, Risk Adjustment, and Operations leadership to ensure quality initiatives are coordinated enterprise-wide without assuming accountability for their respective programs.
    Accreditation
    • Own enterprise accreditation strategy and execution, including NCQA Health Plan Accreditation, URAC, and other applicable state and federal accreditation or certification requirements.
    • Lead survey readiness, documentation, and corrective action planning for all accreditation activities.
    • Maintain accreditation standards as they evolve and ensure organizational readiness for renewal cycles.
    HEDIS Vendor Ecosystem Leadership
    • Serve as the executive owner of the vendor ecosystem supporting HEDIS data collection, medical record retrieval, abstraction, and supplemental data.
    • Consolidate and manage HEDIS vendors to reduce cost, improve data quality, and strengthen audit defensibility.
    • Establish unified SLAs, KPIs, and performance governance for HEDIS-related vendors.
    • Ensure vendors operate as extensions of the internal quality team.
    Quality Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
    • Ensure data quality, timeliness, and integration across clinical, operational, and vendor systems supporting quality measurement.
    • In partnership with Health Services Analytics, build a unified reporting architecture for HEDIS, accreditation, and clinical quality programs.
    Governance & Compliance
    • Ensure compliance with NCQA, URAC, and applicable regulatory requirements governing quality and accreditation.
    • Lead enterprise audit readiness for HEDIS and accreditation surveys.
    • Establish governance structures for decision-making, escalation, and cross-functional alignment on quality matters.

Key Requirements:
• 10+ years of leadership experience in health plan Quality, HEDIS, and Accreditation, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.
• Proven track record of improving HEDIS rates and achieving strong NCQA/URAC accreditation outcomes.
• Deep knowledge of HEDIS technical specifications, NCQA accreditation standards, and clinical quality improvement methodology.
• Experience leading large cross-functional teams and complex vendor ecosystems, particularly HEDIS data and abstraction vendors.
• Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, ROI analysis, and budget management.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive enterprise-wide change.
• Master's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.

General Physical Demands: Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
    • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
    • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
    • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
    • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
    • Additional voluntary benefits available; and

• A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Job Description

Who We Are

Horizon Media, founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg, is recognized as one of the most innovative marketing and advertising firms. Headquartered in New York City, with offices in Los Angeles and Toronto, Horizon is known for its data-driven approach, highly personal client service, and people-first culture. We hire talented thinkers, doers, dreamers, and makers, challenge them, and give them opportunities to grow.


Job Summary

The Application Support Specialist, Canada Media Applications is a temporary role providing hands-on Level 1 and Level 2 support as Horizon Canada transitions to and stabilizes within a Horizon-managed Mediaocean environment. Reporting to the VP, Business Operations, this role will support the Canadian business from implementation and cutover through production stabilization and ongoing operations.

The role will partner across Canada Media Operations, Finance, Business Operations, Shared Services, Financial Systems, Technology, Security, and external providers. The successful candidate will combine application-support discipline with practical knowledge of media planning, buying, billing, reconciliation, master data, access, reporting, and integrations.


What You'll Do

Day-to-Day Application Support & Service Management

  • Primary Support: Serve as the primary application support resource and day-to-day liaison for Horizon Canada across Mediaocean Prisma, Spectra Digital, Spectra Linear, OX, and other supported media applications.
  • Incident, Request & Queue Management: Manage Level 1 and Level 2 incidents, service requests, problems, and escalations in ServiceNow from intake through closure, including prioritization, documentation, ownership, user updates, and SLA adherence.
  • Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot campaign setup, workflow, configuration, billing, reconciliation, master data, reporting, integration, authentication, and user-access issues; document findings and coordinate escalation when needed.
  • Vendor Coordination: Coordinate resolution with Mediaocean, internal application owners, Technology teams, Edenred / IPS, and other vendors or partners.
  • Problem Management: Identify recurring incidents and root causes, document support risks, and coordinate preventive or corrective action.

Canada Implementation, Conversion & Stabilization Support

  • Implementation Readiness: Participate in implementation and transition working sessions and translate Canadian operational needs into executable setup, configuration, data, access, testing, and support activities.
  • Master Data Readiness: Support the review, validation, cleanup, preparation, and controlled loading of users, clients, products, suppliers, vendors, remit and pay-to relationships, stations, publications, security roles, and other required master data.
  • Testing & Validation: Develop and execute test scenarios and support integration testing, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, retesting, and business validation across planning, buying, billing, reconciliation, reporting, and downstream interfaces.
  • Integration Support: Monitor and help troubleshoot application and data-flow issues across Mediaocean, integrations, NetSuite interfaces, Edenred / IPS workflows, and related reporting or financial processes; route functional and technical issues to the correct owner.
  • Cutover & Hypercare: Support cutover planning, production readiness, go-live, hypercare, issue triage, production validation, and stabilization until the Canadian environment is operating reliably.

Application Administration, Access & Controls

  • User Administration: Provision, modify, and deprovision approved users, roles, permissions, user groups, security profiles, and licenses across supported applications.
  • Access Governance: Support periodic access reviews, licensing audits, segregation-of-duties reviews, evidence collection, and remediation of access inconsistencies.
  • Configuration Support: Maintain approved application settings and configuration documentation and coordinate controlled changes with application owners and vendors.
  • Operational Controls: Follow established change and production support controls and maintain complete audit trails for support, configuration, and access activities.

Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Knowledge Management: Maintain SOPs, support procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guidance, user instructions, known-error documentation, and escalation paths.
  • Support Reporting: Maintain reporting on ticket volume, aging, SLA performance, escalations, recurring issues, and application health.
  • Release Support: Participate in releases, upgrades, patches, configuration changes, maintenance activities, and post-release production validation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Recommend improvements to service quality, data integrity, operational efficiency, user experience, and production stability.

Who You Are

  • Hands-On and Accountable: You are comfortable working directly in applications, managing tickets, following issues through resolution, and maintaining ownership of commitments.
