jobs.title: Vice President, Global Manufacturing
jobs.excerpt: Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders.
jobs.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare and difficult-to-treat diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity. Rezolute’s lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage clinical development for the treatment of hypoglycemia due to congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI).

Position Description: Overview

A key member of Rezolute’s Technical Operations Leadership team, the Vice President, Global Manufacturing has the mandate to provide the vision, leadership, strategy and management skills to build, lead and oversee Rezolute’s fully externalized, global biologics manufacturing network, from cell line through Drug Product. The role is accountable for the reliable, robust and redundant manufacture of ersodetug in support of late-phase clinical supply, global submissions, approval, launch and continuous commercial supply.

The Vice President, Global Manufacturing will build and lead executive-level relationships across the global service provider network, engaging both at the Site Head level and with above-site executive leadership to influence and resolve capability, capacity, reliability and readiness. The position reports to the Senior Vice President, Operations (and Head of Technical Operations), and works daily in partnership with the Head of Quality and the Vice President, Global Supply Chain to deliver one seamless manufacture and supply platform, while acting as a pivotal source of information for the RZLT Management Team and Board of Directors. This role may be performed remotely within the US.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities Include:

    • Charged with designing, developing and implementing the transition of Rezolute’s clinically oriented manufacturing operations toward a robust, reliable and redundant commercial manufacturing network, positioned to support global markets. In this, the organization must maintain its agile operational capability while installing the rigor necessary to meet market demand through a fully externalized network of service providers.

    • Accountable for all externalized manufacturing from cell line through Drug Product, including cell line development, cell bank manufacture and maintenance, Drug Substance manufacture and Drug Product (aseptic fill-finish) manufacture, across a global network of qualified service providers.

    • Accountable for the storage and depot facilities supporting the manufacturing network, including cell banks, Drug Substance and Drug Product held within the manufacturing network. Accountability for Drug Product transfers to the Global Supply Chain upon shipment of Drug Product from the manufacturing site.

    • Accountable for the manufacturing elements of the current Plan of Record, inclusive of Drug Substance and Drug Product supporting two advanced P3 programs, now pre-BLA enabled and preparing for potential launches globally.

    • Owns the Manufacturing Plan as a byproduct of the S&OP process led by the Global Supply Chain. Translates the consensus supply plan into Drug Substance and Drug Product campaign schedules, capacity reservations, slot commitments and critical materials plans; provides capacity, constraint and risk input to S&OP.

    • Builds and sustains executive relationships with each service provider at the Site Head level and with above-site executive leadership, leveraging these relationships to influence priority, capacity and investment, and to resolve capability, reliability and readiness issues.

    • Applies a tiered governance structure with each service provider (operational, site leadership and executive steering) to drive open, contemporaneous and clear understanding of conduct of work, costs, risks and deliverables, with defined escalation paths.

    • Develops and executes the global manufacturing network strategy, including redundancy, second-source and dual-site strategies for Drug Substance and Drug Product, business continuity planning and long-term manufacturing solutions aligned with corporate strategy and evolving goals.

    • Accountable for the robustness and reliability of manufacture; establishes and manages service provider performance to Right First Time and On Time In Full expectations through defined KPIs, routine performance review and corrective action.

    • Accountable for identification and mitigation of risks to the manufacture and supply of Drug Substance and Drug Product; routinely assesses risks within the span of control, creates and implements effective mitigation plans, escalating as appropriate.

    • Builds and leads a Manufacturing Technical team to support routine manufacture, including person-in-plant oversight, campaign technical monitoring, batch record and process performance review, and technical leadership of deviation and investigation resolution at service providers.

    • Builds redundant, reliable capability across the manufacturing platform, enabling site transfers through to registration by establishing the service provider relationship and leading program, contract and deliverable management. Partners with the MSAT team within Quality, which owns technical specification, characterization, qualification and validation, and Module 3 authorship.

    • Leads the team to collaboratively (Quality, MSAT and the Technical Operations Leadership) resolve deviations, investigations and CAPAs, enabling on-time, reliable supply.

    • Supports global submissions and pre-approval inspection readiness at service providers in concert with Quality and Regulatory teams.

    • Works as part of a broader Technical Operations Leadership team, striving for open, honest communication and collaboration.

    Areas of specific responsibility include:

    • Build, lead, manage and develop a best-in-class, high-performance, phase-appropriate team, including external manufacturing leads for Drug Substance and Drug Product, cell line and cell bank management, manufacturing planning and the Manufacturing Technical team.

    • Build phase-appropriate manufacturing systems, procedures and governance for service provider oversight, manufacturing planning, performance management and executive escalation.

    • Work diligently with the Head of Quality to maintain seamless integration with all aspects of the Quality team, including batch disposition support, deviation and change control, supplier qualification and audits, and inspection readiness; support the Head of Quality with respect to registrational compliance evaluation and ongoing release of drug.

    • Partner with the Vice President, Global Supply Chain to ensure a seamless handoff of Drug Product from the manufacturing network to the global supply chain, and alignment between the Manufacturing Plan and the FDP supply plan.

    • Ensure the management of all financial aspects of manufacture, including contracts, budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, capacity commitments and Cost of Goods for Drug Substance and Drug Product.

    • Lead development of relationships and contracting with service providers, including master services, supply, capacity reservation and technical agreements; ensure all manufacturing agreements are effectively negotiated to meet the near- and long-term needs of Rezolute in a cost-efficient manner, as agreed with Legal, Finance, Quality and functional heads.

    • Coordinate the selection and oversight of service providers and suppliers of critical raw materials, consumables and primary components for Drug Substance and Drug Product.

    • Work cross-functionally to identify product lifecycle needs (e.g., scale, presentation and line changes), enabling feasibility and implementation in concert with MSAT, product and corporate strategy.

    • Review technical documentation and summaries to ensure sound rationale, conformance with regulations and existing approvals, and challenge where appropriate the effectiveness of these documents to deliver on the intended purpose.

Qualifications/Requirements - We are looking for a candidate with:

    • B.S. in Engineering, Life Sciences or related field is required; advanced degree preferred.

    • 15+ years of biologics manufacturing experience within biotech/biopharmaceutical organizations, including 5–7+ years in senior leadership with demonstrated executive experience at the Vice President or Executive Director level.

    • Demonstrated hands-on experience building an external manufacturing function, its systems, procedures and team, in the context of a late phase to commercial biotech; Rare Disease experience highly preferred.

    • Expertise in monoclonal antibody Drug Substance and aseptic fill-finish Drug Product manufacturing required; technical awareness of cell line development preferred.

    • Commercial launch experience required, including PPQ, BLA/MAA submission support, pre-approval inspection readiness and transition to commercial supply.

    • Track record of executive relationship management with CDMOs, at the Site Head level and above-site, resulting in resolution of capacity, capability and reliability issues.

    • Demonstrated experience establishing manufacturing redundancy, second-source or dual-site supply for biologics.

    • Experience negotiating master services, supply and capacity reservation agreements.

    • Comfort in leading through influence, acting with agility, leading problem solving and driving toward robust solutions; communication is a critical strength, demonstrated at all levels of the organization; sense of humor and humility are essential.

    • Position may require morning, evening and/or weekend commitments as the RZLT team is spread across the US, and service providers are located offshore.

    • Position requires domestic and international travel (up to 50%).

    Preferred Experience, Special Skills and Knowledge - We are looking for a candidate that has:

    • Experience with multiple CDMO networks across the US, EU and Asia.

    • Board- and executive-level communication of manufacturing risk and strategy.

    • Act with HONOR: Honesty, Open with Direct Communication, Nimbleness, Open-minded, Respect.

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for the Vice President, Global Manufacturing role could range from $290,000 to $340,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience and geographical location of the selected candidate.

Rezolute offers competitive compensation, stock options and a rich benefits package.

Qualifying employees are eligible to participate in benefit programs such as:

  • Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision)

  • Disability, Life & Long-Term Care Insurance

  • Holiday Pay

  • Tracking Free Vacation Program

  • 401(k) Plan Match

  • Educational Assistance Benefit

  • Fitness Center Reimbursement

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against applicants due to race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status

  • Collaborative team skills in a remote environment

  • Excellent record keeping

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

We are hiring a Bilingual Medical Virtual Assistant to support an Internal Medicine practice. This role requires someone with strong English and Spanish communication skills, especially over the phone, since a large part of the work involves speaking directly with patients, coordinating appointments, handling follow-ups, and keeping communication clear and professional.

This is a patient-facing support role that directly affects clinic flow, patient experience, and day-to-day operational efficiency. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, confident on calls, and able to manage scheduling, insurance-related tasks, and administrative follow-through with accuracy.

Top Requirements

  • Strong bilingual communication skills in both English and Spanish

  • Confident and professional on phone calls

  • Strong patient coordination and scheduling ability

  • High attention to detail and reliable follow-through

Key Responsibilities

1) Phone Calls and Patient Communication

  • Handle a high volume of inbound and outbound phone calls with patients, pharmacies, payer offices, and other healthcare contacts

  • Communicate clearly and professionally in both English and Spanish

  • Provide appointment reminders, follow-up calls, rescheduling support, and general patient assistance

  • Answer routine patient questions and escalate concerns appropriately

  • Maintain a calm, patient-friendly tone, especially when dealing with elderly patients or complex situations

2) Appointment Scheduling and Patient Coordination

  • Manage new and existing patient scheduling through phone, email, and text

  • Maintain provider calendars accurately and help prevent gaps, overlaps, or scheduling errors

  • Confirm appointments and manage cancellations, reschedules, and waitlist coordination

  • Conduct pre-visit outreach and communicate next steps clearly to patients

  • Ensure accurate patient demographics, appointment notes, and call outcomes are documented in the system

3) Insurance Verification and Benefits

  • Verify patient eligibility and benefits before appointments

  • Confirm copays, deductibles, covered services, and authorization requirements

  • Identify insurance issues early and communicate them clearly to patients and internal staff

  • Document verification results accurately in the EMR and any internal trackers

  • Escalate unresolved payer issues and follow through until completed

4) Referral and Prior Authorization Support

  • Process referral-related tasks and ensure required documents are complete

  • Initiate and follow up on prior authorization requests as needed

  • Track pending items, approvals, denials, and required follow-up actions

  • Coordinate with payer offices, provider offices, and internal team members to avoid delays

5) Administrative Support and Documentation

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and consistent documentation

  • Support daily administrative workflows such as inbox management, task queues, forms, uploads, and follow-up tracking

  • Handle patient information in a HIPAA-compliant manner

  • Provide status updates proactively and complete assigned tasks with minimal follow-up

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Spanish

  • Previous experience handling phone calls in a patient-facing, customer-facing, or healthcare support role

  • Strong confidence speaking with patients over the phone, including appointment coordination and follow-up calls

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks accurately

  • Able to work independently and communicate updates clearly

  • Reliable computer setup, headset, and stable internet connection for remote work

  • HIPAA knowledge or experience with HIPAA-compliant workflows

Nice to Have

  • Clinical or healthcare background

  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems

  • Experience supporting internal medicine, primary care, or similar outpatient practices

Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

The Clinical Trial Coordinator (CTC) assists in the coordination and administration of the study activities from the start up to execution and close out, and within the Local Study Team (LST) to ensure quality and consistency of interventional study deliverables to time, cost and quality objectives.


CTCs might have different internal titles based on the experience level (CTC, Senior CTC). The experience level depends on the years of experience, performance record, level of independence to execute, ability to take on additional tasks or tutor more junior colleagues. The Director, Country Head may assign this internal title after confirmation with Senior Director, Cluster Head / Executive Director, Regional Head.


Typical Accountabilities

  • Assists in coordination and administration of clinical studies from the start-up to execution and close-out.
  • Collects, assists in preparation, reviews and tracks documents for the application process. Assists in timely submission of proper application/documents to EC/IRB and, where appropriate to Regulatory Authorities for the duration of the study.
  • Interfaces with Investigators, external service providers and CRAs during the document collection process to support effective delivery of a study and its documents.
  • Serves as local administrative main contact and works closely with the CRAs and/or the LSAD for the duration of the study.
  • Operational responsibility for the correct set-up and maintenance of the local eTMF and ISF including document tracking in accordance with ICH-GCP and local requirements.
  • Ensures essential documents under their responsibility are uploaded in a timely manner to maintain the eTMF “Inspection Readiness”.
  • Ensures that all study documents are ready for final archiving and completion of local part of the eTMF and supports the CRA in the close out activities for the ISF.
  • Contributes to the production and maintenance of study documents, ensuring template and version compliance.
  • Creates and/or imports clinical-regulatory documents into the Global Electronic Management System (e.g. ANGEL) ensuring compliance with the client Authoring Guide for Regulatory Documents.
  • Contributes to electronic applications/submissions by handling clinical-regulatory documents according to the requested technical standards i.e., Submission Ready Standards (SRS), supporting effective publishing and delivery to regulatory authorities.
  • Sets-up, populates and accurately maintains information in client tracking and communication tools (e.g. CTMS such as VCV, SharePoint, etc) and supports others in the usage of these systems (with the exception of countries where there is a specific role dedicated to set up and update the systems).
  • Prepares and/or supports contract preparation at a site level (with the exception of countries where there is a specific role dedicated to preparing site contracts).
  • Prepares/supports/performs Health Care Organisations (HCO)/Health Care Professionals (HCP) payments in accordance with local regulations.
  • Manages and contributes to coordination and tracking of study materials and equipment.
  • Coordinates administrative tasks during the study process, audits and regulatory inspections, according to company policies and SOPs.
  • Leads the practical arrangements and contributes to the preparation of internal and external meetings e.g., study team meetings, Monitors’ meetings, Investigators’ meetings. Liaises with internal and external participants and/or vendors, in line with international and local codes.
  • Prepares, contributes to and distributes presentation material for meetings, newsletters and websites.
  • Responsible for layout and language control, copying and distribution of documents. Supports with local translation and spell checks in English to/from local language, as required.
  • Responsible for printing and distribution of documents such as letters and meeting minutes, and for handling and archiving of study/country related e-mails.
  • Interfaces with Data Management Centre and/or Data Management, Global Clinical Solutions representatives to facilitate the delivery of study related documents/material.
  • Ensures compliance with client’s Code of Ethics and company policies and procedures relating to people, finance, technology, security and SHE (Safety, Health and Environment).
  • Ensures compliance with local, national and regional legislation, as applicable.

Additional country-specific tasks might be added depending on local needs.

jobs.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Biologics
Biologics research is where molecular therapeutic discovery begins. Scientists are discovering and engineering proteins, antibodies, bispecifics, and other large molecule formats, then deciding which candidates are worth taking forward. They run huge numbers of experiments across assays, instruments, and teams. The data is rich but often not well organized, and the best candidates can get lost in the noise. Good decisions here shape everything that comes after.

We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Biologics research is a core part of our Molecule to Market story. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.

This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with biologics research leaders at pharma, biotech, and academic and government institutes, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to this market with confidence and one consistent story. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in biologics research. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win.

How you’ll spend your time

  • Customer engagements: meeting research leaders and scientists, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business
  • Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors, and spotting trends early
  • Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win
  • Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the biologics research audience
  • Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on AI driven discovery and the future of the research lab
  • Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get scientists using Luma and putting AI to work on their data
  • Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the biologics research market

The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to biologics research buyers, and turn that into real software adoption.

What you’ll do

  • Own the market growth strategy for Luma in biologics research, including antibody discovery, protein engineering, lead optimization, and developability
  • Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Biologics Research, Discovery Biology, Protein Sciences, Antibody Engineering, Research IT, and Lab Automation
  • Build positioning and messaging that speaks to bench scientists, research leaders, and executives
  • Drive software adoption by working with customers and field teams to find the workflows where Luma delivers value fastest, and by capturing what works so others can repeat it
  • Define and prove AI use cases for biologics research, including how scientists prepare, trust, and use their data with tools like NVIDIA BioNeMo
  • Translate research pain points into clear value, including faster design, build, test, and learn cycles, better capture of experimental context, easier sharing of data across teams, and cleaner handoffs into development
  • Partner with the Siemens Solution Marketing team to build content, campaigns, and events for the research market
  • Work with industry thought leaders, analysts, and partners to build credibility and bring outside voices into our story
  • Create the competitive view against other informatics vendors, point solutions, and in house builds
  • Develop the business case, pricing inputs, and value story with Finance and Sales
  • Equip global teams with talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and customer proof points
  • Partner with DISW and DI Automation teams to align messaging, joint offers, and customer conversations
  • Partner with Product on roadmap priorities based on what research teams tell us
  • Connect biologics research to the bigger Molecule to Market narrative, including ELN, Lab Orchestration, and Biologics registration
  • Support strategic pursuits and executive conversations with customers and partners
  • Track market trends, including AI driven discovery, autonomous labs, lab automation, and data analytics, and turn them into action

We are looking for people who have 10 or more years in life sciences, with hands on biologics research experience in a pharma, biotech, or research institute setting. You wiil bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case, excellent writing and presentation skills, and ideally hold a degree in biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field. Advanced degree strongly preferred, and a PhD is a plus

The key skills

  • Deep understanding of how biologics discovery works day to day, including target validation, antibody and protein engineering, expression and purification, assay development, screening, characterization, and candidate selection
  • Knowledge of how research leaders make decisions, balance speed and quality, and work with development, automation, and data science teams
  • Familiarity with ELN, LIMS, registration systems, or assay data platforms
  • Experience in product marketing, market strategy, product management, or commercial roles at a software, informatics, or life sciences solutions company
  • A track record of driving software adoption, or of turning new technology such as AI into use cases customers actually adopt
  • Proven ability to turn complex science and technology into clear, simple messaging
  • Comfort working with senior leaders, industry experts, and customers
  • Ability to work across a large, global, matrixed organization and build trust with teams in different regions and business units

Nice to have

  • Experience running or supporting a biologics discovery team
  • Experience with lab automation, high throughput screening, or self driving lab concepts
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, or data platforms in a scientific setting
  • Existing relationships with industry thought leaders, analysts, or research institutes
  • Prior time at a biotech or in a discovery organization at a large pharma

What success looks like

  • A clear biologics research market strategy adopted by Sales, Product, Services, and Solution Marketing
  • Messaging and sales tools that teams around the world actually use
  • One consistent story for biologics research across Dotmatics, DISW, and DI Automation
  • Growing software adoption and a library of proven AI use cases in biologics research
  • Industry voices who help tell our story
  • Growing pipeline and wins tied to biologics research
  • Research leaders who can say, in their own words, why Luma helps their scientists find and advance better molecules faster

jobs.excerpt: Senior Product Designer (iOS 26 / Liquid Glass / Figma) - Portugal Full Remote ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITYWe’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with native iOS expertise to join a well-established digital product team.
jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer (iOS 26 / Liquid Glass / Figma) - Portugal Full Remote

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with native iOS expertise to join a well-established digital product team. They are building a shared, reliable design foundation for multiple product teams. This is a hands-on, fully remote role for a detail-obsessed designer who enjoys bringing order to complexity. You’ll turn a live, evolving product into a structured, well-documented template library that teams will rely on every day.

PROJECT & CONTEXT

The product is live across iOS 26+ and iPadOS 26+, with Apple’s Liquid Glass design language at its core. Your mission is to close the gap between what’s in production and what’s in the design files. You will:

  • Analyse production user journeys and recreate their screens, including states, interactions and platform-specific nuances
  • Compare production components against the design files and identify missing components and discrepancies in structure, appearance or behaviour
  • Document each difference with visual references, deviation descriptions and the affected screens or journeys
  • Build local components and variants that accurately reflect the current product, ready for review and alignment with the Design System
  • Organise screens into reusable templates, named consistently and structured by user journey and platform
  • Make sure templates are easy for different teams to adopt and adapt, with enough context to support new feature design

Expected deliverable: an organised template library that mirrors the live product, with documented discrepancies and local components prepared for review.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR (Required)

  • Native app design specialism, with proven experience designing with Liquid Glass on iOS 26+ and/or iPadOS 26+. This must be clearly stated on your CV.
  • Hands-on experience working with Design Systems, including how components, variants, patterns and tokens relate, and knowing when to reuse a component and when to propose a new variant. This must also be clear on your CV.
  • Advanced Figma mastery: Auto Layout, components, variants, component properties, variables, styles and libraries
  • High attention to detail and visual rigour, with a strong eye for discrepancies in layout, spacing, typography, colour, iconography and behaviour
  • Solid web and app interaction design background: responsive behaviour, platform conventions and states (loading, error, empty, success, unavailable)
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills, so you can describe issues clearly and constructively for designers and developers
  • Systematic, organised thinking to keep screens, journeys and shared files consistent across teams
  • Working knowledge of digital accessibility, to flag issues and guide future decisions
  • Autonomy and clear communication: you manage your own workload, resolve ambiguity and escalate what needs validation
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)

NICE TO HAVE (Preferred)

  • Previous experience building, contributing to or maintaining a Design System, beyond consuming one

Compensation: €1,800 – €2,500/month net, depending on experience and seniority level.

About the Company:

Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. We work with the largest global brands like Delta Airlines, MetLife, MGM, United, and others to enable agentic automation at scale across the entire customer journey. Our no-code platform delivers the fastest time to market, lowest total cost of ownership, and simple, scalable management of AI agents for any CX use case. Backed by WndrCo, Y Combinator, and Index Ventures, we help enterprises drive efficiency, lower costs, and deliver higher quality customer experiences.

Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!

About the Role:

The Solution Architect plays a critical role in guiding customers through their AI adoption journey — from discovery and architecture design to implementation and go-live. You will serve as the technical leader and trusted advisor in customer engagements, owning the solution blueprint and ensuring seamless delivery. This is a customer-facing, hands-on architecture role requiring deep technical expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, cloud-native solutions, and multi-tenant architectures, as well as strong communication skills to present solutions to senior stakeholders (CIOs, CTOs, VPs, and Directors).

Responsibilities

  • Customer Engagement & Advisory: Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and architecture reviews with enterprise customers.

  • Translate business challenges into scalable, secure, and cost-effective solution designs.

  • Present high-level architecture and roadmaps to executive stakeholders in a clear, concise, and consultative manner.

  • Build strong relationships as a trusted technical advisor to customer leadership teams.

  • Solution Architecture & Design: Define and document solution architectures leveraging tech stacks (Java, Python, Kafka, Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis, Docker, and AWS (ECS, RDS, S3, IAM, Lambda, etc.).

  • Design and validate multi-tenant SaaS architectures addressing scalability, reliability, security, and compliance.

  • Recommend integration patterns (APIs, microservices, event-driven) for seamless enterprise adoption.

  • Ensure solution designs align with Netomi’s product roadmap and best practices.

  • Implementation Leadership: Own the technical delivery of customer solutions, from PoC through production rollout.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to implement and optimize solutions.

  • Provide guidance on CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, observability, and performance tuning.

  • Lead solution validation, testing, and customer onboarding activities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Support pre-sales and RFP processes by crafting technical proposals and architecture decks.

  • Partner with Customer Success and Account Management to ensure long-term adoption and satisfaction.

  • Mentor engineers and solution consultants on architectural best practices and customer engagement.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise consulting roles.

  • Proven expertise with Java, Python, Spring Boot, MySQL, Redis, and microservices-based architectures.

  • Strong experience in AWS infrastructure (ECS, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM, networking, scaling strategies).

  • Hands-on knowledge of Docker, containerized deployments, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience building or implementing multi-tenant SaaS solutions in B2B environments.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills, with experience engaging CXOs and senior leadership.

  • Ability to lead technical discussions, influence decisions, and drive alignment across business and engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, or conversational AI platforms.

  • Knowledge of Kafka, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch for distributed data processing and search.

  • Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, etc.), and identity management (OAuth, SSO).

  • Exposure to large-scale B2B SaaS solution design in customer support, contact center, or AI-driven automation domains.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape next-generation AI solutions for global enterprises.

  • A customer-facing leadership role with direct impact on adoption and customer success.

  • Collaborative startup culture with the scale and reach of enterprise SaaS.

  • Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits.

  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities in Generative AI and SaaS solution architecture.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who can work across our entire product portfolio, from the established platforms that hundreds of school districts run on every day to the next-generation platform we are building to expand what's possible for them.

You'll work across both our core platform (BusPlanner Pro and our existing web applications, which must keep running reliably) and our next-generation platform (modern APIs and front ends on a unified data model and cloud-native architecture, with an AI assistant built directly on top of it). We need someone who respects the first, is excited by the second, and can make sound decisions across both.

We are an AI-first engineering team, and Claude Code is central to how we work. We are looking for someone who has fully embraced agentic development: who maintains CLAUDE.md files and skills that encode architecture and conventions, runs agents in parallel, builds verification into the loop, and treats getting better at this as part of the job.

Key Responsibilities

  • Core platform development - maintaining and enhancing our flagship product's core business logic, web applications, and databases, including performance tuning and production fixes across the full stack.
  • Next-generation platform development - designing and building features end-to-end on our modern platform, spanning APIs, modern web front ends, and cloud-based infrastructure.
  • Agentic development with Claude Code - using Claude Code as your primary development environment, and building and improving the CLAUDE.md files, skills, agents and workflows the rest of the team relies on.
  • Architecture and technical direction - contributing to design decisions across core and next-generation platforms, reviewing code and setting the standard for quality, including the review of AI-generated code.
  • Mentorship - raising the level of the team through code review, pairing and showing others what AI-first development looks like in practice.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a track record of senior-level ownership: taking features from ambiguous request through design, build, release and support.
  • Deep C#/.NET experience across both generations of the stack: .NET Framework with ASP.NET MVC, and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core.
  • Professional C++ experience and the ability to work productively in a large, long-lived production C++ codebase.
  • Strong SQL Server skills - schema design, T-SQL, stored procedures, query and index performance tuning on production databases.
  • Production React and TypeScript experience building real applications.
  • Full, daily use of Claude Code as your primary development tool. You should be able to show us how you work: CLAUDE.md files, custom skills or commands, subagents, MCP servers, hooks, parallel sessions or worktrees, and how you verify what the agents produce.
  • Experience building agentic workflows beyond your own desk - Claude Code in CI/CD pipelines, automated review, spec-driven or multi-agent development.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI features into products - LLM integrations, tool use, retrieval or agent-based functionality on top of application data.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience, including tenant isolation and enterprise customer requirements.
  • Kubernetes and Docker experience.
  • IBM Cloud experience, or strong experience with Azure or AWS.
  • Background in fleet, transportation, telematics, GPS, routing or logistics software.
  • Experience supporting both self-hosted and cloud-hosted deployments of the same product.

Benefits


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Full health and wellness benefits.
  • Flexible work hours and remote-friendly setup.
  • Full access to Claude Code and modern AI tooling, and the autonomy to shape how our team uses it.
  • A collaborative team culture focused on modernizing software that drivers, parents and school districts rely on every day.
